'go brjod/krung go mi dmangs chabasrid gros mol tshogs 'du'i sgrig yig nang du rim pa khag gi srid gros u yon lhan khang gis ‘‘'thab phyoḍa gcig gyuragyi khyad chos gzhir bzung ste/ krung go'i nye rab kyi lo rgyus dang / deng rabs kyi lo rgyus rgyu cha rnams bsdu sgrig dang zhib 'jug par skrun bcas kyibya ba spel dgos ’ zhes gtan 'bebs gnang yod pa der brda lan zhus tenag chu sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus dpyad yig khang gis rang gi khyad nus la dpag pa'i snga rting gis byang rgyud yul tsho'i lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha 'tshol bsdud kyis rtsom sgrig sda gon byas 6 lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha'i las don 'go tshugs tsam yin pa'i sa khul la ‘ rgya che gang mang gi bsdu len ’’byed rgyu'i dgongs don bzhin nag chu sa khul gyi lo rgyus ni da yan yig lam du gtan nas 'khod myong med pa zhig yin pa dang / rjes deng yang dngos don ldan pa'i lo rgyus 'tshol bsdud de 'go tshugs tsam rang yin par brten slar yang 'bad pa yod rgyas mgyogs la zhib pa'i 'tshol bsdud myur skyob yang yang bgyis pas zhi nas rang khul rdzong tsho ha

lam tshang ma'i lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha rtsa ba'i cha nas 'dzom thub pa byung / de dag nas snga rting gis bsdu bkod rtsom sgrig zhus te smyo nag chu sa khul gyi lo rgyus rig gnas ’’zhes pa'i deb chung kha shas shig rim bzhin 'don kyin yod/'dis nag chu sa khul gyi rdzong tsho so so'i lo rgyus rgyus mnga' yong ba dang / zhib 'jug byed par cha rkyen skrun pa/ rang khul lo rgyus rig gnas kyi stong cha kha skong / slad rang re'i 'di thad kyi bya gzhag la lam bu gsar gtod sogs kyi phan nus thon nges yin la thon rgyu'i re ba yang bcangs yod lags/ 'on kyang nga tshor lo rgyus kyi shes bya dman pa dang chu tshad zhan pa/ nyams myong srab pa/ dngos 'pher gyi mi sna nyung ba cha rkyen skyo ba/ dus tshod thung ba bcas la brten tshig don gang thad nas nor 'dzol dang 'gal nyog ci rigs yod nges pas gzigs po mkhyen can dang thos mang myong can rnam pas rin bral dgongs 'char dang dag bcos mdzad rogs zhu/srid gros nag chu sa gnas lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad yig tshogs chung gis 1991 lo zla tshes la/

dkar chagasngon la/ bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bsnyon med yin pa'i lo rgyus rags bsdus tsam nyi zlas/ (1)1 hor tsho'i snga phyi'i chabasrid kyi rnam pa lam tsam/ bkra ba/ (36)1 'brog pa'i 'tsho ba'i skor/ bkra ba dang bkra shis stobs rgyal/(53)3 sog rdzong dang 'bri ru rdzong gnyis su sa ma 'brog gi thon skyed bdag gnyer byed stangs skor/ phur bu bdud 'dus dang / g.yung rgyal ba/nyi zla/ rta mgrin/ yon tan/ bkra ba bcas kyis/(79)/bye 11 1sdo /) the:mi theg theṭa theṭa:rno/sge01 tshan ཿputhab 'o/ 95 zug zugab/ the: thag /rgyakhub ba/ ཿpa dang them grangs 'go dpon ming grangs bcas kyi tho byang sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus dpyad yig khang /(117) (nang khul gyis dus deb )nag chu sa gnas srid gros kyis rtsom sgrig dang dpe skrun byas/bod dmag khul khang dpar 'debs bzo gas dpar brgyab/〈〈dus deb 'di'i zhu dag gtong mkhan gtso bo 〉〉bod dmag khul khang dpar 'debs bzo grwa'i blo bzang yin/

'khrug zang zing rnams mjug sgril nas gcig gyur gyis sa skya pa la sa gnas kyi srid dbang sprad de mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs dngos sum̐ gyur pa red/ 'di ni dus kyi 'khor phyogs dang mi sems gtad phyogs shig kyang red/ de'ang rabs byung 3 pa'i lcags byi spyi lo 1240 gong ma yon brgya /lha mtho 11 theg coje the1 /) rngotho :nge rjes tshes ra spre( 1shākyi ba/ zug nga(zug ཿ/zugab/ nga( zug zug zab stan zugab/ po dpung chen dang sbrags bod ljongs su btang nas ‘‘shar kong po'i yul yan chad nas nub bal po dang / lho mon la thug tshun chad kyi btsan po'i mkhar rnams bsgyel zhing gong ma rgyal po'i lung las mi 'da' ba'i rgyal khrims btsan pos gnya' ba mnan dor rta nag pos bod ljongs dbang du bsdus rjes go dan la ‘‘bod mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal khams na/ dge 'dun gyi sde ni bka' gdams pa che/ ngo srung ni stag lung chos rje mkhas/gzi brjid ni 'bri gung spyan snga che chos ni sa skya paṇa ṭi ta mkhas par 'dug pas gang spyan 'dren gyi lung rtsol zhig ces zhus par sa skya paṇa ṭi ta gdan 'dren dgos pa'i bka' phabs skabs der sa pan dgung lo re gsum du phebs yod khongs gi tsha bo 'phags pa dgung lo ( 11 〉(phyag na rdo rje dgung lo 7khrid nas lang kru la byon (deng tan su zhing chen gyi lu we rdzong )ste go dan dang mjal 'phrad zhus thog bod sa gnas kyis mong gol han la mgo sgur rgyu'i cha rkyen dang / dpya khral mjal rgyu'i rnams—grangs dang / grangs 'bor rnams gros thag bcad pa red/ shing 'brug 1244 lor sa pan kun dga' rgyal mtshan lang kru la phebs rjes mes rgyalagong bu gcig gyur yong ched/ bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs dang / mi 2

dmangs la bslabs bya'i spring yig bsrings bod kyi mtho rim dpon rigs dang / ser skya mi dmangs kyis hor se chen go dan rgyal po'i gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i bod sa gnas srid 'dzin gyi rtsa ba'i lam lugs dang /yul dpon rnams sngar yod go gnas rang 'jag 'joḍa rgyu yul dpon gyis sa skya'i gser yig par brtsi bkur zhu dgos pa las/ rang tshod byas mi chog pa/ dmag khral dang / khral 'ul lam lugs sogs lag len bstar then :sgo /tshe reṭa theṭa:rno 21 :rdo /spre :sgo :)che/:rnotshoṭa bzhi ཿ/ thab sdigarngub shāspyo dzisno zug ba/theg thab nga/ཿpu / grangs/ 'dab nor gyi tshad yi ge legs po gsum bzos nas gcig hor rgyal por 'bul dgos pa dang / gcig sa skyar bzhag rgyu/ gcig rang rangagi dpon gyis nyar tshags dgos pa sogs kyi gtan 'bebs kha gsalaganang yod/ de nas bzung bod 'di hor gyi mnga' 'bangs su gyur pa dang / se chen go dan rgyal pos sa skya paṇa ṭi ta bod khri skor 13 gyi bdag por bskos de nas bod kyi dpon 'bangs rnams kyis bang mi dmags te sa paṇa bod la gdan drangs kyang nged yar log pa las 'dir sdad na༄na pa che zer nas ma byon/ lang krur lo 7 bzhugs nas mthar lcags phags/ 1251 lor der sku gshegs pa dang / 'phags pa skumached mu mthud bzhugs yod/ 1252 lor pi li se chen han gyis lhophyogs dpung 'jug gis ta li btul (deng sang yun nan zhing chen )nas rgyal kha'i ngang phyir log lam li phan hran ri bo (kan su'i mnga' khongs )rgal skabs sa paṇa gdan zhus kyi pho nya mngags rung sa paṇa 'das zin pa'i tsha bo 'phags pa sku mched gdan drangs kyis se chen han gyi gam du 3

bzhugs 'di dus (dgung lo 19)de rjes 'phags pas to co'i 'thus mi pham par bzos pas se chen nas brtsi 'jog chen po thob 1260lor hu pi li se chen han gong ma'i go sa 'khod rjes 'gro mgon 'phags pa guthi bskos nas g.yang tri'i tham ka rtsal ba red/ de lo se chen han gyis ta mon gyis gtsos pa'i dpon po khag gcig bod ljongs la btang zhing de'i las 'gan ni them dud zhib bsher byed rgyu dang / sa tshigs 'dzugs rgyu de red/ skabs der mes rgyal nang khug nas bod ljongasabar la 'ja' mo khyon sdoms 27 btsugs par/ mdo stod la 'ja' mo 7 mdo smad la 'ja' mo 9 dbus la 'ja' mo 4 gtsang la 'ja' mo 7 bcasayod pa red/ 'ja' mo'i las 'gan ni/ par tshur 'gro 'ong dpon po dang / gzhung skyel mkhan bang chen rnams la sdod sa sprod rgyu dang /zhor rta brje rgyu de red/ 1287 lor them dud zhib bsher thengs gsum pa byed skabs yonga' ris su 'ja' mo 4 btsugs pas khyon 31 yod/'ja' mo'i 'og tu yan lag sa tshugs kha shas re btsugs yod cing 'ja' mo rer zhing bran nam/ 'brog bran kha shas re sprad nas 'ja' mo der khral rgyug gi yod pa red/ (yon rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus )nang du bkod pa ltar na/ 'ja' mo rer rta brgya re dang / phyugs zog nyis brgya re lug lnga brgya re bcas dngul la phabs nas smod kyi yod pa red/ 1264loragong ma hu pi li se chen han hrang tu'u nas ta tu'u (deng gi pe cing ) duganas sbo gnang ste tsung kri yon las khungs btsugs nas sangs rgyas chos lugs pa dang / bod ljongs bdag skyong byed/ tsung kri yon las khungs ni4

skabs der yon rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung gis btsugs pa'i krung dbyang gilas khungs bod ljongs kyi las don kho nar do dam byed mkhan zhig red/tsung kri yon las khungs nang du yon hri gnyis bsko bzhag byas yod cing rim pa dang po'i khungs gtogs yin/ thengs dang por bsko bzhag byas pa'i yon hri gnyis kyi nang nas gcig ni sang ko zer ba dang / gcig ni 'gro mgon 'phags pa red/ skabs der 'gro mgon 'phags pa yon rgyalarabs srid gzhung gi dpon rigs chen po ang dang po'i gras su gyur yod lo'adir se chen gong mas 'gro mgon 'phags par bod kyi lha sde yongs kyi gtso skyong legs par byed dgos pa'i skor 'ja' sa mu tig ma zhes pa gnang me yos 1267 lo 'gro mgon 'phags pas sog yig gsar gtod mdzad zin te pe cing du phebs dus der las tshan 13 gra sgrig mdzad nas byon/ las tshan 13 zhes pa ni (ya rabs kha rgyan las gsol gzim mchod gsum/ mdzal yig mdzod gsum/ thab 'dren gdan gsum/ skya rta mdzo khyi bzhi zhes 'khod )dpon chen rnams la las tshan 13 btsugs srol 'di nas dar ba yin zer/)hor yig gi yig phud phul bas gong ma bugs shin tu dgyes bzhin gnam gyi 'og sa yi steng rgya gar gyi lha yi sras po/ yi ge rtsom mi/ spul ba'i sangs rgyas/rgyal khams 'jags su 'jug mi/ snyan ngag gi rgyu/ paṇa ṭi ta 'phags pa ti shri zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ zang zing gi 'bul ba yang dngul bre chen stong ra can/ gos dar lnga khri dgu stong la sogs nor rdzas phun sum 'tshogs pa phul rab byung lnga pa'i shing khyi 1274 lor 'gro mgon 5

'phags pa pe cing nas tshib kha sgyur skabs su gong ma se chen thugs 'bral mi phod pa lta bu'i nyams 'khrungs nas skyel thung zhag nas zla spar zla ba nas lor spar te bod kyi yul sbom ra lha yi bya 'dabs rma gu ra'i lha gzhol/rma chu khug pa'i sa cha bar du phebs skyel zhu bar phebs sa gnas der zang zing gi mchod sprin rgya cher bshams nas dga' bsu zhus me khyi 1276lo'aphags pa sa skyar phebs 1277 lo chu mig gi chos 'khor btsugs pa dang 1280 lor 'phags pa dgung lo 45 thog blo bur du sku gshegs/khong gis sa skya'i bdag chen khri thog dang po'i thuza/sa 'gan lo 15 bzhes yod/ de'i gong 'gro mgon 'phags pa thengs dang po mes rgyal nas yar phebs rjes nang khul gyi srid 'dzin sa skya dpon chen zer ba bsko gnang mdzad yod pa de dpon chen dang po shākya bzang po yin/ sa byi 1288lor tsung kri zhes pa'i spyi khyab las khungs de shon gri yon zhes ming bsgyur 'di ni yon gong ma se chen gyis bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs dngos sugyur rjes bod kyi phyi nang gi las don gal chen mtha' dag la bkod 'dom dang / 'go khrid byed pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs mtho shos yin/ yon se chen gong mas rim bzhin bod rigs sa khul du shon dbu tre si tu'u yon hrang h+phu zhes pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs gsum btsugs/ de dag gis nub byang sa khul dang / lho nub sa khul dbus gtsang / mnga' rigs sa khul bcas kyi bod rigs dmag dmangs rnams kyi 'go 'dzin gnang / srid 'dzin las khungs de dag gi dpon rigs yon se chen gong mas bsko bzhag rtsal zhing / bod kyi yul dpon che gras la khri dpon6

dang / stong dpon sogs bsko bzhag rtsal bod khri skor bcu gsum gtanaphabs kyis sa skya pas spyi khyab dbang 'dzin byed dgos pa'i bka' rtsal bod khrid skor bcu gsum zhes pa ni la stod lho byang dang / gur mo chu mig shang zha lu ste gtsang la khri drug rgya ma 'bri gung / tshal pa/ thang po che ba/ phag gru/ g.ya' bzang ste dbus kyi khri drug dbus gtsang gnyis kyi mtshams su yar 'brog khri skor gcig bcas yin/ de yang khri skor re la lha sde bzhi stong dang / mi sde drug stong yod pa yin 'dug sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen bang mdzod las/ dbang yon bar ma la tshos dung dkar po rgyang grags kyis gtsos bod chol kha gsum gyi ban de dang / mi sde thams cad phul ba yin pas chol kha gsum la zhing gcig tu rtsis pa —yin par bshad de/ de yang stod mnga' ris skor gsum nas sog la skya bo yan dam pa chos kyi chol kha/ sogal skya bo man nas rma chu'i khug pa yan mgo nag mi yi chol kha/ rma chu'i khug pa man nas mchod rten dkar—po yan chad kyi ling rta yi chol kha zhes grags shing / zhing zhes pa'i tha snyad—kyang khang pa ka ba drug gi sa yod pa/ bza' mi gnyis bu pho mo gnyis/g.yog pho mo gnyis te drug phyugs rta bong gnyis ba glang ra lug rnams dang zhing hor son khal bcu gnyis yod pa rnams la hor dud chung gcig zer ba yin/ de 'dra nyi shu rtsa lnga la dud chen gcig de 'dra gnyis la rta mgo gcig de gnyis la brgya skor gcig de bcu la stong skor gcig de bcu la khri skor gcig de bcu la klu gcig de bcu la zhing gcig bya ba yin ’’zhes 'khod 'phags pa'i gcung po 'gro mgon phyag na la7

gong ma se chen nas sa len wa nga gi lung dang / gser tham gnang / hor rgyal po'i sras mo mer gan btsun mor gnang hor gyi cha lugs su bcugs te bod chol kha gsum gyi khrims bdag tu bskos yod/ da nas zhib par mi zhu bar mdor na sa skya'i khri thog bdag chen drug dpon chen las thog nyi shu'i ring lung las mtha' dag yon gong mas rtsal nas bod sa gnas kyi srid 'dzin lo dgu bcu lhag byas yod/2 phag gru sogs kyi dus skabs/ de rjes sa skyar bla brang khag mang gyes pa dang / nang khul thugs ma mthun pa'i gleng brjod mang ba/ dpon chen dbang brtson dang / rgyal bzang sogs kyis phag gru dang g.ya' bzang khri skor zlos gyar skor phyogs lhung sogs sna tshogs byung pa'i rkyen la brten phag gru khri dpon byang chub rgyal mtshan nas khri dpon gzhan las zhi drag las gang las rgyal ba byas te ha lam khri skor bcu gsum yongs kyi dbang cha bzung nas rab byung drug pa'i shing rta lo 1354 lor drung chen shes bkras pa la seng ge'i pags pa sder bzhi ma nyams pa sogs nor bu mang poskur nas gong ma'i drung du btang yon gong ma tho bkan the'i mur la yin min gnas lugs gsal zhing gsal ba zhus/ gong ma chen pos bod kyi da yod gnas tshul la dbye zhib dang dus deb zhod 'jags myur du yong ba'i ched du/ khrid dpon byang chub rgyal mtshan la ti si tu gong ma'i las rogasakyi go gnas dang / bod yongs kyi srid dbang rtsis blang chog pa'i bka' shog dang / tham ga bcas gnang / de nas bzung khag gru'i srid dbang dngos su btsugs/ ta sa byang chub rgyal mtshan bod sa gnas srid dbang 8

gi byed po gtso bor gyur/ dus 'di nas bzung khri dpon byang chub rgyal mtshan mi zer bar ta'i si byang chub rgyal mtshan zer ba yin sa phag dbar dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul du srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i khyod shi nga gson gyi 'thab rtsod rabs dang rim pa byung yang / phyogs gnyis nas yon gong ma'i srid gzhung la brtsi bkur dang len byed dgos pa gsal por mthong thub si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan 'das rjes mes rgyal nang khul du phyogs gang sa nas zhing pas 'os langs byung nas gnam 'og tu 'gran zla med pa'i hor gong ma'i srid dbang de snum zad kyi mar me lta bur gyur nas mthar ku'o tsi shin gyi dmag dpon kru'u yon krang nas yon gong ma'i srid dbang mgo rting slog nas 1368 lor nan cing du ming rgyal rabs dngosasu btsugs/ dus der phag gru mjam dbyangs shākya rgyal mtshan dang /zhwa nag korma pa rol ba'i rdo rje sogs kyis rgyal sa nan cing du bang mi btang ste ming rgyal rgyal rabs dngos su tshugs par rten 'brel zhus/ ming gong ma chen po kru'u yon krang gis 'jam dbyangs shākya rgyal mtshan la ta'i si tu ste gong ma'i las rogs dang / tshin go gung / ka din gu shri zhes pa rgyal khab slob dpon gtsug gi nor bu zhes pa'i cho lo dang / tham ga gnang ba ma zad/ bod chol kha gsum dbang 'dzin chog pa'i 'ja' sa'ang gnang ba red/ ming rgyal rabs btsugs pa'i rjes su yon rgyal rabs dang 'dra bar bod 'di ming gong pa chen po'i 'og srid 'dzin sa khongs zhigal rtsis nas bdag dbang yongs su lag len bstar mes rgyal nang khul dang / lhag par yun nan dang / kong kro'u/ zi khron/ kong zhi sogs 9

grangs nyung mi rigs kyi sa khul du btsugs pa'i dmag dang / srid 'dzin lam lugs de dag bod du lag len bstar/ rab byung drug pa'i chu byi 1372 lor bod dbus gtsang zhing tu'u kre hung hri si zhes pa bkod 'doms spyi khyab khang btsugs/ rim pa khag gi ser skya dpon rigs mtha' dag ming gong ma chen pos bsko bzhag rtsal/ phag gru sde srid chos rgyal khri rabs lnga pa grags pa rgyal mtshan la gong ma ming the'i tsu'u yis hung lung khri lo nyer gcig par ‘ bkan ting gu shri'i 7go gnas gnang zhing gong ma ming khring tsu'u yi yung le'i khri lo bzhi par 1406 lor ‘ bkan ting gu shri hran ha wang zhes pa'i go gnas gnang thog g.yang ṭi'i tham ga 'brug gzugs can sogs rtsal/ yung le'o khri lo lnga par 1407 lor hu co wang dang / tsan hran wang / 'bri gung pa gu shri/ 'bri gung dang mdo khams lung mda' bca/ga skor gsum khron bod tsho ba khag bcas mnyam du 'ja' mo bskyar 'dzub/sa byas nas phar tshur shar bgrod thub pa zhig yong ba byed dgos pa'i bka' phabs pa red/ de nas lam kha tshang ma shar bgrod thub pa byung nas pho nya phar tshur le bar khri phrag kha shas 'gro dus kyang jag rkun gyi 'phrog bcom 'khel dogs sems khral mi dgos pa zhig byung ba red/ 1408 lo gong ma chen po yung los rje tsong kha pa gdan drangs rung / khong gi tshab tu byam chen chos rje shākya ye shes btang mdzad/ phag gru'i sde srid ngag dbang bkris grags pa la gong ma chen pos sngar bzhin bkan ting gu shri h+pha wang ste rgyal khab slob dpon gtsug gi norabu chos kyi rgyal po zhes pa'i cho lo gnang de nas yun ring ma song par rin 10

spung pas zing cha bslangs gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse sogs bzung / de rjes des kyang srid dbang bzung long ma byung bar rin spung pa'i mnga' 'og zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo rjes mgo rting bslogs/ gtsad pa sde srid pha bu gsum gyis srid dbang gang mtshams bzung 'di dus nang sa nas ming rgyal rabs bar gyi dbang sgyur 'thor zhig 'gro bzhin yod/ mdor na phag grusde srid khri rabs bcu gsum tsam dang rin spung pa gtsang pa sde pa bcas kyiskabs ming gong ma rim byung nas lung las 'ja' sa re re bzhin rtsal yod pa red/ gong gsal phag gru sogs kyis bod sa gnas kyi dbang sgyur lo nyis brgya dgu bcu skor byas yod/(3) dga' ldan pho brang pa'i dus skabs gtsang pa dkar ma bstan skyong dbang po'i skabs kur dge par 'gal ba drag po byung nas dge lugs pa'i rgyab snon sog po hong the' ji sogs nas sog dmag btang nas 'thab 'khrug phran bu byung ba dang mthar tā las lnga pa'i phyag mdzod bsod nam rab brtan nas sog po'i gu shri han la rgyab rogs zhus ltar gu shri han nas bar khams be ri don yod rgyal po bcom pa dang chabs cig bod du byudapung drangs nas kurma bstan skyong dbang po'i mnga' 'og dbang du bsdus/ gtsang pa sde srid rjes 'brang dang bcas pa chams la phabs nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta 1642 bla ba gsum par tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'bras spung nas gzhis rtser gdan drangs/ tshom chen du gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal dang / bsod nams re:rdo 1sde lhas/ 151 lhas/ :spro( /bsdi :rdo1/bye/ 1re/ there/sa 'a la gas da ga da na gas mang dbus su snga hor 11

chen rgyal pos 'gro mgon 'khags par phul ba'i ma skyes dgra yi bstan skalargyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi 'phel gdung rgyal mkhar rtser bzhugs par grags pa dang / khrus long ma ni ma'am/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi thuḍa gsal me long nang rten bla sku li ma rgya nag mas mtshon pa'i mchod rtenamang po de bzhin gna' rdzas khyad par can du ma rgyal bar lnga pa phul ba dnga'abrel gtsang pa rgyal po'i pho brang gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtses thog drangs bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi dbang cha yongs rdzogs phul ba yin zhes khyab bsgrags byas/ bsod nams chos 'phel sde srid kyi go gnas gnang /dga' ldan pho brang pa'i srid dbang btsugs ('bras spung jo khang sdon 1rdo// // 1re/ /ste/ /ji/ /bye//rdo// //mi /che/ra dus ra sa rgyal nang khul du nga pa sa langs ga ga sa gnyis mthud langs te ming rgyal rabs kyi srid dbang mgo rting bslogs nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i 'i/nga sprel 1644 lor man ching rgyal rabs kyi srid gzhung btsugs gu shri han ni ching rgyal rabs srid gzhung gisagazhung bzang brtsi srung drang bden las skyong mdza' chan gu shri han zer ba'i mtshan gnas bskos yod pa'i blon po yin/ tā la'i sku phreng lnga pa dang /paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa rnams gnyis kyis gu shri bstan mjon chos rgyal la bka' gros legs par zhus te se chen chos rje rgyud sngar srol lta 'tshams 'dri'i yi ge dang / rten bcas phul te man ching krung dbyang srid gzhung dngos su tshugs par rten 'brel zhus pa ma zad gsar du btsugs pa'i sa gnas srid gzhung la gang ci'i rgyab skyor roḍa ram yong ba'i re ba zhus pa de dag ching srid gzhung gi bod la 'dzin pa'i srid jus dang yongs su mthun 12

stabs gong ma shun tsi thung shin hu mnyes se chen chos rje lha sar phyir phebs skabs tā la'i bla ma mchog dang / paṇa chen/ sa skya chos rgyal stag lung chos rje kurma pa sogs la 'tshams 'dri'i yi ge dang / gnang skyen rin po che sna tshogs dang dar gos ji snyed gnang / gong ma chen pos bod kyi hūṃ 'gro rnams bde zhing skyid pa dang chos dang srid kyi 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa yong ba'i ched du sngar srol bzhin gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes bzang po mdzad sdesrid bsod nams chos 'phel sa gnas khag tu bskor zhib bskyod nas khral rigs zhib gzhung gsar du bkod/ shing bya 1645lo pho brang dkar po rmang gzhi bting lo gsum nang leḍa grub zin chu 'brug 1652 lor zla ba gsum par rgyal dbang lnga par gong ma shun rtsi khri lo dgu pa'i thog gdan zhuganang bzhin bod sog gi dpon rigs mang po dang bcas 'bras spung nas chib sgyur te rgyal sa pe cing du phebs/ hong si zhes pa'i dgon par bzhugs gsol ba zhabs rtog gang legs mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos gser gyi byang bu gser chos kyi shog bu mthug shos dang mnyam pa bco lnga 'phrul mig tu sgrel te ltebs chog pa zhig gi thog ‘ nub phyogs kyi lha gnas ches dge par bde par gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' lung gnam 'og gi skye 'gro thabs cad bstan pa gcigā tu gyur pa/ 'gyur med rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i bla ma ’ zhes rgya bod hor gsum gyi yi ge shan sbyar pa'i 'ja' sa gnang / rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/ gnam gyi lha 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po zhes 'khod pa'i gser gyi byang bu zhig 'bul bar phul/ de nas tā la'i bla ma mchog sa chu 'phrod min la 13

brten bod la phyir log chog pa'i dgongs zhu btang chu sprul 1653 lor zlab gnyis pa'i nang rta hra'u dgon par tā la'i bla ma phebs skyel zhu ba'i gsol ston gzab rgyas bsham/ 'jam dbyang gong ma shun tse'ang gsol ston du phebs te lhan 'dzoms thog gsung mol gnang zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin pe cing nas chibs sgyur gong ma chen po'i bka' ltar haso dran tshe chin lpang gis dmag sde brgyad sna khrid de te khar zhes pa'i sa gnas bar phebs skyel zhus/ te' khar 'byor rjes gong ma ched pos slar yang pho nya gnyis mngags te gser yig dang / tham ga kha ris su yig rigs bzhi shan sbyar 'bru don du ‘ nub phyogs kyi phul byung zhi ba'i sangs rgyas rgya chen khyon la sangs rgyas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang tā la'i bla ma'i tham ga zhes pa gnang / 'di nas bzungatā la'i mtshan gnas de bod kyi chab srid thog 'god thub pa byung ba red 1653 lo'i lnga bcod skabs lha sar 'byor yar phebs nas dga' ldan pa'i sa gnas srid dbang sra brtan du btang ba sogs kyi las ka mdzad nas 1682 lor po ta lar zhi bar gshegs/ skabs der sde srid lnga pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos dus gnas kyi dgos dbang la gzhigs nas lnga pa chen po sku gshegs par gsang rgya byas te gong ma la go sa zhus pas so/nga masathu rbe chi rgyal po'i go sa dang gser tham sprad 1696 lor gong ma khang zhi bde skyid rgyal pos phyi sog la dpung 'jug byed skabs bzung dmag bod mi zhig gis tā la'i 'das pa'i gsang ba brtol stabs/ gong mas tā la'i gshegs rjes paṇa chen gyis dbang cha ma bzung bar gsang ba byas par 14

bka' bkyon mdzad pa'i yi ge btang bar sde srid sangs rgyas pas gnas tshul babs gses zhib par phul bas gong ma dgos pa dwangs de nas tā la'i drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho khrir bkod dus skabs 'di'i snga rjes nas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud bar srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod byung yod/ gu shri mi rabs gsum pa rgyal po lha bzang dang mthun thabs med pa'i 'gal ba dragapo byung nas glengartsod byung la thar shing bya 1705 lor zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin lha bzang khang gis stod lung snang rtser sde srid sangs rgyasargya mtsho bkrongs pa red/ de nas lha bzang khang gis tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho tshul mthun min tshul gong ma khang zhir dbyen sbyor mang tsam zhus pa sa gong mas sku tshab pad ma sbri chi sogs mngags nas nang sa la bkug par mtshosngon kun dga' nor zer ba'i sa char 'das zer/ ye shes rgya mtsho khrir bkod/ lha bzang khang la'ang gong mas cho lo gnang / de rjes 1717lor jun gar tshe ring don grub kyi dmag dpung bod la lhag nas rgyal po lha bzang khang pham par bzos nas bkrongs pa dang / kho pas bod dbang zung nas dga' ldan thi ji stag rtse lha rgyal rab brtan srid skyong byed pa'i khrir bkod/ ye shes rgya mtsho rtse nas phabs jun gar pas gang sar khrims med lung med kyis 'phrog bcom byas pa dang / chos lugs grub mtha' khag dbar phyo gas ris cher 'dzin gyis rnying dgon gtsos grub mtha' gzhan gyi dgon pa rtsa med bzos/ rdo brag rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'phrin las dang / smin gling gdung sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho/ smin15

gling lo chen rdarma shri sogs bla ma mang po bkrongs/ lhag par du jun gar pas sngar bzhin 'jam dbyang gong ma chen po'i bka' la brtsi bkur mi zhu ba ma zad/ bod btsan bzung byas rjes zi khron dang / mtsho sngon yun nan sogs khyims mtshes zhing chen gyi bde 'jags la yang gnod 'tshe btang /rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa khyi 1718 lor gong ma khang zhi mchog gis dpung dmag btang ste jun gar ba btul bar 'ong kyang sa rgyus med pa dang / dmag rgyag mkho sbyor dus su ma slebs pas nag chu nas ching dmag phams 1719 lo slar yang gong ma'i sras bcu bzhi pa yun thi rgyang skyod dmag dpung dpung sde drug gi spyi khyab cherno po bskos te mdo khams sogs dmag lam kha shas nas dpung skyod byas pas jun gar phams bros byas te btul thog tsheḍa med du lha sar 'byor nas 1720 lor jun gar dmag yongs rdzogs bod nas mthar bskrad/ yul lung bde zhing skyid par gyur/bod 'bangs kyi skye bo yongs nas 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i dpung dmag bod du lhags par brtsi bkur zhus jun gar gyis bskos pa'i sde srid stag rtse ba sogs khrims kyis tshar bcad gong ma chen po'i bka' star/ lo de'i zla ba dgu pa'i nang rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtshor khrir bkod/ gong ma'i gtsang jun dang gung tshe dbang nor bu/ don grub wang /bstan 'dzin wang / i si pi si pe lib/ nga phod pa rdo rje rgyal po gung sumapa soḍa rgya bod tshoḍa 'du chen mos lo gcig ring bod sa gnas kyi srid kyi kha lo sgyur/ de rjes gong ma'i bka' 'brel bzhin khang chen pa bsod namasargyal po ste de bzhin sba dur gtso bo byas pa'i pi si nga phod dang / gung 16

lum pa tha'i ji sbyar ra ba/ pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas bcas kyis chab srid skyong / skabs 'dir gong mas khang chen par bdag chen 'ja' sa dang / gser tham rtsal thel rtse'i 'bru don yang /‘‘pi si khang chen nas gtsobo/ pi si nga phod pas las rogs phying sang rnams kyi tham ga rgyal dge ’ zhes pa yod/ 'dis sa gnas srid dbang lo bdun skyong / kha sa khan am ban nang sar phyir log rjes nga lum sbyar gsum dang / khang chen pa dang pholha ba rnams gnyis phyogs gcig byas dbar 'gal ba je cher byung nas mthar nga lum sbyar gsum gyis ngan gros bshams nas 1727 lor bka' shag tshogs pa'i skabs bsnan khang chen pa gtsugs lag khang gi gzim chung kham gsum du bgrongs pa dang pho lha bas skor gsum gtsang dmag bsdus te'athab 'phrug yun ring byas mthar pho lha bar rgyal kha thob nas lha sa blangs/dus der 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos bod kyi gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing ha cang che ba mkhyen rtoḍa kyis snga rjes su nang blon khang gi zho hri seng ge dang glu tu'u thung mā la/ spu cangayan chin soḍa pho nyar mngags te bod kyi gnas tshul rtog zhib mdzad/ yothe 1728lor dmag dpon chen po khrang lang a dang / smad lu sogs kyi sne khrid pa'i dpon dmag 8400zi ling nas bod du 'ong blon chen kro dbyin gyis sne khrid pa'i zi khron gyi dpung dmag 4000 lhag tsam dkar mdzes rgyud nas bod skyod byas dmag dpon nan than zhan gyis gtso khrid mdzad pa'i dpung dmag 3000 lhag yun nan nas bod du lhags/ dmag lam gsum gyi dmag mi skya rkang 15400 tsam lha sar 'byor ba'i rjes su/ sngon skyod dpon rigs dang 17

lha na du dmab/ srid dpon chen rnams bka' gros dang / gnas tshul zhib rtsad byas rjes khrims kyi do ra chen por/ nga lum sbyar gsum sogs bye gtedang / rjes 'brangs pa mi nyer gnyis dus gcig tu srog bkum/ kho lha bsod nams stobs rgyal la pi si'i cho lo dang jun lpa nga zhes pa'i 'ja' sa gser tham che mo yi ge gsum sbya ra 'bru don du dbus gtsang gi bka' slob kyi bya ba byed mkhan rdo ros pi si'i tham ga zhes pa bcas gnang /pho lha pa bod sa gnas kyi chab srid 'gan yongs su bzhes 'di dus gong mkhang zhi gshegs nas sras g.yung kring gong ma gnang gi yod/ gong ma g.yung kring mchog gis bod kyi gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing che bar byed thabs mang tsam lag len bstar ba sa spre 1728 lor dar mdo dang li thang 'ba' bcas sa gnas khag gcig zi khron gyi mnga' 'og tu bcug kham gyi lho ngos bde chen dang / 'od zhi sogs sa gnas khag gcig yun nan gyi mnga' khongs su sprad gzhi rtse nub ngos nas mnga' ris skor gsum bcas paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes la phul yang paṇa chen rin po ches lha ngam phun gsum ma gtogs rtsis ma bzhes de bzhin bod sdod am ban 4btsugs pa'i lam lugs gsar du bzos/ sa spre 1728 lor bod sdod am ban dang po mā la dang de'i las rogs seng ge bsko bzhag rtsal/zi khron dang hran shi'i dmag mi nyis stong tsam bod la bzhag thog am ban gyis bkod 'dom byed du bcug chab mdor yun nan gyi dmag mi chig stong tsam bzhag pa sogs byed thabs mang po lag len bstar bas mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur yong ba dang / bod mi dmangs kyi bde 'jags la'ang—18

phan thog che cher byung 1735 lor gong ma g.yung kring zhi bar gsheḍa de'i sras bzhi pa chan lung gser khrir mnga' gsol pho lha mi dbang nas a ma ban dang lhan du lo nyi shu'i ring srid skyong nas 'das rjes gong ma chan lung gis pho lha ba'i byas rjes la gzhigs nas 1747 lor pho lha'i sras chung ba 'gyur med rnam rgyal la jun wang gi cho lo tsho dang / gser tham chen mo skad yig gsum sbyar ma zhal ris su 4dbus gtsang gi bka' slob bya ba byed mkhan tho jun wang gi tham ga ’ zhes pa gnang de snga yab pho lha la rtsal ba'i dmar tham khag gnyis rang 'jags su rtsal nas bod kyi srid 'gan blangs bcug 'gyur rnam khrir 'khod ma thag yab pho lha'i srid jus dang yongs su 'gal nas bod sdod am ban la ngo rgol dang tā la'i bla mar brtsi bkur mi zhu ba/ mnga' ris gung gcen po 'gyur med tshe brtan jun bkrongs pa gar dang lkog tu 'brel ba byas pa sogs bya log spyod log la brten bod bzhugs am ban gyis gong mar snyan seng zhus pa dang 'brel gnas tshul gyi dbang gis gong ma'i mngag pa'i dpon dmag sgug long ma byung bar am ban phun rin dang / lab stun gnyis nas 'gyur rnam skong ste 1750lor zla bcu pa'i nang khrom gzigs khang du srog bkums/ 'on kyang 'gyur rnam gyi ngan rogs nas nang 'khor sdus te am banaganyis bkrongs/chan lung khri lo bco lnga par gong ma'i bka' bzhin tā la'i bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho nas srid 'gan bzhes lcags rta 1750 lor zla bcu gnyis par h+phu hu thung ban de dang / zi khron gyi tsung tu'u tshe ring gis dpung dmag khag gcig khrid nas lha sar 'byor 'phral zing 'khrug skor 19

gsal rtog gnang nas mgron gnyer blo bkras bcas byed gte mi drug lus la khra ma rgyab ste thog btang mi drug ske bcad/ 'phros btson 'jug byas/ 'gyur rnam gyi kha dbang gzhung bzhes btang gong ma chan lung gi bka' bkod bzhin lo rgyus kyi bslab bya blangs te jus zang kri ste rgyal po'i lam lugs med bzos bod kyi chab srid las don mtha' dag tā la'i bla ma dang bod bzhugs am ban rnam gnyis kyis 'gan khur dgos pa'i bka' phabs bka' shag sgrig gzhi dngos su btsugs/ gtso bo rdo ring no yon paṇa ṭi ta gung 'gon po dngos grub rab brtan dang las rogs dzasag mdo 'khar gzhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyas thang pa srid ched rdo rje ser mo ba rtse mgron dar han nyi ma rgyal mtshan bcas bka' blon bzhi bskobazhag rtsal phyi nang gi bya ba gang ci thun mong thag gcod pa las brgya kha gcig chod mi chog pa tā la'i bla ma dang am ban rnams gnyis la brtsi bkur mtha' gcig tu zhu ba las tshul min gyi bya ba'i rigs gye da chog pa'i bka' phabs/ lcags lug 1751 lor bka' rtag dngos su btsugs pa der dam kha bde skyid ma dang rtags dam sel dam bcas gnang ba red drug mgron 'gag ste bka' drung dang / bka' mgron 'gag pa bcas 'dzugs pa'i srol gtod de rjes yig tshang las khungs dang rtse slob grwa sogs btsugs tshe ring dang ban de sogs kyis gong ma chan lung gis bka' slob gzhir bzung gang sa ci thad nas zhib 'jug byas te 1751cho/ra bod kyi las don byed phyogs skor gyi sgrig yig 7don tshan bcu gsum zer ba zhig bton pa red/ min ching gong mas gtan phabs ltar na tā 20

la'i dgung lo bco brgyad ma zin bar srid dbang bzhes mi chog cing de'i ring rgyal tshab zhig bsko dgos pa de'ang bstan rgyas gling dang / tsho smon gling sogs spul sku che khag nas gang 'os zhig lagong ma chen pos lung dang tham gnas rtsal gyi yod pa red/ tā la'i brgyad pa 'jams dpal rgya mtsho'i dus su 1788 lo dang 1791 lo so sor gor khas bod du btsan 'dzul byas te gzhis rtse'i nub ngos dgra lag tu shor mtshams/ gongam chan lung gis snga rting gis dmag dpung btang gnang ba dang / lhag par 1792 lor dmag dpon chen po spu khang an dang dmag mi chig khri bdun stong bod du 'byor nas dgra la phar rgol byas pas rgyal kha blangs te gor dmag rnams ka ta man tu bar du ded gor rgyal nas dgongs dag 4dang 'dum sgrig zhus slad sa mtsham la mi rgol ba dang lo lnga mtshams legs skyes 'bul rgyu'i dam bca' zhus te dngos po stos chen dang bca sku tshab mi sna che mngags pe cing du sku bcar zhus chu glang 1793 lo dmag dpon chenapo spru khang an sogs kyis gor dmag khrid mkhan gyi nyes can zhwa — dmar spul sku'i yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu mi chog pa dang rgyu dngos gzhung — bzhes thog yang can dgon pa'i chos lugs bsgyur 'brum pa hu thog thus gor dmag la phar rgol ma byas stabs pe cing du khrid nas khrim la sbyar ba sogs mdzad dmag dpon chen po spu khang an gyis bod kyi gnas tshul rnyoga'adzing che ba dang phyi nang gi zing cha mang ba/ las don mtha' dag tā la'i bla ma dang / am ban thun mong nas thag gcod dgos zer gtan—'bebs byas yod rung am ban rnams bod la sdod yun thung ba dang la la rgyu 21

/rdo// /re// lha/rdo/ 1/// / /༈ /byen //rdo/ /bye/da sa dang sha chang bud da gas la ma ma ra bsdad pa gas ba naming tsam du gyur/ gnas tshul der brten dmag dpon chen po glu khang an sogs nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang bka' shag paṇa chen rin po che'i dza sag sogs la gros mol zab nan gnangathog bod kyi las don byed phyogs skor rtsa 'dzin don tshan nyer dgu gtan 'bebs gnang rtsa 'dzin 'di'i nang / 1 7 la'i bla ma dang hu thog thu'i yang srid gtan 'khel byed skabs gser bum dgug dgos pa'i skor dang / 2 am ban dang tā la'i bla ma paṇa chen rin po che bcas go gnas 'dra nyams yin pa dang dpon rigs che 'bring chung gsum nas am ban la brtsi bkur zhu dgos pa/ 3 bod kyi dpon rigs mtha' dag bsko bzhag dang gnas spar gnas dbyung sogs kyi byed phyogs skor/ 4 bod sa gnas kyi dmag gi sgrig gzhi skor dang rgyun 'jags dmag sum stong 'dzugs pa dmag dpon che gras mi phal pas kyang byed chog pa'i skor/ 5 bod dngul ṭam dkar lhad mang bas chan lung sbo gtsang zhes pa'i ṭam dkar gsar pa lhad med cig bzos rgyab ngos su bod yig bkod yod (rgan rabs rnams nas glog phyogs nor te gtsang chen sbo lung zhes ma dag rgyun 'byams kyi ming de chags ) 6 bod kyi nor srid dang dpya khral khral 'ul lam lugs skor/ 7 dgon pa khas gi mkhan po bsko bzhag byed phyogs dang dgon pa'i bdag gnyer skor/ 8 khral chagadang bun rnying chag yang btang ste thon skyed tho/nga 'phel gtong phyogs skor/9 khrims lugs skor 10 phyi phyogs tshong 'brel dang phyi 'brel mtha' 22

mtshams sa srung bcas kyi skor sogs yod mdor na don tshan nyer dgu pa'i nang bod kyi las don che khag gtan 'bebs zhib gsal gnang ba des mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams sra brtan dang bod kyi chab srid lam lugs 'thus sgo tshang ba thon skyed gong du 'phel ba/ chab 'bangs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas 'gro ba bcas la phan nus ha cang chen po thon thub pa byung yod/ tā la'i sku phreng brgyad pas don tshan nyer dgu der gling thag pa nas gong bkur 4gnang zhing khong gis spu khang an la zhus don dbus gtsang gi bya ba tham cad la gong ma chen pos thugs ca zing por ma 'dzems par khrims lugs bzo bkod mdzad bas mi rabs nas mi rabs bar yun du gnas yod/bdag dang bod kyi ser skya mi ser tshang mas bka' 'drin snying bcang byed pa—las rgyab 'gal spu tsam yang byed mi phod 7sogs gsung yod pa red/ 'di skor bod kyi bya ba mtha' dag am ban la snyan sgron thog thag gecod dgos/ am ban rnabaganyis rtse la phebs skabs tā la'i bla ma ltag sgo'i rgyab tu phebs bsur bcar dgos pa dang / srid skyong dang sa dbang sogs rang nyid kyi go gnas la gzhigs te ri gsham bar rim bzhin 'gro dgos pa/gong ma'i bka' sgrog sbyong byed skabs tā la'i bla ma mchog phying dmar zhig githog zhabs pus btsugs te bzhugs dgos pa'i lam srol yang yod pa red/1stu// //ji/ /jig/ /byere ///rdo /sgro// /rdo// //mi sa tā la sku bheng dgu pa lung gas rgya ma dgung bcu ga ga las ma bzhugs pa 'das pa dang / bcu pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho dgung lo nyer gnyis las bzhugs med pa bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho dgung lo bco brgyad las bzhugs med pa bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho dgung 23

lo nyi shu las bzhugs med pa 'di rnams mang che ba srid dbang bzhes longs ma byung bar sku tshe ma zin pa red/ 'di'i ring ching gong ma ca ching gong ma ca ching dang / ho kong gong ma shan spung gong ma/ thung kri gong ma bcas kyis bka' don bzhin sngar srol yang srid cad gcod khrir bkod dang / 'das 'jug sogs kyi bya ba rnams bsgrubasade'i ring srid skyong de mo hu thog tu dang dga' ldan khri zur tshe smon gling / rwa sgring hu thog hu bcas kyis srid skyong dang / paṇa chen sku phreng bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi ma rin po che mchog nas kyang lo gcig ma zin tsam srid skyong yod/ 'di kun yang gong ma so sos bsko bzhag rtsal nas dam phrug gnang yod/ dper na yong 'dzin de mo blo bzang thub bstan 'jig med rgya mtsho la gong ma chen po ca chin nas er ti ni no man han gyi cho lo dang / srid skyong rim pa'i dngul tham chen mo sku gong ma'i rgya dam gling drug ma 'bru don du ‘‘gong ma'i lung gis zhwa ser bstan pa 'dzin byed dpal ldan no min han gyi tham ga bkris dge'o ’ zhes 'khod pa lta bu rtsal yod la de bzhin sel dam dang rtag dam gnang yon pa yin/ dus skabs de'i nang phyi nas seng pas nang 'dzul byung bas der zlog dmag las cung zad byung yod pa dang / bal pos slar yang brnyad skos pa'i gnas tshul phran tsam byung yod/ ching gong ma zhan sprung dang to kong nas bzung gong ma'i srid gzhung nyams gud kyi gnas su lhung pas sangs rgyas rang mgo mi thon dus shi po'i yar 'dren zer ba'i dpe ltar gyur yod/ 'on kyang nang khul du bod sdod am ban na rim gyis sngon bzhin bya ba sgrub kyi yod la tshe gling rgyal thog gnyis pa ngag dbang 24

'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang am ban ma mthun stabs gong ma'i bka' bzhin tshe smon gling srid skyong gi go sa phabs pa dang rgyu nor gzhung bzhes kyis mes rgyal nang sar btang ba'i gnas tshul byung yod pa dang / rwa sgreng ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgya mtsho rgyal tshab srid 'gan thengs gnyis pa bzhes skabs bka' blon bshad sgra dbang phyug rgyal po sogs sku drag kha shas dang 'gal ba byung nas de tshos lkog jus byas te 'bras spung rig gra'i gtong sgo chad par snyad nas bod dmag dang 'bras dga'i grwa pas srid skyong gi gzims shag la 'ur bsasrid skyong mtshan mos dam phrug khyer nas shar rgyag gong ma'i sku mdun rgyal sa pe cing du bde sdug zhu bar phebs pa'i gnas tshul sogs byung yod pa red tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho yang 1877 lo ngos 'dzin zhus nas dbus tshal gung thang du phebs skabs sngar srol ltar bod bzhugs am ban rnams gnyis phebs nyi 'od du yang srid rin po che zhal shar du gzigs su bzhugs/ sku rgyab tu rgyal tshab rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang yong 'dzin gzhon pa phur lcog rin po che sogs dpon rigs rnams pus mo btsug ste bzhugs gnam skos gong ma kong zhus rtsal ba'i gser bum dkrug mi dgos par tā la'i yong srid du ngos 'dzin chog pa yin zhes pa'i bka' yig de amaban gyis sgroṇa sbyong mdzad de 'phral yong srid rin po ches zhal shar du gziḍate phyag dgu phrug phul rjes zhangs sor 'khod/ am ban rnams gnyis nas yang srid la mjal dar phul am ban rnams gnyis la tshur mjar dar a she re dang ja 'bras sku brnyan snam bu sogs gnang skyes gya nam pa phul sa stag 25

1878lor rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho gser khri mnga' gsol chog pa zhes bod bzhugs am ban rgyud 'jam dbyangs gong ma kod zhur gser snyan sgron pas sa yos 1879lor bka' phyir phebs su 6 tā la'i bla ma'i skye spul rin po che gtan 'khel zin te 'de lo'i zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin mnga' gsol byed rgyu sogs shin tu nas bkris pa'i don bzang po song gshis ngos kyang dga' spro lhag par thob cing tā la'i bla ma'i mchog sprul la gnang skyes su kha btag ser po gcig sku brnyan gcig bzlas phreng gcig rdo dril cha tshang bcas rtsal yod phyogs mtshungs tā la'i bla ma sku gong mar rtsal thob byung ba'i gser gyi tham ga de bzhin tā la'i bla ma gser khrir 'khod skabs thugs rje zhu yig thog phab 'thus dang / 'argyags byamashing rta sga 'bol srab mda' phu ral kha dog ser po yang sngar lam bed spyod bgyis 'thus yab kun dga' rin chen la gung gi cho lo dang bka' yig nor bu'i tog rma bya'i sgro mdangs bcas gsol ras yod pas dga' bar gyis zhes phebs yod/ de rjes dngos gzhi khri 'don gyi 'dzad sgo'i skabs gong ma chen pos rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshor gser khri mnga' gsolagyi gzengs bstod gser yig mkhan drug bgres pas skad gsang mthon posasnyan sgron zhus zin pa dang rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshos zhal shar du gzigs bzhin sku phyag dgu phrug phul de nas am ban gyis gong mas legs 'bul gnang ba rnams rim bzhin phul thub bstan rgya mtsho dgung lo nyi shu bar demo ho thog thus srid skyong gnang shing lug 1895 lor sngar srol ltar spa yer mkhan po btang ste rgyal bas srid dbang bzhes rgyu la 'jam dbyangs 26

gong ma kong zhu mchog la gser snyan sgron lo de'i zla drug pa'i tshes 1 1 nyinagong ma chen ngo/'i gser yig phyir phebs tā la'i bla ma nas zla ba dang po'i tshes gnyis nyin thugs rdzogs zin pa 'di dag bkris dge ltas lhag par che bas ngos kyang yid spro dpag med bskyed cing da nas bzung tā la'i bla mas chos spyod slob gnyer la hur brtson gang ches zhwa ser gyi bstan pa rgya khyab 'phel rgyas dgos la da lam tā la'i bla mar bka' drin 'phar ma'i gsol ras su byu ru'i bzlas phreng gcig gser skud las sgrub pa'i shub bcas yol go gcig g.yang ṭi dkar po'i yol go gcig rgya phug che ba gcig chung ba gnyis bcas rtsal rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos dgyes pa'i ngang tshul ston bzhin phyag dgu phrug brkyang rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos bod sa gnas kyi srid 'gan yun ring bzhes pa'i ring / dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas sngar bas bod la snga rting gis btsan 'dzul dang 'jam bslu sbrag ma byed de bod 'di mes rgyal nas kha 'phral te kho pa'i mi ser spel yul du sgyur rtsis bcangs/ o ru su yi kyang go skabs bstun nas bod kha lo sgyur rtsan 'chang ba/ ching gong ma'i srid dbang ni rlung dkyil gyi mar me dang mtshungs pas bod kyi phyi nang bya ba gang spyir bkod jus gtong ba'i nus pa je ngan je sdug tu gyur ba ma zad mi rigs gnya' gnon gyi srid jus lag len bstar ba/ bod kyi dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul du btsan rgyal ring lugs la dga' nye rten mkhan nyung shas thon pa dang / de tsho'i bar 'thab rtsod rno ngar dza drag gi gnas su yod pa bcas kyi gnas tshul 'og snga rting gi phyi sog dang rgyal sa pe cing rgya gar bcas la phebs pa dang / krung dbyang 27

dang bod sa gnas bar gyi 'brel ba yang dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis dbyin sbyor dkrug shing byas pa'i dbang gis 1 91 1 lo'i skor skabs shig ring rgyun ldan min pa'i gnas tshul thon yod rung / bod 'di mes rgyal dang kha bral nas rang btsan byas pa'i don dngos byung myong med pa red/lcags phag lo'i gsar brje langs pa de rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs rnams la cha bzhag na bkra shis pa'i don chen zhig yin rung bod kyi mi dmangs la god chags tshabs chen 'khel ba red/ dbyin go btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis ngan slob byas pa'i 'og gong rim la bral pas mes rgyal la rgyab kyis phyogs nas ching rgyal rabs kyi bod bzhugs lan am ban phyir 'bud btang ba dang / ma zad bod rigs nang nas byas rjes dang snyan grags yod pa'i rgyal gces pa 'ga' zhig skabs dang bstun nas bsad pa dang skabs der dbyin gor dga' ba'i phyogs khag la ngo rgol byed mkhan paṇa chen er ti ni sku phreng dgu pa mes rgyal nang khul du ma bros ka med byung ba dang bod mi dmangs kyi ngo rgol la ma ltos par dbyin btsan gyis ngan skul 'og mes bod kha bral gyi lkog gshom bya ngan kha shas spel yod pa red/ sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku tshe'i smad du krung hwa rgyal dmangs srid gzhung skabs nan cing la mi sna ched btang gis go yin rta hud nang zhugs pa dang / don gcod las khungs btsugs rma sogs mdzad nas krung dbyang srid gzhung la nye bar btud nas dbyin jir yi mi rang ba mdzad pa'i mur dgung lo nga brgyad rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu bya 1933 lor nor gling du sku gshegs pa red/ skabs 'dir krung hwa rgyal dmangs srid 28

gzhung gis dpon rigs hon mu sung tā la'i bcu gsum pa sku gshegs para'adas mjuḍa soḍa byed par bod du btang gnang gis 1934 lor bod 'byor gyis bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bsu ba zab rgyas zhus pho brang po tālar mdzad sgo gzab rgyas tshogs tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho la smyo‘hu'ugo hwang hwa phu tshe yon jam tā tre rgyal skyong bstan rgyas kun byam byang chub slob dpon chen po zhes pa'i rjes snon cho lo dang g.yang ṭi'i 'ja' sa dam kha gnang gser gdung dge legs 'dod 'jo bzheng par zhal 'debs kyang gad legs phul ba sogs byas yod/ shing khyi 1934 lor drung rtsis tshogs 'du chen mo'i mol sdur dang 'brel go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la gser snyan sgron pa ltar ra sgreng 'jam dpal ye shes srid skyong dang glang 'dun kun dga' dbang phyug las rogs su bsko bzhag byung / ra sgrong 'jam dpal ye shes mes rgyal la blo sems dkar pas dbyin ji btsanargyal ring lugs dang nang khul kha bral pas sdang gzugs 'dzin gyi yod pa red rgyal tshab rwa sgrong nas tā la'i sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho.a mdo sku 'bum shar smad stag 'tsher bltam pa'i byis pa lha mo don grub dengos 'dzin mdzad mtsho sngon zhing chen srid gzhung la gdan 'dren chog pa'i re ba zhus kyang rma pu'u wang nas mos mthun ma byas stabs krung dbyang srid gzhung la snyan seng zhus go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis zi ling gi kru'i zhi rma pu'u wang la tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid bod la phebs skyel zhu dgos pa'i bka' phabs pa dang / gron dngul sgor khri bcu tsam gnang yod yang srid dang / yab yum sku 'khor bcas rma pu'u wang gi sku tshab 29

hro krang rma lon hang dang pu'u thon krang sogs rta dmag brgya phrag kha shas phebs rogs su btang yod lcags 'brug 1940 lo po tā lar khri 'don mdzad dus go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis tā la'i bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho khri bzhugs mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong byed ched bod sog u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang 'u krung shing hin rdu rgyud lha sar mngags btang mdzad khri 'don skabs gdan thob kyi skor la rtsod gleng byung bar 'u u yon krang gis bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs bsnyon med yin pa'i rtsa don rgyun 'khyongs mtha' gcig tu gnang thog krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bka' ltar khri 'don gyi mdzad sgo'i gartsa skyong gnang / ra sgreng 'jam dpal ye shes la tsa h+phu go hung ho hran zhes pa'i cho lo gnang / ra sgreng gis srid skyong ring dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang rjes 'bras kha bral nyung shas kyis 'khon 'dzin chen pos thabs rnam mang pos mthar lcags sprul zla ba dang po'i nang ra sgreng gnas skabs dgongs zhus kyis stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab srid skyong gi khrir 'khod stag brag khrir 'khod ma thag dbyin ji'i rjes 'brang pa zur khang sogs la bka' blon byas stabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid dbang dbyin ji'i rjes 'brangs pa'i lag tu lhung mes rgyal la rgyab gtod kyi spyod ngan ji snyed spel 1947 lo slar yang ra sgreng rgyal zur bkrongs pa'i gnas tshul bzos zhwa sgab pa soḍa tshong don mthun tshogs la khagayar nas phyi rgyal la phyin te me dbyin bcas dang ngan 'brel byas te bod rang btsan yong bar rgyal phyi'i rgyab skyor thob re byas rung 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag la 'gro ba'i bod rang gi lag dngul dang lag khyer gyis go ma 30

zhugs par dka' ngal 'khrad mus stong log byed dgos byung ba dang de rjes kha bral pas lha sar rgya mi phyir phud kyi don dag bzos pa sogs bya ngan yod rgu byas/ sa glang 1949 lo krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig nyin ma'o tse tung mchog gis gnam sde sgo mo'i yang steng nas krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dngos su dbu brnyes pa'i khyab bsgrags gnang mtha' yas dgung sngon dbyings su skar lnga'i dar dmar lhab lhub du g.yos mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyis dga' spro'i skad gsang 'brug sgra ltar bsgrags mes rgyal mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs rnam yangs shing rgya che ba dang bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje'i bgrod lam thog gom stabs chen pos mdun skyod byed bzhin gnas pa'i bod ljongs sa mtho'i thog gi mi dmangs rnams da dung sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las mi thar par nyin mtshan kun tu bde skyid kyi nyi ma bod ljongs su gang myur mchar rgyu'i re mdod skam pa chu mdod ltar gnas/ tang dang ma'o kru'u zhis mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du bskyod de bod kyi spun zla mi rigs rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las skyobs dgos pa'i bka' phabs pa ltar krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod zhi ba'i thabs lam rgyud bod mi dmangs gang mgyogs bcings 'grol thob ched sdon la dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho dang dkar mdzes dge stag sprul sku gnyis snga rting gis bod la btang gnang bar bod kyi gong rim kha bral pas shes rab rgya mtsho nag chu nas phyir slog btang ba dang dge stag chab mdor yun ring bzhugs dgos byung rjes dbyin nyul pas dug 'das 31

btang ba red/ bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong ba'i 'gog rkyen sel ba dang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan shugs bod nas mthar skrod pa'i ched du lcags stag 1 950 lo ston dus mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod mdzad yod bod kyi gong rim log spyod pas bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod la bkag 'gog byas rung zla 10 pa'i nang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis chab mdor dpung 'jug byed 'go btsugs te bod dmag gi gtso shugs dang / yul dmag lnga stong bdun brgya sum cu so brgyad tsam rtsa gtor btang nas chab mdo bcings 'grol btang / ta dang mda' dpon sde dge skal bzang dbang 'dus kyis 'os langs byas/ stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab kyis lo bcu skor ring bod sa gnas kyi srid skyong byas ring dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa sogs kyi ngan skul ltar gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis rgyal gces kyi stobs shugs la rdung brdegs btang ba dang / mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byas pa'i bya ba ngan pa ji rnyed brtsam pa rgya che'i mi dmangs rnam la brdabs gsigs dang mnar gcod tshadamed btang ba sogs la brten/ bod kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor rig gnas mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba sogs dgun gyi me tog ltar nyam gud kyi gnas su lhung 1 950 lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad nyin stag brag dgongs zhus kyis tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos srid 'gan bzhes gro mor skyod rjes rgyal gces stobs shugs la rgyal kha byung nas krung dbyang la zhi gros byed rgyu thag bcad/ krung dbyang gis bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor la gros mol byed dgos pa'i bka' phabs pa ltar lcags 32

yos 1951 lor zla ba gnyis par bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bkarna blonang phod ngag dbang 'jigs med gtsos mi lnga dbang cha tshang yod pa'i sku tshab tu bsko bzhag gis zla ba bzhi par pe cing du 'byor ba dang krung dbyangami dmangs srid gzhung gis dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi rlis 'u han gtsos 'gan 'khur pa lnga dang gros mol gyis 1951 lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyer gsum nyin be cing ching kun pho brang du krung dbyang mi dmangs sridagazhung dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi rnams nas zhi ba'i bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa'i mdzad sgo tshugs/bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun de ni chu 'go bzang na chu rgyun ring ba'i dpe ltar bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs kha bral thabs med pa'i 'brel ba'i rmang gzhi brtan po der lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim gsar pa'i 'byung nges kyi 'bras bzang thob pa zhig yin gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung bar gyi 'brel ba'i skor gtan 'bebs gsal po gnangab ma zad/ bod sa gnas nang khul gyi lo rgyus gnad don khag la'ang thagagacod yang dag pa byung ba sogs la brten tā la'i bla ma dang ser skya dpon rigs yongs nas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis brtsi bkur zhus tang krung dbyang gis yang dag pa'i dbu khrid 'og spun zla mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra ba'i mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi khe dbang longs su spyod thub pa byung ba dang /bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i nyi 'od de shar ri'i phrag pa'i rtse nas shar te 33

bsil ljongs gangs cam rwa bar 'phros ba bcas yin no/ 1642 lo nas 1 959 bar dga' ldan pho brang pa'i sa gnas srid dbang lo sum brgya bcu bdun tsam bzung yod/gong gsal yon gong mas bod sil bu kha 'thor de gcig gyur gyis dpal ldan sa skya pa la sa gnas kyi srid dbang bzung rgyu'i lung las gnang ba nas da bar mi lo 700 lhag tsam ring bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bsnyon med ce ga yin pa gsal po yod do/ bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs grub mtha'ami 'dra ba tshang mas krung go'i rgyas rabs rim byung gi gong ma rnam yon bdag chen por bkur gyi yod pa red/ rgyal rabs rim byung gi gong ma rnam dang / bod sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grub mtha' mi 'dra ba rnams bar gyi 'brel ba ni mchod gnas dang yon bdag bar gyi 'brel ba lta bu yang mtshon pa dper na gong ma yon hri tsung hu pi li dang / sa skya 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i dus nas bzung rgyal rabs rim byung gi gong ma tshang ma sangs rgyas chos la dad bkur byed mkhan sha stag yin cing / kho tshos bod ljongs dgon sde khag la gser dngul 'bor chen btang nas mang 'gyed byed kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang mes rgyal gyi krung dbyang bar gyi 'brel ba ni mchod yon gyi 'brel ba min pa gcig khongs gcig gtogs kyi 'brel ba cig red/ dper na sa skya bdag chen dang / khag gru'i sde srid khag nas bzung dang / lhag par tāla'i rim byung tshang ma ngos 'dzin dang / khri 'don 'ja' sa she bam/ srid kyi sgrig gzhi dbang tshad mnga' khongs bzhag na zhabs ra/ 'ju na lung 34

thag zer ba'i dpe ltar srid kyi steg khri mtha' dag mes rgyal krung dbyang srid gzhung gis gnang ba dang / gtan la phabs pa sha stag yin pa ni rtsod thabs bral ba'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos zhe gcig yin pas mi sus kyang g.yo bcos byed thub thabs med pa zhig yin no// //yig cha 'di sgrig gzhi'i khungs gtug lo rgyus yig cha ni bod yig gilo rgyus yig cha sna kha drug cu dang rgya yig gi dpyad gzhi'i pi ga cha mi 'dra ba bcu drug las grub pa'i 〈〈deb ther kun gsal me long 〉〉〈〈tā la'i bla ma'i rnam thar 〉〉〈〈ya han krang gis rgya bod lo rgyus deb ther ram dpyad gzhi'i yig cha bdun cu don lnga la ltas te brtsams pa 〉〉bdag rang 1962lo lha sar las byed slob grwar slob sbyong skabs 〈〈mes bod 'brel ba'i lo rgyusaslob khrid zin bris 〉〉bcas yin/35

hor tsho pa so dgu'i snga phyi'i chab srid kyi rnam pa lam tsam/bkra ba/hor tsho so dgu ni bod ljongs kyi cha shas chung ngu zhig yin pa der bod mi rigs thu ca/ mong gi khyad chos ldan pa'i lo rgyus yod la dmigs bsalagyi khyad chos kyang ldan yod/ dus yun ring po'i nang bod rigs mi dmangs kyis rang re'i rlabs chen mes rgyal gong 'phel gtong ba'i 'dzugs skrun nang spun zla mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra ba'i byas rjes bzhag yod/ lhag par bod rgya mi rigs bar khyim gcig ltar mdza' bshes kyi 'brel ba btsuḍapa dang / dpal 'byor dang rig gnas spel res/ phyi nas yong ba'i btsan 'dzul par thun mong thog kha gtad bcog pa sogs kyi nang dpa' bo'i mi rigs kyi rang rtags ji snyed bstan yod pa de ni thun mong gi khyad chos ches gsal ba zhig yin cing / dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos ni srid 'dzin dbye mtshams kyi thad la yod pa des mi rnams kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs la shugs rkyen che tsam thebs yod/yon dang ming gong ma'i skabs su hor tsho so dgu 'di bzhin mtsho sngon wang gi khongs su gtogs pa dang / mong gol sbyor khang gi thad kur do dam byed pa'i sa khul yin zhing / de rjes man ju gong ma'i rgyal rabs skabs si khron zhing chen gyi khongs su gtogs te bod sdod gong ma'i blon 36

chen am ban gyis thad ka'i skyong khongs yin pas de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang 'brel ba de tsam med/ hor tsho ni thag ring khug kyog tu gnas pa zhig yin stabs gnya' gnon bshu gzhog myong tshad de tsam chen po min gshis/ rgya rigs dbang sgyur gral rim la 'khon 'dzin de tsam byed kyi med/ btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod kyi mtho rim kha bral ring lugs pa nyung shas la ngan skul gyis mes bod kha bral gtong rgyu'i bya spyod spel rkyen mes bod dbar gyi 'brel ba thag je ring du song khar bod nang khul gyi mthun sgril la'ang tshabs che'i gnod 'gal byung zhing / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol ma btang bar gyi lo sum cu so brgyad yas mas ring hor tshoso dgu 'di bzhin bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang sgyur khongs su gnas pa de'i ring hor tsho'i mi dmangs kyi dpal 'byor gyi 'khur po dang chab srid kyi gnon shugs lo re bzhin je cher song bar brten sa khul mang che ba'i mi ser ha lam stong la khad du gyur pa red/ yin na'ang skabs de'i mi rnams kyis mes rgyal dang rgyang thag ring du song ba de gnas skabs kyi snang tshul zhig yin la mes bod 'brel ba slar gso dang 'brel bod sdod gong ma'i sku tshab rgya rigs mi sna bod du phebs nges yin pa'i yid ches brtan po byed kyi yod pa red/ rgan rabs rnams kyis gzhon nu'i mi rabs la rang nyid kyi mes rgyal ni krung go yin pa dang / rgya bod mi rigs bar spun zla'i 'brel ba yod lugs sogs kyi lo rgyus drangs nas rgyal gces kyi slob gso gtong gi yod pa dang / hor tsho'i mtho rim mi sna tshos kyang gong ma'i dus kyi blon chen tshos stsal ba'i thob thang 'ja' pa bka' gtan 37

/sdusgo shārtse/ 1)sdi /je/ /spri/ /ste/ /bye) //mi //// ga ngas rnams ga da yul da na'ang phugs ga sa ra la brtsis nas nyar tshags byed kyi yod pa red/1949 (sa glang )lo'i zla 10par krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes rjes de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis rgyal yongs su khyab bzhin pa'i mi dmangs gsar brje'i bya gzhag gi rngam brjid ma bzod par bod ljongs 'di bzhin mes rgyal dang rbad de kha bral gtong rgyu'i rmi la ma rmis te mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du yong rgyur bkag 'gog byed ched bod dmag mda' khag lnga drug tsam hor tsho'i sa khul smad dubazhag nas sa srung byed du bcug pa dang chabs cig hor tsho'i 'go dmangs kyis 'os langs byed par dogs zon dang bkag sdom dgos pa'i bkod khyab byas shing / skabs der bod dmag tshos dgon pa dang mang tshogs kyi rgyu nor 'phrog pa dang / mi la nyes rdung gtong ba/ mi gsod me rgyagadagon nang dmag mi bca' sdod kyis bud med bsten pa sogs lha chos dang mi spyod gang la'ang mi mthun pa'i gtor bshig gi spyod ngan ci rigs spel ba dper na/ bod dmag rnams bros dgos pa'i skabs su spyod rgyu'i dmag rta dmag khal bsdus te rgyun nyar byed pa/ grong drag mda' khag gnyis pas 'brog shog khongs klu phug dgon gyi bkag rgya'i ri dwags bsad pa/dgon nang dpung 'jug gis rgyu dngos bcom 'phrog dang grwa par khrims gcod/ lha ri dgon pa'i rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin la gri btsug pa'i rkyen gyis shi ba/ khul de'i mang tshogs khrod kyi lo na brgyad cur sleb pa'i rgan mo zhig kyang bsad pa red/ skabs der mang tshogs kyi38

zur za'i gzhas tshig cig brtsams pa te ‘‘grong drag drag dang ma drag brgyad cu'i rgan mo bsad song / srung ma btsan dang ma btsan dge rgan ka li bkog song zhes dang / de min sa khul gzhan dag la'ang de dang 'dra ba'i gnas tshul mang po byung bar brten sa khul khag gi rgyal gces stobs shugs kyis kho pa tshor mdung rtse kha sprod kyi 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod/ dperan/ ye tha'i lding dpon rnam lhas grong drag dmag mi bsad pa dang / demin gzhan dag gis kyang bod dmag la kha gtad bcag ste phan tshum gsod res byas pa/ lag 'dzing byas pa/ bod dmag gi bkod 'doms la ma nyan par bros byol 'gro ba sogs dngos shugs gang thad nas ngo rgol byed mkhan mang po byung ba ma zad/ khyung po steng chen dang ser tsha bas bod dmag la mtshan mor me mda' mang po 'phangs te phyir skrod btang ba sogasabyas yod/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dmag don la shugs snon rgyag ched hor tsho so dgu'i yul dmag rnams bcos sgrig gis 'brog shog dpon la mda' tshab dang / de min shog khag kha shas kyi 'go gtsor ru dpon dang brgya dpon bskos te tsho dmag gi dmag sgar de bod dmag gi ka tho'i khongs su btsud nas matsa dang ’’zhes btags thog bod dmag dang mnyam du sa srung 'gan 'khri'i bkod sgrig byas kyang khong tshos las 'gan sgrub rgyu lta zhog de las ldog ste bod dmag dang 'dzing res kho na byed kyi yod stabs khul der sdod pa'i bod dmag gi 'go pa rnams dogayopa za nas tsho dmag rnams rang khongs so sor phyir slog mi byed ka med byung zhing /skabs der hor tsho'i 'go dmangs rnams kyis mi dmangs bcings 'grol 39

dmag bod du ga dus 'byor yong ngam snyam pa'i skom pa chu 'dod lta bu'i re sgug byed kyi yod la spun zla'i zhing chen gyi sa khul du lta nyul byed mkhan yangamang po btang ba dang / 'go pa kha shas kyis bcings 'grol dmag spun zla'i zhing chen 'ga' shas su 'byor skabs 'phral du bod phebs thub pa'i re'abod snyan zhu byed mkhan gyi bang mi btang ba red/ 'on kyang 'go pa ches nyung shas bcings 'grol gtong bar blogs pa yod pa smos ci dgos/gong gsal gnas tshul gyi thog nas btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod du 'drelag brkyangs yod pas bod nang khul du kha bral ring lugs dang rgyal gces ring lugs bar sne mang 'dres 'dzings kyi 'thab rtsod gnas pa gsal por mtshon thub/mes rgyal skam sa chen po gcig gyur yong ba dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan shugs bod nas mthar sgod gtong ba/ bod mi dmangs rnams bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog gi gnas las grol ched krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i dbu khrid 'og mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod ljongs su rim bskyod kyis dang thog mdo smad mnga' khul drag po'i bcings 'grol btang ba des rgyal khab phyi nang gi log spyod stobs shugs la rdung rdeg tsha nan 'khel ba dang / yar thon gyi stobs shugs la rgyab skyor shugs chen byung bar brten tang dang ma'o kru'u zhi mchog gi mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i dgongs 'dun 'thab jus la brda lan zhus don krung dbyang mi dmangs sridagazhung dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis 1951(lcags yos )40

lo'i zla 5tshes 23nyin bod zhi bas bcings 'grol yong thabs skor gyi grosamathun don tshan bcu bdun 'jog thub pa byung zhing / de ni bod mi dmangs dang rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi rtsa ba'i khe phan dang mthun stabs tshang mas snying thag pa nas yi rangs gong bkur zhus pa red/ skabs der hor tsho'i 'go dmangs rnams kyi dga' ba'i 'phrin bzang de dag thos pa tsam gyis spro ba 'phel nas yig cha 'byor 'phral slob sbyong byed pa dang / yig cha ma 'dang ba dag lag bshus byas te nyar tshags byed kyi yod pa red/krung gung krung dbyang gi bka' ltar krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod mi dmangs kyi don du khres po 'khur nas la rgyab chu brgal gyis dka' ngal dang nyen khar ma mdzems par dpa' ngar zhum med kyi gsar brje'i snying stobs ldan pa'i sgo nas bod du bskyod skabs mang tshogs kyi sa nas khab skud tsam yang mi len pa dang / nyo tshong drang bzhagagayar dngos phyir sprod/ chag pa'am bor ba'i dngos por skyin tshab 'jal ba/ mi la nyes rdung dang gshe gshe mi gtong ba/ tshang mar 'dra mnyam dang mdza' mthun gyi spyod tshul bzung ba/ dgon bdag dang grong bdag gi mos mthun med par gang byung nang du mi 'gro ba sogs bya spyod tshang ma srid jus kyi rang bzhin dang sgrig khrims kyi rang bzhin ches cher ldan la/blo gcig sems gcig gi bod mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i lhag bsam dag cing / mang tshogs kyi dka' ngal gang thub kyis sel rogs byed pa/ dga' sdang gi dbye ba gsal zhing / gzhung drang spyod pa gtsang 41

ba/ dka' ba gzhan gyi sngon la spyod cing / bde ba gzhan gyi rjes su rol ba sogs gung khran ring lugs kyi phugs bsam ldan pa'i gsar brje'i 'thab 'dzing pa'i gzi brjid spyod bzang de 'dra ba mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus thog mthong myong med pa zhig red/ khong tsho'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i mig dpe des nga tsho hor tsho so dgu'i mi dmangs la sems 'gul ha cang chen po thebs te dmag dmangs bar nya chu lta bu'i 'brel ba chags pa ma zad/mig dpe der nga tsho gsar brje pa tshang mas dus rgyun du slob sbyong byed dgos la/ bya spyod dngos kyi tshad gzhir yang 'dzin dgos snyam gyi yod pa red/ nga tsho'i sde dgon gyi 'go dmangs rnams nas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag so so'i sa gnas su 'byor 'phral ja 'dren dar 'bul dang /dga' bsu'i sne len thog sngar gong ma'i skabs kyi lugs ltar rgya mjal dngalba sna dar btags kyi 'bul ba btegs pa/ sngar 'dris kyi mi ltar kha zhe 'dres pa/ sngar srol da gnas gleng ba/ bod mi dmangs kyi bde sdug zhu ba bcas byas yod/ dmigs bsal mjal 'phrad dgos don med pa'i rgan rabs mang po zhig gis kyang ched mngags khong tsho mjal 'dod byas nas mjal dar 'bul bar 'gro ba dang sngar gong ma'i skabs kyi lo rgyus dran gso dang gleng slong byed pa/ bcings 'grol dmag phebs par dga' ba'i mig chu 'dod mkhan yang byung yod pa dper na/ 'bri ru rdzong khongs 'gom dpon gyi yang mes mar mdzangs zer ba lo na ha cang rgas po zhig yod pa de rta la bskyon nas mi gzhan gyis khrid de bcings 'grol dmag gi phogasakhang ang bzhi pa'i wang kreng u zer ba mjal 42

'phrad zhu bar na ba gser gzhong gi sa gnas su phyin te de ring rang gi 'go dpon ngo ma phebs pa red ces brjod pa dang / de snga sa gnas srid gzhung gis nga tsho nag shod tsho drug la brdabs mnar chen po btang lugs sogs bshad de bcings 'grol dmag gi phyag la 'jus te mig chu yang bton pa red/bod du krung go gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og gi srid dbang thengs dang po ste/ mdo smad mnga' khul mi dmangs bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang dngos su dbu brnyes pa ma zad/ de'i khongs steng chen mngags gtong las khungs kyis lcags yos (1951lo'i zla 10 tshes 25 )lor don gcod las khungs ang dang po btsugs nas gsham gsal rdzong khag bcul 'go khrid byed kyi yod pa red/ hor tsho'i sngar yod steng chen dang /ser tsha/ khri rdo/ sbra chen/ 'bri ru/ snyan rong bcas rdzong khag drug gi khar/ de sngon hor tsho'i khongs min pa'i nye mtshams kyi dpal 'bar dang / sa steng / lha ri/ sog bcas la rdzong bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang btsugs pa des de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rdzong dpon srid dbang gi tshab byas shing / rim pa so so'i las khungs de dag nang bcings 'grol dmag gi dmag don sku tshab dang / rgya rigs las byed pas tang gi 'go khrid 'og gnad che'i las kur rogs ram gnang thog rdzong kha shas su bsdad pa'i de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rdzong dpon dang / de min mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi rgyal gces mi sna rnams la rang rang 'os babs kyi chab srid dang 'tsho ba'i bkod sgrig byas te nus 43

par dpag pa'i las 'gan 'khur du bcug cing / rim pa so so'i bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gis rgya che'i mi dmangs la 'go khrid de tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / chos lugs srid jus/ btsan rgol rgyal gces 'thab phyogs gcig gyur sogs 'bril yod srid jus khag nan tan gyis dril bsgrags dang lag bstar byas pa/ lhag par gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun zab nan gyis lag len bstar ba/ bcings 'grol dmag la rgyab skyor rogs ram gyi las po'i 'gan 'khur byas pa/ dmangs don dang nyes don gyi gyod gzhir tang gi srid jus dang mig snga'i gnas tshul zung 'brel gyis thag gcod byas pa/ mang tshogs la zhing 'brog gi yo chas 'grems pa/ zhing 'brog mi dmangs la skyed med dngul bun g.yar ba/ lhag par steng chen dang (/de)sog rdzong / de min dmag sgar bca' sdod byed pa'i sa gnas 'ga' shas bcas la mi phyugs sman khang btsugs te rin med sman bcos byas pa/ rgyal gnyer tshong khang btsugs te ja dang ras cha mngar cha sogs mkho chas 'don sprod byas pa/ bcas mang tshogs kyi ched du las ka mi nyung ba byas pa ma zad/ gnas de ga'i nor srid kyi 'gro gron tshang ma krung dbyang nas gnang gi yod pa red/1951lo nas 1954lo'i bar gzhung lam bzo skrun dngos su ma grub bar de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi tsho khul du yod pa'i lam chen lho byang gnyis kyi rta zam legs sgrig byas te dbor 'dren babs tshuḍa 'ga' shas btsugs thog dmag mkho'i za 'bru dang yo chas sogs gzhan yang bod gsar 'dzugs skrun gyi nyer mkho'i dngos zog rta khal gyi thog 44

nas skyel 'dren byed sgo gang ci'i thad la hor tsho 'go dmangs tshang mas 'phyar ba gru 'degs kyi rgyab skyor dang / khron bod gzhung lam las yuladangos kyi sa khad nye mtshams sho pa mdo sogs la dka' ngal 'dzems med kyis rta khal mi gsum btang nas rgyab skyor byas yod/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis kyang dbor 'dren byas par gun med kyi rdal gla dang tshong zog la drang bzhag gi rin gong sprod kyi yod stabs mang tshogs kyi zhor las yong 'bab 'phar snon byung yod pa red/ chu 'brug (1951)lo nas bzung mes rgyal nang khul du pe cin mi rigs slob grwa dang / khren tu'u mi rigs slob grwa/ zhan yang bod spyi'i slob grwa (bod ljongs mi rigs slob grwa )bcas la hor tsho khul gyi gzhon nu pho mo snga rting gis slob sbyong byed par btang ste bod mi rigs kyi las byed dang / lag rtsal mi sna'i dpung sde gso skyong byed pa'i cha shas su gyur cing / rdzong kha shas la slob grwa chungakhag kyang btsugs yod/ dus mtshungs mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna sgrig 'dzugs byas te mes rgyal nang khul du lta skor thengs bzhi btang zhing / khong tshor krung dbyang gi 'go khrid blo mthun dngos mjal gyis byams brtse'i bka' slob thob pa dang / mes rgyal spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'dzugs skrun dang lo rgyus kyi dngos po/ sngon thon mi rigs kyi nyams myong bcas mngon sum mthong bas khong tsho'i nang nas mi ches mang bar sems 'gul chen po thebs nas tang la dga' zhen dang /mes rgyal la dga' zhen/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam la yid ches che ru phyin yod/ de bzhin mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna rnams kyis las 45

rigs khag gi mang tshogs kyi tshab byas te steng chen dang / sog rdzong /chab mdo/ lha sa bcas la snga rting gis tshogs 'dur thengs kha shas bcar te gong rim gyis sprad pa'i las ka rnams gros bsdur thag gcod dang / zhibacha'i bkod sgrig kyang byas yod pa red/ shing rta (1955)loragong rim nas mang tshogs kyi go rtogs sa da tshad la gzhigs te mdo smad mnga' khul du mi dmangs shog sgor 'grems spel byas par hor tsho'i 'go dmangs kyis rgyal sa/ces ring lugs kyi bca ma blo 'khyer nas dab/'a bsu dang 'breladang len byas pa red/shing lug (1955)lor bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang dngoca/ su dbu brnyes rjes mdo smad mnga' khul spyi khyab don gcod khang dang / rdzong so so'i rdzong don gcod khang rim bzhin btsugs te sa gnas rang skyong gi srid dbang dngos su 'dzugs rgyu'i grwa sgrig byas/ pa dang chabs cig tang krung dbyang gis bod du gong nas 'og bar zhi ba'i gros mol gyi thabs lam la brten nas dmangs gtso dang spyi tshogs bcos sgyur bya rgyu'i mdzad phyogs srid jus khag rgya khyab gting zab ngang dril bgraḍabyas pa/ las don ru khag btang ste dason khag so sor krung dbyang gis stsal ba'i sku 'gyed phul thog tang gi 'brel yod srid jus kyang dril bsgrags byas pa red/ rdzong khag so sor las byed slob grwa dang slob grwa chung ba 'dzuḍargyu'i rmang bzhi bting ba/ mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna mang che ba sngar bzhin rim pa so co/'i las khungs su las 'gan 'khur ba dang / 'ga' shasamakyis mdo sma da spyi khyab don byed khang dang / bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig 46

u yon lhan khang nang las 'gan 'khur gyi yod pa red/ rim pa khag gi rgyal gces bud med mthun grogs tshogs pa dang / rgyal gces gzhon nu shes rig mthun tshogs tshogs pa/ chos don u yon lhan khang bcas kyang rim bzhin btsugs pa red/ 'on kyang bod kyi mtho rim log spyod ru tshogs ches nyung shas shig gis btsan rgyal ring lugs dang / phyi rgyal logaspyod shog kha'i kha la nyan te bod ljongs kyi gsar brje dang 'dzugs skrun byagazhag sogs bod mi dmangs la phan thogs yod pa'i bya ba mtha' dag thabs brgya jus stong gis bkag 'gog byas rkyen tang krung dbyang gis bod du dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur lo drug 'gyang nas kho tsho rmongs gnyid las sad rgyu'i dus tshod sprad de ngang sgug gnang / hor tsho'i rdzong khag bcu la yang gzhan dang 'dra ba'i las khungs khu bsdu dang / slob grwa phyir 'then/rdzong so sor bca' sdod byed bzhin pa'i bcings 'grol dmag gi dmag don sku tshab dang / rgya rigs las byed pa rnams nang sar phyir 'then bya rgyu gtan 'khel ba red/ skabs der mnyam las mnyam sgrub byed mkhan rgyal gces mi sna mang che bas khong tsho dang kha bral rgyur blo pham tshad med byung ste khong tsho mes rgyal nang sar 'then ma dgos pa'i re 'dun nan zhu byas pa dang / 'ga' shas mig chu shor ba sogs 'bral mi phod pa'i brtse dung gi rnam pa mtshon pa byas shing / las khungs khu bsdu tshar rjes steng chen lte ba'i rdzong tang ud dang / don gcod las khungs gnyis kyi thad po'i 'go khrid 'og rdzong khag bcu la de ga'i mtho rim rgyal gces pa nyung shas shig hrag sgrug byas te rdzong bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang so sor 47

rgyun ldan las ka byed du bcug pa phud/ de phyin tang gi 'go khrid pa mnyam 'grogs med pa'i rkyen gyis las don 'thus shor phran bu byung rung sa gnas mang che bas sngar bzhin tang gi srid jus gzhir bzung las ka byas yod/ dper na/ dmangs don dang nyes don gyi gyod gzhir srid jus gzhir bzung thag gcod byas pa dang / gong rim gyis stsal ba'i yig cha mang tshogs la dril bsgrags byas pa/ mang tshogs la rgyal gces ring lugs kyi slob gso brgyab ste ngo log zing 'khrug gi gtam 'chal bkag 'gog byas pa/ nag chab gzhung lam bzo mi bsdu gtong byas pa bcas byas yod/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi bka' phab pa ltar 1959 lo'izla 5par rdzo nga so so'i bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang rnams lo rgyus kyi las 'gan bsgrubs nas phyir 'then byas pa red/ gong gsal lo brgyad kyi nang hor tsho so dgu'i rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs rnams rim gyis go rtoḍa sad 'go 'tshugs te bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin khral 'ul lam lugs la ngo rgol byed pa/ dper na/ 1951lor rdzong dpon ser skya 'ga' zhig sa gnas srid gzhung gis sprad pa'i khral bsdu khrims gnon gyi las 'gan sgrub ma thub par lha sar phyir log bya dgos byung ba dang / de rjes 1954lo dam1957lor yang skyar rdzong dpon thengs gnyis slebs te khral bsdu khrims gnon bya rtsis byas kyang rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis dang len ma byas pa dang /rgyal gces mi sna mang che bas kyang kho pa tsho dang mnyam las mi byed khar mang tshogs kyi re 'dun la rgyab skyor byas pa'i rkyen gyis khul der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi khral 'ul gzhi rtsa'i thog nas rgyugs ma dgos par gyur 48

zhing / tang gis rdzong sdod snga phyi rnams la mnyam ‘pas byed kyi yo da kyang mang tshogs kyis dang len ma byas stabs/ sa gnas srid gzhung gis sprad pa'i las 'gan 'grub ma thub par snga rting du lha sar phyir log byed dgos byung zhing / sa gnas 'ga' shas kyi mtho rim mi sna khag gcig rdzong dponadang phan tshun brten res byed kyi yod stabs rdzong dpon gtan sdod byed thub pa dang / sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'char can khral rigs rnams gzhirtsa'i thog nas bsdu len byed thub rung / mang tshogs kyis khral 'ul 'khur 'dod med stabs chag yang mi gtong ka med byung yod/ 195 lor byang rgyud spyi 'dom pas tsho sdod rdzong khag bzhi la bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bkod 'doms dang len dgos rgyu dang / slar yang khral 'jal khrims 'khuradagos lugs/ byang rigs dang mnyam du nag chur tshogs 'dur zhugs dgos rgyu'i brda khyab btang bar mtho rim pa kha shas tshogs 'dur zhugs yod kyang / rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs dang rgyal gces mi sna mang che ba'i blo la ma babs gshis brda khyab nang don lag len ma thub khar rgyal gces mi sna 'ga' res gong gsal brda khyab dang zhib phra'i gnas tshul rnams steng chen lte ba'i rdzong ud la gong 'bul snyan seng zhus pa red/ brdakhyab de dag sa gnas srid gzhung dngargyun ldan 'brel ba yod pa'i mtho rimapa rnams kyis dang len byas rung mang tshogs kyi re 'dun dang mi mthun pas lag len 'thus tshang bstar thub med/ rgya che'i mi dmangs kyis hor tsho'i nang khul dpon rigs rnams kyi sngar srol nang khral sngar bzhin sgrub 'dod med la mtho rim mi sna rang nyid nas kyang tang gi srid jus dang dus 49

bab la shes rtogs phran tsam byung gshis mang che bas nang khral rnams snga ting gis rtsa chag gam cho yang btang yod/ 'om kyang 'ga' shas nas rang nyid kyi dmigs bsal dbang cha nam yang 'dor 'dod med stabs tang dang mi dmangs dang rgyang thag je ring du song nas mtho rim lob/ spyod ru tshos/sa la rten shu /sa che ru song ba red/ 1957lor mtsho sngon dang zi khron zhing chen khongs kyi zing slong pa rnams hor tsho'i sa khul du 'byor nas gtam 'chal bkram pa dang / zing cha bslangs pas mi mang po'i sems la dwogs skrag byung zhing / hor tsho'i 'go pa kha shas la'ang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis thad kur skul slong byas pa'am ya nga na shugs rkyen 'thebs yod/ lhag par 1958lor mtho rim log spyod ru tshogs kyis rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i chubazhi sgang drug gi zing jag rnams lha ri dang / 'bri ru/ rgya ston/sa steng / dpal 'bar/ steng chen/ sog sbra chen/ snyan rong / be khu gsal sgron sogs la snga rting gis slebs te sa gnas de ga'i 'go dmangs la 'jigs skul bslu brid kyis zing cha slong rgyu'i ngan skulabyas pa dang / byed thub sar rtsa 'dzugs kyang byas pa red/ 'on kyang hor tsho so dgu'i rgya che'i mi dmangs dang rgyal gces mtho rim mi sna mang che bas srog nyen sogs gang la'ang ma 'dzems par sems thag gtsang bcad kyis ngo rgol byas te ma skul rang mos kyis tang ud las khungs dang bca' sdod dmag sgar sar 'brel gtug gis ngo log zing 'khrug mgyogs myur lhing 'jags gtong rgyu'i re 'dun zhus pa dang sprags dgra phyogs kyi gnas tshul snyan seng yang zhus shing / da dung kha shas kyis rang rang sa khul 50

gyi yul dmag bsdus te rang srung byed pa'am/ zing slo nga mkhan la kha gtad kyang bcag pa red/ ngo lob zing 'khrugs pas 'brel yod sa gnas las khungs la bca' sdod byed mkhan rgyal gces mi snar lta log pa dang / rgya mi'i rgyu'i khyi zhes kho pa tsho'i mig nang gi gra ma ltar brtsis te gang thub kyi gnod 'tshe btang ba dper na/ sbra chen ye tha'i 'brog pa dbul phongs spos bdag gi mig ril bton pa dang / sog rdzong skyid 'dzoms kyi bu dang / nag shod 'bri ru bom phan dpon gyi bu spun/ khri rdo rdzong khri ru dpon dbang ldan sogs dmar gsod btang ba/ gser tsha rdzong 'bugayung drung nam mkha'i rgyu nor bcom 'phrog thog brtsigs pa'i mkhar dang bzhengs pa'i rten sogs mer bsregasab sogs rgya che'i mang tshogs dang rgyal gceyomi sna'i lus srog longs spyod 9/ gnod 'tshe tshabs chen btang zhing las khungs kyi mtha' bskor dang / gzhung lam dang zam pa sogs 'dzugs skrun khag la gtor bshig btang ba/ kho pa tshos rgyal gces mi sna dang mang tshogs tshang mar rgya dgang zhu tshur (me mda' bsdus tshar bar zer )dang ngo log pa sogs ming sna tshogs 'dogs pa bcas byas te nam mkhar mi shong pa'i nag nyes bsags yod pa red/bod mi dmangs kyi re 'dun ltar 1959lo nas krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis tang krung dbyang gi bka' brda dang du blangs te dpal 'bar dang / sog steng chen/ be khu gsal sgro na sogs sa gnas so sor yod pa'i ngo log zing 'khrug gi rten gzhi che chung rnams ri ma bzhin rtsa gtor mthar phyin pa btang bas mi dmangs kyi tshe srog dang 51

rgyu nor la srung skyob thob pa red/ skabs der khul de'i rgya che'i mi dmangs dang mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna rnams kyis mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gang du dpung skyod byed pa der g.yas gzhogs g.yon 'degs kyis rta khal mi gsum gyi rgyab skyor dang / dgra phyogs kyi gnas tshul snyan sengazhu ba/ ngo log zing 'khrug pa mgo len rgyu'i chab srid kyi brtson len byasapa sogs rang nus gang yod 'bad brtson byas pa red/ sog rdzong du bca' sdod nag chab gzhung lam bzo skrun khang gi tang kri pu'u nas rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 1959lo'i zla 4par de snga'i bod sa gnas srid / gzhung mi dgos par bzos pa dang / zing 'khrug lhing 'jags/ dmangasagatso bcos sgyur bya rgyu bcas kyi 'brel yod bka' rgya brgyud bsgrags gnang bar ser tsha dang / sbra chen/ sog rdzong bcas kyi rgyal gces mi snakhag gcig gis mang tshogs kyi tshab byas te yi rangs gong bkur zhus pa ma zad/ 'bri ru rdzong phur bu bdud 'dul dang / ser tsha rdzong 'bu g.yung drung nam mkha'/ sog rdzong a mdo yon tan/ sbra chen rdzong bkra ba bcas mi bzhis gong gsal rdzong khag bzhi'i las rigs khag gi mang tshogs kyi tshab byas te nag chab gzhung lam las khungs brgyud bod las don u yon lhan khang la dmangs gtso bcos sgyur 'phral myur yong ba'i re 'dunaglog 'phrin phul ba bcas so /52

'brog ba'i 'tsho ba'i skor/bkra ba /dang bkra shis stobs rgyal/nag chu kron hru'u kung yon sa khul ni bod ljongs kyi byang ngos su gnas pa'i 'brog las sa khul zhig yin cing / 'di'i khongs gtogs rdzong khag dgu dang / don gcod khru'u gnyis yod pa'i nang / shar phyogs rdzong gsum dang / lho phyogs lha ri rdzong bcas par sa zhing phran buyod pas sa ma 'brog gi sa khul yin pa de tsho'i thon skyed dang / 'tsho ba gang thad nas dmigs bsal khyad chos yod pa phud/ de byings tshang ma 'brog las sa khul yin cing / de'ang nub kyi rdzong khag la stod pa zhes zerab dang / shar gyi rdzong khag la smad pa zhes zer ba/ de gnyis kyi bar la thon skyed dang / 'tsho ba/ goms gshis sogs kyi thad la dbye ba gang 'tshams yod/ rdzong khag kha shas byang ngos su 'brog pa'i ru ba sdod stangs nges gtan med pa/ rgyun du spo sdod byed mkhan khag gcig yod/de dag la'ang rang nyid kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos yod pa red/ 'brogalas khe gtsang gi thon skyed dang / 'tsho ba/ 'brel yod goms gshis kyi byed sgo kha shas bcas khag gsum pa dbye nas brjod na/dang bo/ 'brog las thon skyed skor/sa bab dang gnam gshis sogs rang byung khams kyi cha rkyen la brten 53
