nas thon skyed kyi chags tshul grub kyi yod pa dang / thon skyed kyi 'bras bur brten nas 'tsho ba'i spyod stangs thag gcod kyi yod/ spyi tshogs kyi lo rgyus 'phel rgyas dbang gis thon skyed byed stangs dang / 'tsho ba spyod stangs sogs rim bzhin 'gyur ldog 'gro gi yod kyang nga tsho'i sa khul la ma rtsa ring lugs kyi tshong zog thon skyed dar myong med pas/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin rang grub dpal 'byor gyi rnam pa dang ldan yod na'ang bod zhing khul du gzhis ku'i lam lugs chags pa de dag dang mi 'dra bar gdod ma'i dus nas dpa' bos 'go khrid byed pa'i lam lugs nas dus yun ring po'i 'brog las thon skyed kyi nang du 'brog g.yog dang 'brog bdag byung ste gral rim dang / rim gras kyi dbye ba dngos su chags shing /'brog pa rnams thog marwa gnam gshis dro ba'i khul du gzhis chags pa dang / de rnams rim bzhin sa ma 'brog la gyur rjes gnam gshis snyoms pa'i sa khul la 'brog pa'i ru ba chags pa dang / rim gyis gtan sdod byed mkhan gyi 'brog par 'gyur ba/ gnam gshis grang ba'i khul du skabs 'gar sdod mkhan yod pa dang / skabs 'gar sdod mkhan med pa sna tshogs byung mthar 'brog khul gyi dud grangs dang mi grangs rim gyis 'phar ba/ sa gnas de gar yang ru ba sdod stangs nges gtan med pa'i spo sdod kyis 'brog pa rnams gzhi nas chags pa yin tshod 'dug lha ri rdzong dang / sog rdzong / 'bri ru rdzong bcas kyi 'brog las sa khul dang / nag chu rdzong yongs/ sbra chen rdzong dang / snyan rong rdzong /a mdo rdzong / dpal mgon rdzong / shan tsha rdzong bcas kyi lho ngos 54

tshang mar 'brog pa gtan sdod kyi ru ba gzhis chags yin pa dang / sa cha de dag ni rgya khyon chung tsam yin stabs dgun 'tsher sdod sa nges gtan dang / dbyar sa nges gtan/ sa khul 'ga' zhig la da dung ston mtsher sdod sa yang yod pa red/ 'ga' shas ni dpyid dus lu gu khrid skabs 'gro sa tsam las/ dbyar sa gun mal byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ spyir btang stod pa'i sa gnas rnams ni sa spus zhan zhi nga / rtswa bcud chung ba dang / smad pa'i sa gnas rnams sa bab dro la/ rtswa bcud bzang ba/ sa rgya chung ba/ lho phyogasasu gnas pa rnams ni ri mtho ba/ byang phyogs thang rgya che ba bcas yod pa red/ gtan sdod 'brog pa'i sa khul gyi rtswa thang bdag 'dzin dbang cha nismad pa'i sa khul mang che bar cha bzhag na/ khyim dud 'ga' shas sde tshanare byas pa'am/ khyim dud re sde tshan re byas pa'i sger sa'i lam lugs yin mod/ 'on kyang rgya bod sku tshab bam/ phyi nang dpon rigs kyis sprad pa'i sa bkrar brten nas rtswa thang bskyar bgos byed dgos stabs/ rtswa thang gi lte ba'i dbang cha ni mnga' bdag gsum gyi la ga tu yod pa gsal por bstan pa red/ sa khul 'ga' zhig la rang byung gi 'thu rtswa yod pa dang / khyim dud 'ga' zhig gi sbra mkhar gyi 'gram du sger gyis bskor ba'i rtswa rwa chung chung re yang yod pa red/ rtswa thang bed spyod byed stangs thad/ ston dgun dpyid gsum sa cha'i rgya khyon la gzhigs nas phyugs zog 'tsho yul zla re'am/ zla gnyis re/ tha na dus tshigs re byas te khag bgo ba dang / zhib cha snga nyin phyi nyin bcas phyugs 'tsho 55

res bskor lam lugs/ gzhan yang gangs zhod dang / rlung chen sogasaganam gshis kyi 'gyur ldog dbyar dgun ston dpyid dus bzhi'i dbye ba/ nor/ lug ra/ rta sogs rigs mi 'dra ba dang / phyugs che ba dang / phyugs phrug bcas phyugs zog rang nyid kyi khyad chos la brten nas rtswa thang gi bkod sgrig byed pa/ lhag par dgun dpyid be'u'i sa dang /'bri/ ma mo'i khrid rtswa zer ba thag nye sar spus legs pa'i rtswa thang chung ba re yang zur du 'jog dgos kyi yod pa red/ stod dang / bar pa'i sa khul rnams la cha mtshon na/ ma gzhi shog kha re re spyi sa lta bu zhig yin kyang / dpon rigs rnams la stod smad gang du yin rung rtswa thabaka dmiḍa bsal dbang cha'i sger sa yod pa phud/ de byings stod pa'i lho rgyud dang /dkyil rgyud rnams kyi sa khul 'ga' zhig la khyim dud tsho rer sde tshan/re byas pa'i goms gshis kyi dbyar dgun sdod gnas 'khel yod pa dang / 4khul 'ga' zhig ni dbyar dgun gyi ru ba'i skyas spo stangs thog mar mi tshogs sa khul de'i 'go pas bkod sgrig byed kyi yod pa de'ang gtso bo goms gshis la brten dgos pa zhiga'ad/ spra chen rdzong gi sa khulanyung shas dang / snyan rong rdzong / a mdo rdzong / dpal mgon rdzong /shan tsha rdzong / ('om bu dang mtshe'u gnyis tshud )bcas kyi byang ngosakyi sa khul 'ga' shas 'brog pa'i ru baspo sdod sa khul yin cing / de ga'i rtswathang ni shog kha'i spyi sa yin pasadashog khag bar gyi sa mtshabs kyang de tsam —zhib bra med/ spyir sa khul de dgas rgya che la gnam ga shis grang ngadabasgod cing/ de ga'i 'brog pa—rnams dgun dus ri dwagasalhag rgyu'i chedarwa ru 56

ba byang du spo ba dang / dbyar dus sa gnas srid gzhung la khral rgyugs bde'i ched du ru ba lho la spos yong gi yod pa red/ ru mal rer ring shos zla ba gnyis dang gcig thung shos nyin bzhi lnga/ phar tshur gnyis kur spo thengs bcu phrag kha shas dgos kyi yod pa red/ sbra chen dang /snyan rong gi sa khul 'ga' shas ru ba spo yul rgya khyon de tsam med stabs spo thengs nyung ba dang / ru mal rer sdod yun ring ba yod pa red/ sa cha'irgya khyon ni lho rgyud 'brog pa gtan sdod kyi sa khul rnams la deng skabs kyi kung tre re'i sa khyon la cha bzhag na/ shar nub bar dang lho byang bar la khal tshugs gsum nas gcig bar yod pa/ byang ngos 'brog pa spo sdod kyi sa khul la shar nub bar khal tshugs gsum nas gnyis bar yod pa/ lho byang bar khal tshugs nyi shu nas gsum bar bcas yod pa red/ da dung sa khul nyung shas la lam̐ rgyus thog shog khag gcig gi sa bkra'i thog 'khod yod kyang sa der gtan sdod dam bed spyod byed mkhan med par lus te shog kha gzhan zhig gi dud grangs 'phel rgyas song ba'am/ yang na shog kha gsar pa chags te ru sdod rtswa bza' byas na/ de snga'i sa bdag gi shog kha der rtswa bogs sprod dgos pa dang / da dung dpon gyi bdag 'dzin dbang cha'i thog mi ser dud grangs 'phel nas ru sdod rtswa bza' byed cing / rtswa bogs 'jal mkhan yang nyung shas yod pa red/ mdor na/ rtswa thang gi rgya khyon dang / bkod sgrig yag nyes/ bkod sgrig ji bzhin lag bstar thub min bcas kyis 'brog las thon skyed gong 'phel yong min la nus pa ha cang chen po thon gyi yod pa red/57

'brog pa'i thon skyed rgyu chas phyugs zog yin la/ 'tsho ba'i rgyu chas kyang phyugs zog yin/ phyugs khyu'i chags tshul ni sa bab sogs kyi rkyen pas stod pa dang / bar pa/ byang ngos su sdod mkhan bcas ni lug mang ba dang / de 'og 'bri g.yag de 'og ra/ nyung shos rta yin cing / smad pa dang / lho rgyud sdod mkhan rnams ni 'bri g.yag dang lug gnyis mang ba dang / de 'og ra/ nyung shos rta yin cing / khyim dung phyug shos 'ga' shas la drel dang / mdzo yang yod pa/ de yang 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho'i dbang gis pho phyugs nyung zhing / mo phyugs mang ba yod pa red/ phyugs zog gi nang nas rtswa 'gangs che shos 'bri g.yag dang lug la brtsi gi yod kyang gong thang thad la ra gnyis rer lug re dang /lug lnga'am drug rer 'bri g.yag re/ g.yag bzhi'am lnga rer rta re/g.yag gnyis rer mdzo re/ rta dang drel phal cher 'dra bar brtsi srol yod rung / zhib cha sa khul so sor rin thang brtsi tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba yod/gzhan yang thon skyed yo chas chung gras/ 'o ma 'jo sa'i zo ba dang / zho bsnyal sa'i zo ba'am zangs sdig 'o ma dkrog sa'i mdong mo/ bcu byed kyi gzar bu/ phyur khu thag sa'i ko/ 'o ma bkol sa'izangs sdig phyur ba skam sa'i phyar ba/ mar gsog sa'i mar sgam/ phyur ba blug sa'i skye sgro/ phyugs kyi gdang thag khal ma'i sga gdan dang /snod sgro/ phyugs rwa dang / phyugs khebs/ phyugs chag thag 'breng /bar spu 'breg byed kyi gri/ rtswa 'breg byed kyi zor ba sogs rtsag rtsig gang 58

'tshams dgos kyi yod pa red/ sa khul kha shas la gna' bo'i srol rgyun ltar 'o ma dkrog sa'i rkyal pa dang / 'jo sa'i 'brong rwa so /sa kyang yod pa red/ de min da dung mtshan mor phyugs la mel 'tshe byed mkhan gyi bul khyi zer ba'i khyi rigs dang / /ri dwags rngo na thub mkhan gyi sha khyi zer ba'i khyi rigs bcas 'ga' shas gso skyong byed kyi yod pa red/thon skyed byed stangs thad/ gtso bo phyugs rigs rtswa thang du 'tshoskyong byed rgyu de yin pas phyugs rdzi ni mang che ba khyim dud so so'i nang mi pho mo gang 'os 'gro ba dang / nyung shas kyis nang mi dang / 'brog g.yog zung 'brel byed pa/ ches nyung shas kyis 'brog g.yog kho nar brten gyi yod cing / phyugs rdzi'i hur brtson che chung dang / phyugs 'tsho'i nyams myong yod med sogs kyis phyugs rigs 'phel rgyas ji yong gi rag las kyi yod/ rdzi bo'i kha grangs ni phyugs khyu'i mang nyung la lto/sa dgos pas/ phyugs rigs mang gras kyis nor bzhon ma dang / ska ma/ khal g.yag bcas khyu dbye ba dang / ra lug ma mo dang / sha ra'i khyu dbye ste 'tsho ba/ ches phyug shos kha shas kyis phyugs zog rigs rer khyu kha shas dbye ste 'tsho ba/de min mang che ba 'bri g.yag khyu dang / lug khyu khag dbye ste 'tsho ba/zog grangs nyung gras g.yag lug chabs cig 'tsho ba/ be'u dang / re'ulug ni ma phyugs las logs su mi 'tsho ka med kyang / sa khul mang che ba re'u lug sha ra'i khyu nang du sdebs pa'am/ them dud gzhan gyi lug khyu'i nang du sdebs kyi yod pa red/ rta dang / g.yag ni jag rkun gyi 'tshe ba soḍa dmiḍa bsal gyi gnas tshul med na ri rgya9 su bzhag ste skabs skabs69

su blta bskor byed pa tsam las nyin ltar rdzi bo dang / dgong ltar lhas rwar bskong mi dgos/ 'bri gcig bzhos byed pa'i sa khul du be'u logasasu dbye mi dgos pa/ phyugs khyu gang yin rung mnyam du mi bsre ba dang /phyugs khyu las kha bral te phyugs rdzi ba phan tshun mnyam du mi sdod pa/ lug khyu mang sar ma mo khrid skabs phyugs rdzi kha snon dang / gangs zhod kyi skabs su phyugs rdzi mang tsam kha snon dgos kyi yod/ spyir btang phyugs rigs dgong re bzhin lhas su bskong ba dang / zhogs ltar ri la gtong dgos shing / 'bri g.yag rnams phyugs rdzi thon ma ran gong kha lo ba zer ba'i mi zhig gis snga tsam ri khar skyel dgos/ smad pa'i sa khul rnams su 'bri bzhon ma ni dbyar dus zla ba bzhi'am/ gsum lhag gi ring ri khar btang ste nyin phyed lhas su thengs re dang dgong mo yang skyar lhas su bcug pa de la gsum dro zer gyi red/ gnyis ba'os byed pa'i sa khul gyis kyang bzhon ma rnams nam ma langs gong ri la bskyal dgos kyi yod pa red/'bri g.yag gi 'tshar long dus tshod ni/ be'u dang / ya ru/shad pho mo/ so gnyis/ so bzhi/ so drug kha tshang bcas lo bdun yim/ pa dang / 'bri ni mthus ma tshur khrid ma ste/ so bzhi'i dus su be'u skye zhing bed spyod tshad la slebs pa dang / de'ang spyir btang lo gnyis rer be'u skye thengs re yin pa/ lo dang por grus ma dang / gnyisapar yar ma zer/ nam dus legs shing 'tsho skyong yag po byung skabs 'brire 'gar lo rer be'u thengs re skye ba de la rkyang tshab zer/ (grus log )g.yag ni sa khul so so'i khyad chos dang / khyim dud so so'i dgos mkho 60

dba'abyor pa che chung gis bod spyod gtong dus phran bu mi 'dra rung spyir btang du so bzhi dang / so drug kha tshang yas mas tsam la tshwa brdal tshong gsum gyi thog tu bed spyod gtong gi yod pa red/ ra lug 'tshar long gi dus tshod ni/ re'u lug dang / thong pa/ gnyis pa/ gsug pa bcas lo bzhi yin pa dang / ma ra ni lo gsum thog re'u phrug skyes te bzho rgyu'i tshad la slebs pa dang / stod pa'i sa khul rnams la pho lug lo lon na tshwa len pa dang brje tshong sogs la dos khal 'gel gyi yod pa red/spyirabatang ra lug pho ni lo gsum dang / bzhi/ lnga yas mas la khyim dud so so'i 'byor pa che chung ltar bshas gtong byed kyi red/ mo phyugs ni spyir btang rgas te 'tsho gnas mi thub pa'i mtshams su bshas gtong ba dang / khal g.yag gi bshas gtong lo tshad ni/ de'i snga tsam yin kyang 'tsho ba dka' ngal yod mkhan gyi khyim dud yin na/ phyugs zog lo tshad la ma ltos par spus tshad zhan pa rnams bshas gtong byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ rta 'tshar long gi dus tshod ni/ rti'u/ co pa/ sga rgyag gzhubo zhes lo bzhi la brtsi yang / don dngos thog na so lnga pa bar la ha lam 'tshar long gi dus tshod rtsis na'ang chog rta bed spyod kyi dus tshod ni/ rgod ma rnams lo lnga'i thog rti'u skye ba dang / pho rnams lo lnga'i thog tu bed spyod chog gi yod pa red/ spyir btang phyugs zog spyi'i 'tshar long gi dus tshod ni/ kha'i so brjes nas so gsar pa kha gang ba'i bar rtsisan 'grig gi red/ rwa yod ni rwa tshigs gzhir bzung lo grangs brtsi choga'abri 'jo rgyu'i dus tshod ni/ spyir btang lo 'khor ma yin na'ang 61

gsum bzhos sa khul la dbyar dus zhogs pa dang nyin gung gnyis dang /dgong mo bcas gsum 'jo ba/ de'ang phyugs phrug skyo gras la 'jo tshad thad dmigs bsal gyi lta rtogs dgos kyi yod pa red/ ston dgun dpyid gsum la snga dgong gnyis la thengs re 'jo ba dang / nam dus dbang gis phyugs zog sha shed khyon yongs skyo ba'am/ re zung dmigs bsal gyi skyo po yod na/ thengs re'am/ mi 'jo ba'ang byed dgos/be'u dang / ya ru ni 'jo thengs re'i snga rjes su 'o ma phran tsam re nu ru 'jug dgos/ stod kyi sa khul 'ga' shas su gnyis bzhos yin pa/ snga dgong ngam mtshan dang dro la 'jo ba/ sa khul kha shas gcig bzhos yin pas/ zhogs pa rang la 'jo gi yod/ lug 'jo rgyu'i dus tshod ni/ dbyar dus zla gnyis yas mas yin pa/ smad pa'i sa khul rnams la dang thog snga dgong thengs gnyis re dang / de rjes snga dgong dro gsum la thengs re ste gsum bzhos byed dgos/ ra 'jo rgyu'e dus tshod spyir btang zla lnga yas mas yin pa dang / nyin re'i dus tshod ni lug dang gcig mtshungs/ stod pa'i sa khul rnams su lug zhogs dgong gnyis re 'jo dgos pa dang / byang ngos sa khul kha shas la ra lug la'ang gcig bzhos byed mkhan yod pa red/ re'u lug ni stod khul sogs sa khul mang che ba ma dang kha phral rkyang byed pa dang / sa khul kha shas kyis dgong mo thengs redang / smad pa'i sa khul rnams ni zhogs dgong gnyis la bzhos tshar rjes 'o ma phran tsam nu ru 'jug gi red/ smad pa'i sa khul rnams su g.yag lug gnyis kur dgun dus lhas rwa yod/ stod pa'i sa khul la ra lug dang /62

be'u yar sogs la dgun dus lhas ra yod pa dang / dpyid dus yol ba yod pa/ byang ngos kyi sa khul 'ga' shas la lhas rwa dang / yol ba gang yang med pa red/ smad pa dang / bar pa'i sa khul mang che bar nor che chung rnams lhas su slebs skabs gdang la 'dogs pa dang / sdebs spu9 mi byed pa'i sa khul rnams su re'u lug kyang gdang la 'dogs rkyang byed dgos kyi yo3da pa red/ stod pa'i sa khul 'ga' shas la be'u yar ma gtoḍa phyugs zog gang yang gdang la 'dogs srol med/ ma mo 'jo skabs bstar thag gis bstar dgos pa dang / ra ma mang sar yang bstar thag gis bstar dgos kyi yod pa red/'o ma 'jo rgyu sogs dkar las ni bud med kho nas byed pa dang /tshwa tshong 'gro mkhan dang / bal spu 'breg mkhan sogs ni skyes pas byed kyi yod/ brje tshong la 'gro rgyu'i dus tshod ni spyir btang dgun dus yin pa dang / tshwa bul len rgyu ni dpyid dus yin/ smad pa'i sa khul rnams kyis brdal 'dren 'gro srol yod pa de ni dus tshod nges med yin/ g.yag gi ze rtsid dang / khu lu/ lug gi sbo spu bcas 'thog pa'i dus tshod nidabyar stod yin pa dang / 'bri g.yag gi rtsid pa dang / ra rtsid bcas ni dbyar dkyil/ lug bal 'breg rgyu ni dbyar smad rang du yin cing /de yang sa khul stod smad kyi khyad chos dang / phyugs zog shed bzang zhan bcas kyi snga phyi'i dbye ba phran tsam yod pa red/ re'u/ lu gu bya gcod rgyu ni spyir btang dbyar dkyil yin cing / sa khul nyung shas kyis skyes nasanyin bcu skor skud pas bsdam gyi yod/ g.yag gi bya gcod rgyu'i 63

dus tshod ni dpyid ku'am/ ston kha dang / lo tshod ni so gnyis yan yin/phyugs zog gi rgyud sbyor dus tshod ni/ 'bri la bod zla drug pa nas 'go tshugs te pha phyugs kyis rang shugs rgyud sbyor byed pa'am/ yang na mi'i ram 'degs kyi rgyud sbyor byed rogs kyang byed kyi yod pa red/ ra lug rgyud sbyor ni spyir btang bod zla dgu pa'i nang yin cing / de'i sngon la snga sbyor mi yong ba'i ched du pha phyugs la thug khebs zer ba zhig bkab stesngon 'gog byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ pha phyugs grangs tshad ni spyir btang pha phyugs res mo phyugs ga tshod ldeng gi yod med yul lung so so'i nyams myong gzhir bzung dgos kyang / tshang mas pha phyugs spus legs kho na gdam srol yod pa red/ rta'i rgyud sbyor ni bod zla bzhi ga dang / lnga pa'i yas mas la yin pa bcas dang / phyugs zog so so'i rgyud sbyor gyi dus tshod thad spyir btang sa khul so so'i khyad chos mi 'dra bas/ rgyud sbyor dusatshod snga phyi'i khyad par phran tsam yod kyang / rgyud sbyor yag po yong min gyi 'gag rtsa ni/ mo phyugs dang / pha phyugs sha shed yag po yod med la rag las kyi yod pa red/ phyugs rigs so so'i skye dus ni re'u dang /lu gu bod zla dang po'i nang skye 'go tshugs pa dang / be'u ni bod zla gsum pa'i nang / rti'u ni snga lo'i rgyud sbyor gyi dus tshod de rang du skyes yong gi yod pa red/byang thang 'brog khul du phyugs zog god chag yong rgyu'i 'gal rkyen gtso bo ni gangs zhod yin gshis/ de yang gna' bo'i shod srol ltar na 64

lo rgan drug cu re'i mtshams su gangs zhod che ba thengs re yong skabs smad pa dang / bar pa'i sa khul du phyugs zog phyed cha nas/ ha lam rtsa med song ba'i lo rgyus kyang byung yod tshod 'dug gangs zhod 'bring ba dngachung ba dus tshod nges med du babs kyi yod pa des kyang phyugs zog mang nyung la ma ltos par shi god yong gi yod pa red/ stod dang / byang gi sa khul la gangs zhod babs thengs dang / babs tshad gong dang cung zhig mi 'dra zhing / phyugs zog gi shi tshad kyang mtho tshad brgya cha sum cu tsam las/ rtsa stong song ba'i lo rgyus yod pa ma red/ gangs skyon byung ba'i skabs su phyugs zog do dam yag nyes kyis phyugs zog shi tshad che chung la nus pa phran tsam thon gyi yod kyang / gzhi rtsa'i cha nas gangs skyon 'gog thabs kyi thabs shes yod pa ma red/phyugs rigs so so la 'gos nad dang / 'gos nad ma yin pa'i nad skyon sna tshogs yod kyang / yul thabs kyis lag bcos byed rgyu dang / 'gos nad rigs la nad skyon yod med kyi dbye mtshams 'byed rgyu'i thabs shes la brten nas khyab gdal mi 'gro ba byed thub kye yod/da dung phyugs zog bza' mkhan spyang ki sogs gcan gzan gyi gnod 'tshe yod kyang / nyin mor mi dang / mtshan mor khyis mel 'tshe la brten nas bkag 'gog byed pa dang / spyang phrug len pa/ gcan gzan che ba gsod thabs bcas byas te gnod 'tshe che ba mi yong ba byed thub kye yod/ 'brog las thon rdzayogatso bo ma yin pa dang / mar gyi thon tshad65

mi/ sa khul so so'i skye dngos kyi bcud che chung dang / phyugs zog gnyer skyong yag nyes/ phyugs rigs rang nyid kyi rgyu dag bzang zhan bcas dang 'brel ba yod pas / smad kyi sa khul rnams la 'bri grus ma rer mar 'dekhargya nyi shu nas bcu gnyis bar/ yar ma rer mar 'degs rgya bcu nas drug bar/ lug ma mo rer mar rgya ma gang nas phyed ka bar/ ra ma rer mar rgya ma do nas gang bar/ 'bri'i phyur ba ni mar las cung nyung zhing / ra lug ni mar las phyur ba mang ba yod pa red/ stod kyi sa khul rnams su 'bri grus ma rer mar rgya ma bcu gnyis nas brgyad bar/ yar ma rer mar rgya ma brgyad nas bzhi bar/ ra lug gi mar ni smad pa dang ha lam 'dra zhing / stod pa'i sa khul gyi phyur ba sngo phyur yin pas/ smad pa'i skyaphyur las phran tsam nyung ba yod pa red/ spu rigs thon tshad thad/ lug pho las bal rgya ma gnyis dang phyed ka nas gcig dang phyed ka bar/ ma molas bal rgya ma gang yas mas/ ra las cha snyom khul rtsid srang gsum yas mas/ lu gu'i 'om bu ni srang bzhi yas mas/ 'bri g.yag las cha snyom khul rgya phyed yas mas dang / rtsid pa srang bzhi yas mas bcas thon gyi yod/ thon rdzas de dag bed spyod gtong yul mar ni khral rigs 'jal sgrub byas 'phros/ smad pa'i sa khul rnams kyis bza' 'bru nyo sgrub bya rgyu'i tshong zong byed pa/ stod pa'i sa khul rnams kyis bza' mar byed kyi yod/ bal ni gyon chas dang / mkho chas gzhan dag la bed spyod btang 'phros gzhung sger chos gsum gyi 'bam tshong dang skyed lci'i bu lon 'jal byed dgos shing / gal srid 'phros lhag yod mkhan nyung shas la sa gnas 66

/sde// //// /sde/rdo /)(1 //// /bye) zing ////da gzhung bkag ma da stabs/ ga thabs sa 4nga nga kha gsab byed mkhan yang yod pa red/ nor dang / ra'i spu rigs ni spra dang /sgyi mo/ thag pa sogs bzo byed yin pa dang / lpags rigs ni gyon chas zob byed yin/gnyis pa/ zhor las skor/sa khul mang che bas gtso bor tshwa kha khag nas tshwa bul len pa dang /khag gcig gis rngon rgyag pa/ 'ga' shas kyis gro ma dang / ram pa len pa/ 'thu rtswa gcod 'breg byed pa/ lag shes thad bud med rnams kyis spu rigs bskor 'thag byed pa/ skyes pa rnams kyis yo ga yog pa/phying pa bzo ba/ nyung shas kyis 'tshems bu'ang rgyag cing / de'i thog smad pa'i sa khul rnams kyis lpags rigs mnyed pa tsam las/ gzhan gyi lag shes byed mkhan nyung nyung red/ lcags bzo ba ni sprang slong kho na'i gras red/ tshong las thad stod pa'i sakhul rnams kyis tshwa dang bshas zog g.yag lug 'ded de dbus gtsang gi 'brel mtshungs sa khul rnams la 'grob dang / smad pa rnams kyis dbus gtsang sa khul 'ga' shas dang /zangs ri/ kong po/ dpal 'bar sogs la mar 'bru brje tshong byed par zla ba dgu pa'i yas mas su 'gro ba/ tshong zog ldeng po yod mkhan khyim dud rnams kyis 'bru rigs kyi khar ja dang ras cha phrug sogs gyon chas dang / nang chas dngos po gzhan dag tha na 'phrul mda' sogs nyo sgrub byed pa/ mang che bas bar tshong rgyag mkhan gyi lag nas ja dang /67

ras cha socas nyo gi yod pa ma zad/ 'phrul mda' sogs mtshon cha nyo mkhan yang kha shas yod pa red/ 'brog pa phan tshun bar phyugs zog dang /de min gyi ca lag gzhan dag phan tshun brje res byed pa tsam las ma rtsal brten nasatshong las gnyer mkhan ha lam yod pa ma red/byang thang 'brog pa'i sa khul du ri dwags rngon rgyag byed rgyu ni gna' 151/bye/15/ /de/ /she/ (1kyi 1re/ 1dro1 /bye/྅rngo1 /|/ mtheg ga sa ga na 95/ nga dutheg 'a ga pa pa/ 'onabab tan gas ba gal che shos shig kyang yin/ sa ma 'brog gi sa khul rnams su shwa ba dang / gla ba sogs ri dwags sna tshogs rngon rgyu'i goms gshis yod pa dang / 'brog pa gtan sdod sa khul la cha bzhag na/ sngar gtan sdod ma byas gong dang dud grangs nyung ba'i skabs su sa stong rgya khyon ha cang che —bar 'brong khyu dang / rkyang khyu/ gtsod khyu/ rna khyu sogs ri dwags sna tshogs yod par brten rngon rgyag sgar pa 'gro srol yod kyang / phyis su dud grangs rim bzhin 'phar ba dang / ru ba gtan sdod byed pa'i lam srol byung stabs ri dwags gnas pa'i rgya khyon chung du song zhing / 'brongadang rkyang sogs byang mtha' sa stong thag ring sar bros song ba/ rna dgo sogs ri dwags chung rigs 'ga' shas sngar mus bzhin 'brog pa sdod sa'i ri steng du lus yod par khyi ra rgyag mkhan nyung shas tsam yod kyang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis ri klung rgya 'dems kyi do dam che ru song bar brten lkog lkog sud sud tsam las mngon gsal gyis ri dwags rngon phod mkhan nyung du song yod pa red/ 'brog pa spo sdod byed pa'i sa khul nang nas a mdo byang ma dang / gnam ru byang ma/ nag tshang byang ma bcas 68

kyi byang ngos ri stong thog tu 'brong dang rkyang sogs ri dwags sna tshogs kyi 5khyu tshogs gnas yod par brten sa cha de ga'i yul mi rnams 'brong rkyang rngon rgyag byed mkhan sgar pa 'gro srol sngar bzhin yod pa ma zad/ 'brog pa'i sdod gnas kyi ri thog tu yod pa'i ri dwags chung rigs rngon mkhan yang yod pa red/ ri dwags brgyab pa'i sha yi yong 'bab ni kho tsho'i 'tshoba'i nang du gal che'i go gnas bzung yod pa dang / lpags rigs spu rtsid rnams rang spyod dam/ gzhan tshong byed kyi yod pa red/ ri dwags rgyag rgyur 'bad brtson che shos byed mkhan a mdo byang ma'i sa khul la cha mtshon na/ lo rer ri dwags rgyag mkhan gyi sgar pa ha lam thengs gsum tsam 'gro srol yod cing / dgun dus byang chen du 'gro zer ba khal ma brgya skor dang / mi grangs bcu nas nyi shu skor/ dus tshod zla gcig yas mas 'gor ba/ dpyid dus sos gtub tu 'gro zer ba khal ma sum cu bzhi bcu skor dang / mi grangs lnga nas bdun bar/ dus tshod zla gcig yas mas 'gor ba/ dbyar kha bog yag tu 'gro zer ba mi khal 'os 'tshams dus tshod zla ba gnyis tsam 'gor gyi yod/ sgar re re'i nangadu 'brong la me mda' brgyab ste gsod thub mkhan ri pa'i pha rgan zer ba des sgar de'i 'go khrid kyi 'gan 'khur dgos kyi yod pa red/ kho par 'brong sha bgo skabs ol sha dang / khung sha/ mgo/ snying / snying tshil/ rnga ma/ g.yag rgan yin na sgal gzhung gi ko ba yang thob pa che bskal du bzhag 'phros mi grangs ltar bgo bsha' byed pa dang / skabs der glo bur du 'brong sgar nang khongs min pa'i mi zhig 'brong rnga ma 'breg 69

gong du slebs pa yin na 'brong gi rnga tseb (slebs )zer ba 'brong sha'i phyed cha sprod dgos 'brong sha'i ljid tshad ni 'brong rab la bod zla drug pa'i nang bsad tshe khal rgyab bcu gnyis tsam yod la dgun dus bsad na khal rgyab drug bdun tsam lon zhing che tshad rwa dbar du mi bsdad na/rwa g.yas g.yon la mi thug pa yod/ ('brong che ba nyung shas la zer )galasrid lus gnad gal che sa la mde'u ma phog par shi ma thub pa'i skabs rmas ma'i mdun du mi dang / rta/ khyi sogs song nas ngar slong ba yin na/steng du rgyugs te rwa yis rdung ba dang / rkang lag gis brdzi ba/ lces bldag pa sogs byed pas srog la nyen kha'ang yod pa red/ skabs der slebasamatshams 'brong gi klad pa dang / rus chen la mde'u ma phog na shi mi thub/spyir 'brong zer ba ni gzugs stobs ha cang che la/ spang rdza'i lung shur dang thang sogs la gnas pa/ nyin mor rtswa mi bza' zhing / brdzi gsangashin tu rno ba/ khal tshugs gcig gi sa nas dud dri tshor 'gro ba bcas khyad chos 'ga' zhig yod/ yang sa zur du sdod pa'i dud tshang re zung tsam la ri dwags rgyag mkhan med cing / kha khu sim po yod pa'i 'brog dud kyinor khyu'i nang du 'brong slebs te 'bri 'ga' shas la 'brong be'u yang chang kyi yo da pa red/ gzhan yang rkyang dang ri dwags chung rigs rgyag pa'i skabs su'ang gsod mkhan la sdig gla'am/ che bskal 'jog dgos pa dang / rkyang rtsa la btso tseb (slebs )zer ba rkyang gi long ril len te gom bdun gyi sar dbyug ma thub gong mi zhig glo bur du slebs tshe rkyang sha phyed bgos byed dgos pa dang / ri dwags chung rigs rnams la'ang sug 70

bzhi tshigs slog ste bkog ma tshar gong mi zhig slebs pa yin na/ 'dre 1sde/ dren /phye/ )// 151 /) /rngo/ chen / /blo/ /nye theb/ da ra ba sha da da da 0sdo da pa da rkyapapa bsdo zug ziṭa thenami 'thung ba dang / bod zla drug pa'i nang ti'u skye skabs rkyang rgod ma khyu yi nang du hrang zer ba'i rkyang pho re re yod pa des rkyang rti'u khrid skabs kha gnam gdangs nas spor nam mkhar bstan te skad yang yang rgyag gi yod/rkyang de'i kha ru mur rdo zer ba'i nor bu'i rigs yod par brten dus tshod de'inang du char pa gtong rgyu yang 'gog thub ces zer srol yod pa red/ mi rnams kyi kha rgyun du rkyang than mig dashār yang zer/ ri dwags chung rigs rgyag par skya thig sgar 'gro zer nas dmigs bsal gyi sgar bkyag mi dgos/lag cha ni/ me mda' rgyag pa dang / dong rnyi dang / lcags rnyi 'jog pa/khyi bkye ba/ wa sbre sogs la hab ka 'jog pa/ gcan gzan khung nang shor na du sub gtong ba sogs byed kyi yod/ 'phyi ba ni/ a mdobyang ma phud/ de byings sa khul tshang mar sprang slong nyung shas shig gis ma gtogs gsod kyi ma red/ mdor na/ ri dwags rngon rgyu ni gna' bo'i srol rnying gi gras shig yin stabs yul skad brda rnying gi ming mang ba dang / rmi lam 'gug pa/ pra ltas brtag pa/ ri dwags mi gsod pa'i skabs dang / bsad tshar rjes bcas la rmongs dad kyi byed stangs ha cang mang zhing / rung dang mi rung gi 'dzem bya sna tshogs yod kyang /dgos med kyi bya ba yin stabs re re bzhin ma bkod/71

gsum / byang 'azog sa khul gyi 'tsho ba/gartsa bo 'brog las thon rdzas rang la brten dbos pa dang / de'i thog brje tshong dang / zhor las yong 'bab kyis kyang kha gsab dgos kyi yod pa red/ de yang sa khul stod smad bar dang / lho byang bar la 'tsho ba'i spyod stangs phyogs gang ci'i thad la dbye ba phran tsam re yod cing /dper na/ sdod khang la cha mtshon na/ shar gyi rdzong khag gi gtan sdod 'brog pa'i sdod gnas ni sbra gur kho nar byed kyi yod kyang / zur du ca lag 'jog sa'i khang pa dang sgo rwa bcas yod pa/ 'byor pa 'bring yan la dgun sbra dang / dbyar sbra khag khag yod cing / nub dang dkyil gyi rdzong khag gi sdod gnas ni sbra gur kho na yin/ khyim dud 'ga' shas la la zog brang 'gro skabs sdod sa'i gur khra yang yod pa red/ byang ngos su gnas shing spo sdod byed pa'i 'brog pa'i sdod pa sbra gur sha stag yin pa brjod ma dgos/ stod byang sa khul 'ga' shas su me thab kyang lcags skyed labyed dgos pa/ nang chas mang nyung sogs kyi thad la khyim dud 'byor pa che chung gi dbye ba tsam gyis ma tshad/ sa khul stod smad bar dang / 'brog pa'i ru ba spo sdod yin min bar la yang dbye ba yod pa red/ gyon chas kyi thadal gzhi rkang 'brog khul stod smad tshang ma ra lug gi pags pa'i slog pa dgun dus gsar pa dang / dbyar dus rnying pa bed spyod byed pa las/ ras cha dang / snam bu gnam gshis dbang gi rgyun gos byed thub kyi med/ gosakyi bzo dbyibs dang / ske rags 'ching stangs sogs bod rigs byings 72

dang 'dra bar gna' bo'i srol rgyun ltar skyes pa rnams phyogs 'gro dang /rta bzhon bab mang tsam dgos rkyen gos sna thung tsam 'ching ba dang / bud med rnams nang las byed mkhan yin stabs gos sna ring tsam 'ching zhing /skyes pa rnams kyis gos dang rgyan cha brjid nyams gtso bor 'don zhing /gos kyi kha dog khra bo mi gyon pa/ rgyan cha'ang go mtshon sha stag la dwang dod byed kyi yod pa dang / bud med rnams mdzes nyams gtso bor byed cing / gos kyi rgyan khra bo byed pa/ rgyan cha g.yu byur dang dngul chas sogs byed kyi yod pa/ de'ang sa khul stod smad dbar la dbye ba mngon gsal dod po yod khar/ sa gnas chung chung re'i dbar la'ang dbye ba phran tsam yod pa de ni lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi dbang gis phan tshun 'gro 'ong nyung ba dang / rgyan chas gcig gyur byed srol ma chags pas byas pa red/ nye rabs te/ dus rabs 'di'i nang skyes pa rnams gos thung gyonasrol chags pa dang / lhag par dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur rjes su gzhi nas pho mo gnyis nas stod thung gyon srol chags pa sogs dus rabs 'di'i nang du gyon chas dang / rgyan cha sogs la 'gyur ba byung ste stabs bde ru song yod kyang / gzhi rtsa'i cha nas bod rigs kyi 'brog chas 'gyur ldog byung med cing / rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skabs skra breg pa sogs gos chas bsgyur rtsis byas kyang / 'gyur ldog phran bu tsam las byung med khar nye lam sa khul kha shas su skra lhas stangs sogs sngar srol skyar gso byed bzhin yod pa red/bza' chas kyi thad la/ byang thang 'brog las sa khul du 'tsho ba 73

rang thon rang spyod bya rgyu'i sngar gyi goms gshisal 'gyur ldog byung med khar/ byang mtha' yin pa'i spo sdod sa khul nyung shas phud/ sa khad kyis 'khor thub pa'i 'brog khul stod smad tshang ma thon rdzas lhag ma dang brjes pa'i'abru rigs bcas la brten gyi yod pa red/ de yang dgun dpyid sogasal sha rigs dang / rtsam pa/ thug pa sogs shasache ba dang / dbyar dus dkar chu shas che ba/ smad kyi sa khul 'ga' shas la dbyar dus thug pa mi bkol ba dang / rtsam pa'ang ha lam bza' srol med pa/ 'thung ja ni ha lam sa khul tshang mas bar tshong gi lag nas gong chen sprad de nyo dgos stabs skyes pa rgan rigs dang / mi mtho gras kyi rigs nyung shas tsam las mang che ba chu dkar (chu khol nang 'o ma blugs pa der zer )kho na 'thung gi yod cing / tshal bzo ba sogs kha lag sne mang bzo srol med par sha dang / rtsam pa/ zho/ thug pa sogs ha cang gi stabs bde spyod kyi yod pa red/ gnyen ston dang / lo gsar/ 'grul pa rtsa che gdan zhus skabs kha lag yag tsam gtong srol yod kyang / sne grangs mang po bzo shes kyi med pa red/ khyim dud nyung shas kyis dbyar thog dkar chu kho na dang / dgun sha/ dpyid kur 'bru rtsam bza' ba las/ zas rigs sne 'dzoms pa'i dus skabs ha cang nyung nyung red/ zhing khul thag ring zhing ru ba spo sdod yin pa'i 'brog khul 'ga' shas su dbyar dgun dus bzhi la phyugs zog bshas gtong byas pa'i sha dang / ridwags rngon rgyag byas pa'i sha kho nar bed spyod byed cing / de thog dkar cas kha gsab byed pa tsam las/ 'bru rigs sogs bza' chas gzhan 74

dag gi cha rkyen ha lam med pa dang / gro ma dang ram pa thon pa'i sa gnas nas kyang rgyun ldan gyi 'tsho ba la phan pa'i phon 'bor thon thub kyi med pa red/ khyim dud 'ga' zhig gis zhing khul nas la phug dang / nyung ma nyos te thug pa bkol gyi yod pa red/ phyoḍa 'gro'i skabs su thud sogs 4za' chas yag tsam khyer srol yod pa dang / 'byor ldan nyung shas kyis dbyar dus bza' rgyu sha skam nyar te bed spyod byed kyi yod pa red/ mdor na/'brog khul gyi bza' bca' de bzhin bcud che la bro ba legs pa yin cing /des mi rnams kyi lus stobs rgyas pa la nus pa mngon gsal yod kyang / zas g.yos sbyor gyi lag rtsal zhan pa dang / sha rigs dang snum ni 'ju dka' ba/ lhag par za ba'i dus tshod nges gtan med pa gang byung byung gi zaba'i goms gshis kyis lus khams bde thang la gnod pa'i phyogs shig kyang yod pa red/bzhi ba/ goms gshis kyi byed sgo 'ga' zhig1 gnyen zig gi skor/ spyir btang rang re'i sa khul tshang mar pho mo rang dbang gnyen sgrig ma yin par pha mas ster slong byed pa'i lam lugs yin cing / bu dang bu mo gnyis mthun gnyen sgrig byed mkhan yang yod pa red/ mna' ma len mkhan mang ba dang / mag pa 'jog mkhan chesanyung ba/ bu gnyis gsum mnyam du mna' ma re len pa dang / bu rer mna' ma gnyis re yang len mkhan yod cing / de yang dang thog bu mor rin 'bab sprod dgos pa dang / sa khul 'ga' shas la de thog ming 75

—'dogs sna tshogs kyis dngos rigs sprod dgos kyi yod pa/ rjes su bu mo'i pha khyem nas kyang bu mor skyel rdzong ngam/ bskal thob sprod dgos kyi yod pa de yang sa khul stod smad bar gsum la zhib phra'i dbye ba mi 'dra ba yod pa red/ sngar dus 'brel yod phyogs kyi lo khams sogs la brtag dpyad kyis bag rtsis byed pa'i srol yod kyang / phyis su pho mo gnyis po'i rgyu dag dang rigs rus/ khyim tshang gnyis kyi 'byor pa sogs la gzhir 'dzin rgyu'i lam srol chags yod pa red/ gnyen sgrig dngos gzhi'i skabasasu bag ma bsu skyel dang / ston mo'i mdzad sgo/ g.yang len lha 'doḍa/gtam bshad grags pa sgra chen sogs dusatshod thung ngu'i nang du byed sgo mngapo zhig yod cing / skabs der gnyen nye dang yul mi khyim mtshes zas khyer ba mang po yong gi yod pa red/ de yang sa khul so sor goms srol mi 'dra ba dang / khyim dud so sor 'byor pa che chung mi 'dra bas gnyen ston mdzad sgo rgyas bsdus dang / byed stangs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa brjod ma dgos shing / de dag ni gna' bo'i srol rgyun zhig yin stabs rmongs dad kyi byed sgo dang 'dres yod pa red/ sa khul nyung shas dang /mi nyung shas kyis pho mo rang mos sam/ rang shed kyis gnyen sgrig byed pa dang / 'ga' shas kyis gnyen sgrig dngos kyi skabs su 'grul pa khrid pa nang bzhin las/ mdzad sgo gang yang mi byed mkhan yang yod pa red/2 'das macag skor/ de ni yul goms chos lugs dad mos dang 'brel ba dam zab yod pa red/ sa khul mang che ba dge lugs la dad pa byed kyi yod cing / 'ga' shas sa dge/ bka' rnying gang la'ang76

dad pa byed kyi yod/ mi 'das grongs song skabs phung po ni dur khrod du bya bya gtor byed pa'am/ ri la skyel ba/ bla grwa gdan zhus kyis bdun tshigasazhe dgu bar 'dzin pa/ dgon khag la 'bul skyel 'gro ba/ dus tshod nges can nang gshin por dmigs te mchod me spor ba/ ma ṇi rdo labarko ba/ chos 'don pa/ gnas bskor 'gro ba sogs byed kyi yod cing / da dung sa khul nyung shas kyis lo re zung la sgo bshas spang ba sogs byed kyi yod/ bon po'i chos lugs la dad mkhan rnams kyi sa bla grwa gdanazhus kyis zhe dgu 'dzin rgyu sogs byed sgo mang che ba gong gsal dang gcig mtshungs yin khar/ phung po sbyin sreg byed pa/ byang bzhus byed pa/gshin po 'dur byed la sogs dmigs bsal gyi byed sgo mi 'dra ba kha shasakyang spel dgos kyi yod pa red/ sa gnas dang chos lugs kyi dbye ba med par gnyen nye sogs 'brel yod phyogs kyis dge sdong zhal 'dengs kyi dngos rigs skyel ba dang / sems gso'i ched du 'das po'i nang mir thug phrad byed par yong gi yod pa red/3 lo gsar skor/ bod zla 12tshes 1la lo chung dang / bod zla 1tshes 1la lo chen zer zhing / lo chung zer ba de dag gtong mkhan /ste/ /// the:mi re:tho /cherdo / 355 /remi /)/ /re dang ga nga mkhan sna ba/sa da pa da na sa khul mang ba bod yongs dang 'dra bar lug mgo dang / phye mar bsham pa/ sder kha sgrig pa/ mi rnams gzab mchor spras shing nyin kha shas ring ston mo dang / grong rogs phan tshun 'bod res byed pa sogs byed kyi yod/ sa khul nyung shas kyis phye mar dang / lug mgo/ sder kha sogs mi bsham 77

par nyin gcig rang la kha lag yag tsam bza' ba las gzhan gyi byed sgo gang yang mi byed mkhan yang yod/4 dus chen skor/ sa khul mang che bar dbyar dus spyi rim dang sbrags rta rgyugs/ mda' 'phen byed srol yod pa dang / de'i gzhi khyonani spyir btang shog kha re sde tshan rer byed cing / sa khul 'ga' shas la shog kha kha shas mnyam 'brel byed pa'am/ shog kha rer sde tshan kha shas byas te dus chen gtong gi yod pa dang / de min ri gsol dus chen/dgon pa'i dus mchod ltad mo blta zhor chabs cig spro skyid gtong gi yod pa red/ byang rigs sa khul nag chu'i char chen dang / 'dzam gling spyi bsangs/ a mdo'i mtsho dmar tshogs pa sogs khral bsdu khrims tshogasardzidang mnyam du byed pa'ang yod/ gzhan yang 'brog pa'i sa khul du rgyu nor 'tshol bar yong mkhan zhing las sa khul gyi dgon khag rnams kyi bla ma che 'bring dang / sa skya'i'abul bsdu sogs 'bul bsdu sna tshogs/ tsa ri'i 'tshug pa/ ma ṇi jo dbyangs bskor mkhan/ 'bri gung gi dung brtsong pa/ ras pa/ rdo brko ba/ yig 'bri ba/ lha bris pa/chos 'don pa/ gnas bskor ba sogs sna tshogs yod pa ma zad/ byang ngos kyi sa khul 'ga' shas su mgo btags gtan sdod byed mkhan khram pa dang / mi 'khyam khral byol khrims byol du yong mkhan sogs kyang yod pa red/ /78

sog rdzong dang 'bri ru rdzong gnyis su sa ma 'brog gi thon skyed bdag gnyer byed stangs skor/nag chu sa gnas chab gros rtsom zig khang gis/dang po/sa ma 'brog gi rmo zhing chags yul de zhing khul gzhan las sa bab mtho zhing drod tshad dma' ba/ sad mi rgyag pa'i dus tshod thung ba/ ri ldebs la sa zhing mang zhing klung thang du sa zhing nyung ba/ chu gtong yul cha rkyen med pa dang sa rgyu gzhan pa bcas kyis dbyar nyal langs zer ba'i lo re phyed 'debs phyed snyal byed dgos pa red/sa ma 'brog gi 'brog pa chags yul mang che ba 'brog khul las sa bab dma' zhing drod tshad cung che ba/ sa dbyibs bde thang 'khor rgya yangs po med stabs rtswa thang yang ri ldebs dang lung shur la mang zhing gu dog pa/nags tshal gang 'tshams yod pa bcas kyis rkyen pas lug gi thon skyed 'phel tshad zhan zhing / bal gyi thon 'bab nyung ba/ 'bri g.yag gi thon skyed cung yag kyang rtswa khas mi ldeng ba'i gnas tshul yod pa red/sa ma 'brog la kher rkyang gi 'brog khul dang kher rkyang gi zhing khul gnyis dang mi 'dra ba'i zhing 'brog gnyis kyi thon skyed byed rgyu'i khyad chos yod pa ma zad/ zhor las byed sa'i rang byung gi cha rkyen mang ba dang /79

rang byung nags tshal yod stabs nags las sogs sne mang zhor las byed yul yag tsam yod/ 'brog zhing kher rkyang dang mi 'dra ba'i sa ma 'brog gi /phyim tshang re res zhing 'brog zhor gsum gnyer dgos yod rkyen mi'i nga'/ rtsol nus shugs kyis mi ldeng ba'i dka' ngal che tsam yod la zhing khral dang / 'brog khral/ zhor las thon skyed la khral 'jal dgos pas 'khur po'ang lci po yod pa red/ 'bru rigs rang kha rang gso'am 'bru lhag phran bu yod pa'i khyim tshang cung nyung zhing mang che bas rang nyid kyis sa zhing btabs kyang 'bru rigs rang ldeng mi thub stabs zhing 'brog brje tshong dang / zhor las sna tshogs kyis 'tsho ba'i kha gsab byed dgos kyi yod/sa ma 'brog gi sde shog mang che bar cha bzhag na sa bab dma' sar zhing kha dang mtho sar 'brog pa yin pa/ sde shog 'ga' shas 'brog las gtso bo yin pas 'tsho rten 'brog las thon rdzas yin pa dang / yang sde shog 'ga' shas zhing las gtso bo yin pas 'tsho rten zhing las thon rdzas yin rung spyir btang byas na khyim tshang mang che bas zhing 'brog gnyis ka ོ/nyer gyi yod/ zhing 'brog bar la sa thag nyi 'gyangs ni g.yag tshugs nyin phyed dang nyin gcig gam gnyis gsum 'gro dgos kyi yod pa red/kha shas 'ing sa dang 'brog sa mnyam du yod/gnyis pa/sa cha gang la 'brog las 'tshams pa dang / gang la zhing las 'tshams pa'i thad/ 'bri ru rdzong la cha mtshon na de snga'i khra ring sde shog dang /80

'gom shog 'bri ru shog stag phrug shog bcas kyi nang nas khag gcig (da lta shag chu chus )te srib khra dang / 'bri lung / na g.yang / rgo chu rgyud bcas la 'brog las 'tshamasapa/ de snga'i khra ring dang / rag shi/ 'gom shog 'bri ru shog bcas kyi nang nas (khag gcig da lta phyag rtse chus )shar lnga'i rgyud dang / mtsho phu'i rgyud/ man thang rgyud/ nag rgyud bcas la 'brog las 'tshams pa/ de snga'i rag shi shog khra ring shog 'gom shog bcas kyi nang nas (khag gcig da lta rag shi chus )zla thang dang / seng thang / g.yang thang / sum mdo rgyud bcas su 'brog las 'tshams pa/ sgam thang dang / tshwa chu bcings 'grol rgyud bcas la zhing las 'tshams pa yod /de snga'i 'bri ru shog (da lta 'bri ru chus )rtswa la rgyud la 'brog las 'tshams pa/ nod cang rgyud/ shar dmar rgyud gnyis la zhing laca/ 'tshams pa/ de snga'i khra ring shog 'gom shog gnyis kyi nang nas (khag gcig da lta'i khra ring chus )gdong la dang / ka rong nang rgyud gnyis la 'brog las 'tshams pa/ klan chu dang / smon khyim rgyud gnyis la zhing las 'tshams pa/ de snga'i bom phan shog dang / stag phrug shog khongs nas (khag gcig da lta'i bon phan chus )yar gdong dang / gshaca/ chu/ chu byang rgyud gsum la zhing las dang 'brog las gnyis ka 'tshams pa/ nyin lung rgyud la gtso bo zhing las 'tshams pa yod/de snga'i sen tsha dang / bu rdzum/ ban dkar shog bcas kyi (khag gcig da lta'i sen tsha chus )ya gong stod rgyud/ u khog rgyud/ gzi 81

mer thog rgyud/ chis gzhung dang de'i lung yan bcas la 'brog las 'tshams pa/ spra nga rdzong nas g.yang shod bar dang / chis rong ba thang nas chis mda' bar gyi chu chen rgyud der zhing las 'tshams pa yod/ de snga'i ban dkar shog nag rog shog gur bzhi shog bcas dang (da lta'i ban dkar chus )gdong / bde skyid/ ya nga / yag khog glas bcas lung pa de tsho'i stod rgyud/ nag rog bkris lung / dpal nang / 1ba nang / tham nang sis phu bcas la 'brog las 'tshams pa bcas red/sog rdzong la cha mtshon na/ de snga'i sog pa shog gi mchod g.yog dang /gra zhol gnyis la gtso bo 'brog las 'tshams pa/ sog rong la gtso bo zhing las 'tshamasapa/ nyin pa la zhing 'brog gnyis ka mtshams pa/cung pa shog gi dbyes pa/ dkar shog gzu pa gsum la gtso bo 'brog las 'tshamasapa/ ldab pa dang / dbyes pa gnyis la zhing las dang 'brog las gnyis ka 'tshams pa/ rong po ni zhing 'brog gnyis ku'i thon skyed byed kyi yod kyang skabs bstun nam bab dang stun rgyu las/ 'ol tshod byed dka' tsam 'dug lcam mdar gtso bo zhing las 'tshams pa/ khri rdo gnyis la zhing 'brog gnyis ka 'tshams pa bcas red/gsum pa/sa ma 'brog gi thon skyed kyi khyad chos gzhir gzung nas dus tshigs ltar zhing las bdag gnyer dang zhib phra'i thon skyed byed stangs skor/(1 ) lo rgyus kyi mnyam myong thog nas sa ma 'brog khul gyi zhing khar 82

phyed 'debs phyed snyal byed rgyu de sa bab kyi don dngos bstun pa/ sa rgyu zhan du mi 'gro ba rtsa ngan nyung du 'gro ba/ thocha/ 'bab mtho ba bcas yong gi yod pa red/ phyed 'debs phyed snyal byed stangs ni dper na/son khal brgya 'gro sar 'bru dang gro bsdoms pa'i brgya cha 50'debab/ kyi yod pa'i nang gro 'debs khyon bcu cha gcig gam de las nyung tsam las zin gyi med stabs gtso bo ni nas red/ brgya cha lnga yas mas khang pa'i nye 'gram sa zhing lo ltar 'debs skyong byed kyi yod pa de la sog log ces zer gyi yod/ brgya cha lnga yas mas nyung ma 'debs kyi yod pa de la lo rjes ma 'bru 'debs skabs thon 'bab dbyar snyal ba'i phu ma dang khyad par med/ brgya cha bzhi bcu snyal nas phu ma 'jog gi yod/ (phu ma zhes la dbyar snyal la zer )(2) phyugs shugs zhing las yo chas/ sa zhing rmo byed rmon g.ya ga ni rwa co dang gzugs stobs yag la gnya' shed che ba'i rmon g.yag bdams gses byed dgos/ rmon g.yag gsar pa ni rnying pa zhig la sdeb nas sbyong brdar byed dgos shing / rmon g.yag la khal g.yag gzhan las lhag pa'i bdag gces dang gso tshags byed dgos pas dpyid 'debs skabs sngo rtswa dang lja nga rtswa bster kyang chag bster gyi ma red/ dbyar snyal ba'i phu ma la dbyar slog dang po dang / gnyis pa/ gsum pa bcas rmo skabs nyin mor rmod slog brgyab cing / mtshan mor sngo rtswa yag sar 'tsho skyong byed kyi yod/ khyim dud so sor sa khying mang nyung la gzhigs pa'i rmon g.yag cha gcig gam/ gnyis/ gsum/ bzhi/ lnga 83

tsam las mang ba phal cher yod pa ma red/ (rmon g.yag cha rer dor gcig zer )rmon g.yag ni zhing kha rmo byed la bod spyod byed pa las/ khyim tshang khal shugs chung ba nyung shas phud de min khyim tshang gis rmon g.yag la 'gel spyorda byed kyi med/thong gshol/ dbyar slog gi thong gshol ni che la ring ba/ 'gram len zer ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi gshog pa che khyi/nga gshol lcags kyi ring tshad khre tse gang tsam yod dgos/ dbyar slog dang / dpyid 'debs gnyis kyi thon skyed khyad chos mi 'dra bas zhing chas mi 'dra ba re bed spyod byed dgos pa red/ zhing rmo skabs sde shob/ 'ga' shas kyis rmon g.yag dor rer rmod rgyag mkhan mi gcig dang / rmod sna khrid mkhan mi gcig dgos pa/ sde shog 'ga' shas kyis rmo khal dor rer rmod rgyag mkhan mi gcig las rmo sna khrid mkhan dgos kyi med/(3) zhing lud/ lud rgyu mi 'dra bar lud nus kyang sa 'dra bas dbyar lud la nus pa chen po yod pa red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni phyugs riḍa kyis sngo rtswa zas pa dang / char chu 'thung bar brten lud la sngo khu yod pas red/dgun lud ni phyugs rigs kyi skya rtswa skam po zas pa'i lud yin pas dbyar lud las nus pa zhan gyi red/ nyams myong gi thog nas lo sngon ma'i dgun lud/ lo rjes ma'i dbyar lud dang bsres nas bsnyal te—rul lud dri ma skyur la mdog nag cing drod tshad mtho ba'i lud de zhing khar rgyag rgyur phan nus yag shos yin pas ljang pa mthub/ la mdog kyang ljang nag 84

yong gi yod pa thon 'bab kyang mtho ba yod/ nor lud dang / rta lud ma rul ba'i skam po zhing lud du brgyab pa yin na rtswa ngan mang la ljang mdog 1ser zhing rtsa ba srab la thon 'bab dma' po red/ 'brog la thag nye sar yod mkhan gyis dgun dus 'brog pa nas ya ru dang be'u yi lud/ lug lud khal thog yul sar dbor te rta lud skam po dang mnyam du bzhag nas dbyar thog lud de ba mdzo'i phyugs khang nang bting ste nyin nyi shu yas mas re'i mtshams skam rlon bsres pa'i lud de 'don spungs thengs re byed dgos/ lud de bsnyal lud yin pas lud nus yag shos la brtsi gi red/spyir btang byas na zhing kha'i sa rgyu'i gnas tshul la gzhigs te lud nus kyang de la 'tshams pa byed srol yod/ — dper na lug lud ni sa nag chi ba'i ri zhing la skyel gyi yod pa de ni lud la drod tshad mtho bas mgo snga tsam smin pa'i phan nus yod/ gal te lukhakhrilud de sog ma mang ba'i zhing dang / gram zhing bcatha la bskyal ba yin na lud kyis 'tshig skyon byas te sdong rkang thung la snye ma chung ba bcas yong gi red/ rwa ba'i lud/ ba glang gi lud/ rta lud bcas bsres pa'i lud de ri ma thang gi gseg ma mang ba dang / gram zhing bcas la bskyal ba yin na lud kyis mi 'tshig pa'i phan nus yod/ gsang spyod nang blugs pa'i go thal mi'i btsog gcin 'dres pa'i lud de lo ltar 'debs sa'i khang 'gram sog log gi zhing khar skyel gyi yod/ lud rgyag stangs thad sa rgyu zhan sar lud mang tsaca rgyag pa dang / sa rgyu yag sar lud 'os 'tshams rgyag gi yod/ sa rgyu yag sar rgyag rgyu mang drags na mthug po skyes te nyal skyon yong gi red/ gzar babs che 85

sa'i zhing khas lud srung mi thub stabs zhing si stod la 'u da mang tsam rgyag pa de ni lud khu rang shugs su zhing gsham du 'gro gi yod pas zhing gsham du lud nyung tsam rgyag pa'am yang na lud ma rgyab na'ang 'grigs/ dbyar dus gsog bzo byas pa'i lud rnams ston khar zhing nang bskyal nas lud phung chung chung mang po bzos te phyi la sa yis khebs g.yogs nas dpyid 'debs ma ran bar bzhag gi yod/ sde shog 'ga' shas kyis dbyar slog thengs gnyis pa brgyab rjes lud zhing khar skyel gtong byas te dbyar slog thengs gsum skabs lud sa 'og la 'gro ba byed kyi red/ dgun dus gsog bzo byas pa'i lud rnams dpyid rmod ma brgyab gong phyugs khang nas phyi la bton nas lud phung chen po bzos te a slog kha shas brgyab nas rul ba bzo dgos/ lud de ston lud ma ldeng ba'i zhing khar skyel gyi yod/ lud rgyag tshad ni son khal re 'gro bar spyir btang byas na lud rgyab bcu re rgyag pa skabs re lud mang po byung dus de las mang tsam rgyag gi red/ zhing pas lud ni grangs tshad ma yin pa'i spus tshad yin zer srol yod la/ lud kyi spus tshad yag po byung na/ zhing gi sa rgyu yag tu 'gro gi red/ lud kyi 'byung khungs nang nas gtso bo ba glang / mdzo/ rta bcas kyi sbang lci yin pas de tshor bdag gces yag po byed kyi yod/ sde shog 'ga' shas la grong tsho 'ga' shas kyis rta dre'u phud/ ba glang / mdzo/ rwa lug 'bri g.yag nyung shas bcas 'tsho gnyir byed mi spyi rdze zer ba'i mi gcig glas nas khyim tshang so so'i phyugs rigs mang nyung la gzhigs te nyin grangs gtan 'khel byas nas lto chas sprod dgos pa dang / lo 'khor gla cha dang /86

dbyar dgun gyon chas bcas sprod dgos/ grong tsho 'ga' shas kyis khyim tshang so so'i phyugs rigs mang nyung la gzhigs te nyin grangs gtan 'khel byas nas khyim tshang res bskor gyis phyus/sa rdzir bskyod de phan tshun bsam 'char mi yong ba'i phyugs 'tsho bdag gnyer yag po byed kyi yod/ grong tsho nyung shas nas khyim tshang so so'i phyugs rigs so sos 'tsho gnyer byed kyi yod pa red/ grong tsho'i phyugs rigs kyis skye dngos btabs pa'i zhing khar za rnyog gtan nas mi yong ba'i bkag 'doms nan po byed kyi yod/lud skyel skabs thag ring sar khal mas dbor 'dren byed pa dang / thag nye sar mis rgyab tu khur nas zhing khar skyel ba red/(4)so/na 'bru/ son 'bru ni nas 'bru'i so kha ma gug pa dang 'bru'i me long la skyon gyis ma nyams pa/ bam rul ma song ba'i 'thu rdog che la nas rus bzang ba/ skam seng yin pa'i 'bru dgos kyi red/ gal te 'bru skam seng med pas rlon shed che ba'i son 'bru btabs pa yin na/ ljang pa thon cung sla yang gyes kha rgyag rgyu nyung pas son 'bru skam seng btabs pa'i zhing kha las cung zhan gyi red/(5) dpyid 'debs/ bod zla 2pa'i nang dpyid 'debs gra sgrig 'go 'dzugs dgos shing / dus mchungs 'brog par phyugs phrug skye bsu'i dus tshod slebs nyer brten khyim tshang so sos 'brog las la ngal rtsol nus shugs dang / rmon g.yag lud 'gel sa'i khal g.yag bcas bkod sgrig byas nas dang po rdo dang bong rdog zer ba zhing nang rdo che ba rnams gtsangasgrug byed rgyu dang / bong rdog (sa rdog )brdung rgyu bcas 87

kyi las ka zhib tshags byed dgos/ rdo chung ba rnams bsgrug gi med pa de'i rgyu mtshan ni than pa byung na phan gyi red zer srol 'dug de nas lud skyel gtor tshar rjes dpyid 'debs byed sgo bod zla 3pa'i tshes 'go nas 'dzugs dgos/ zhib phra'i byed stangs ni nam bab dro grang dang sngar gyi nyi rtags sogs la gzhigs te rmo 'debs byed kyi yod/ dpyid 'debs skabs thong gshol chung la so lcags thung ba spyod dgos shing /gal te dbyar slog skabs spyod rgyu'i thong gshol che ba spyad tshe son 'bru sa 'og gting zab par mnan nas ljang pa 'tshar rgyu cha snyoms po med par snga rjes su skyes pa/ son 'bru 'ga' shas nas ljang pa thon mi thub pa'i skyon yod pa red/gro ni zhing kha sa rgyu yag par btab na ljang pa skyes 'tshar che ba las snye mgo smin mi thub pa'i skyon yod/ gro 'debs sa ni gseg ma mang ba'i zhing dang / gram zhing bcas mgo rgyugs yag sar 'debs dgos/nyung ma'i zhing bod zla 4pa'i nang char pa babs dus dang bstun nas 'debs dgos/ nyung zhing sa slog brgyab rjes nyin bcu skor bzhag ste yang bskyar thengs gcig rmos nas nyung son gtor ba dang de nas bshal ba drud de nyung son sa 'og tu gnon dgos/ khang 'gram sog log gi zhing khar gro 'debs kyi ma red/ sog log gi zhing kha bod zla 3pa'i nang btab na rtsa ba srab la bong ske thung ba bcas kyi skyon yod pas ma tshad ston bsdu'i dus tshod ma slebs gong mgo smin zin pas bod zla 4par 'debs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de red/ dbyar snyal ba'i phu ma dang bsdur na sog 88—

log gi zhing de than pa dang sadami 'khyogs pa'i zhan cha che gi red/ dpyid 'debs byed dus son 'bru 'debs stangs gtor 'debs yin / so/na 'bru cung mthug tsam rgyag dgos/ ha cang mthug drags na nyal skyon 'gro ba dang / srab na thon 'bab zhan pa bcas yong gi red/shing nang/sa nye sar bya rigs ma nga stabs son 'bo re 'gro ba'i zhingakhar son 'bru kha snon rgyag dgos la bya dang ri dwags dgrog mkhan mi yang 'jog dgos/ dpyid 'debs skabs phyed 'debs zer ba son 'bru med pa'i dud tshang gi zhing khar son 'bru yod mkhan gyis son 'bru dang ngal rtsol nus shugs bton nas btabs thog ston bsdu'i skabs thon 'bab phyed bgos rgyag dgos mkhan dud tshang nyu nga shas yod pa red/(6) dbyar snyal ba'i zhing la rmod slog rgyag stangs thad/ dbyar slog thengs gsum dgos pa red/ phu rgod zer ba'i dbyar slog thengs dang po de bod zla 5 pa'i zla mjug nas bod zla 6 pa'i zla dkyil bar char chu che skabs rmod slog rgyag dgos/ de dus thong gshol che la so lcags ring ba bed spyod byas nas gagling zab por rmo dgos/ de 'dra byas na lo rjes mar ljang rtswa mthug la rtswa ba brtan pa/ sdong rkang sbom la snye ma che ba bcas kyi phan nus yod/ phu lan zer ba dbyar slog thengs gnyis pa bod zla 6pa'i zla mjug nas zla 7pa'i tshes 'go bar rmod slog rgyag dgos/ sum phu zer ba dbyar slo ga thengs gsum pa de bod zla 7 pa'i zla mjug nas btsas ma brngas tshar rjes rmod slog thengs gcig rgyag dgos/ gong gsal4dbyar slog thengs gsum pa gting zab mor rmo dgos shing de'i phan nus 89/de/ — ——— — ————— — zi

— ni zhing khar yug po mi rgyag pa dang rtswa ngan med pa bzo thub kyi red/ rmod slog rgyag skabs rus kha bzhag stangs/ na ma'i rus kha rjes mas gtub nasasob sob chags thabs byed dgos/ dbyar slog thengs gsum ka gtingazab ma rmos pa dang / sa zhib po med pa/ nya shor ba/ dpyid 'deb4skabs nor lud/ rta lud skam po 'debs pa bcas de 'dra byas na zhing khar rtsa ngan nang sdug shos a lo rgyu lo/ bcas skyes nas ram rtsa zhing bzang de zhing ngan zhig tu gyur ba yin na lo kha shas ring zhib las byas kyang skyar gso byed khag po yod pa red/ sde shog 'ga' shas kyis lo der nyungam btabs pa'i nyung zhing ston kha nyung ma bsdus rjes rmo slog thengs gcig rgyag gi yod/ snga lo'i nyung zhing la khyim tshang tshang mas phyi lor 'bru 'debs kyi yod pas dbyar snyal ba'i zhing kha dang khyad par med/ bod zla 6pa'i zla mjug la nyung zhing nang gi ldum bu 'thog dgos/ de ni nyung ma rdog che ba'i ched du yin/ dpyid 'debs dang / dbyar slog thengs gsum po so so'i dus tshigs ma shor ba byed dgos/(7) ston bsdu/ ston bsdu'i dus tshigs ni bod zla 7pa'i zla mjug dang zla 8pa'i zla dkyil bar yin/ /skabs der 'brog sar 'brog las byed mkhan mi nyung shas shig bzhag 'phros de byings sa shugs yongs rdzogs ston bsdu'i las kur zhugs pa dang / khal shugs mang che ba tshar ma 'gel sar bed spyod byed dgos/ mi shugs zhan sar mi lag gla dgosakyi yod/ lag cha zor ba lcags kha ring zhing gug chung ba yu ba thung ba zhig spyad nas pho mo nus shugs yag gas kyis brnga ba dang / brnga mkhan 90

mi re'i rjes su tshar ma bsdam mkhan spyir btang byas na bu mo re 'gro gi yod/ zhing brnga skabs 'phro brlag mi 'gro ba'i gtsang brngas byed dgos/brngas tshar ba'i tshar ma rnams thag ring sa nas khal thog 'dren dgos pa dang / thag nye sar mis rgyab tu 'khur nas g.yul thang la skyel gyi yod/'thu bu zer ba btsas ma brnga skabs snye mgo sa la zags pa rnams mi 'phred la gral bstar sgrig nas gtsang sgrug byed kyi yod pa red/ zhing brngas tshar ba'i tshar ma rnams sde shog 'ga' shas kyis khang pa'i thog khar brtsigs pa dang / sde shog 'ga' shas kyis rdo med pa'i spang thog g.yul thang byas nas de gar dbra zer ba'i shing khri bzos pa'i thog tshar ma brtsigs te bam rul mi 'gro ba'i ched a slog thengs kha shas brgyab ste nyi skam gtong gi yod/zhing brngas tshar rjes nyung zhing rnams bsdu dgos/(8) 'bru brdung ba'i dus tshigs mang che ba ni bod zla 10pa'i tshes 'go nas brdung gi yod/ skabs der ngal rtsol nus shugs yag shos kyi mi nyung shas shig bkod sgrig gis sde shog 'ga' shas nas g.yul kha khang thog byas te 'bru ba jung ba dang / sde shog 'ga' shas kyis dbra'i 'gram gyi spang thang la g.yul kha byas nas 'bru brdung ba/ lag cha ni shing gi dbyugs ma spyod kyi yod/ 'bru brdung tshar rjes shing gi 'phyar gzhong thog rlung 'phyar btang ba dang / de nas 'khrol mas phu rdo rnams phyes thog—yang bskyar rlung 'phyar thengs gcig btang rjes 'bru khang nang bsdu nyar byed kyi yod/(9) thon 'bab thon tshad dang bed spyod byed stangs/ sa ma 'brog 91

gi zhing khar g.yog byed dang bdag gnyer yag po byed mkhan khyim tshang la thon 'bab spyir btang brgyad skor yod pa dang / lo legs byung dus bcu skor thon gyi yod/ g.yog byed dang bdag gnyer yag po mi byed mkhan gyi khyim tshang la lnga skor dang / drug skor tsam red/ 'bru bed spyod byed stangs lo 'khor 'bru ldeng nges yod pa'i khyim tshang gis 'bru 'go ma zer ba'i 'bru dang po de son 'bru byed pa dang / 'go 'og zer ba'i 'bru gnyis pa de za 'bru/ 'bru gsum nga dang / song/ log gi 'bru bcas gzhan la ba tsong rgyu dang / bed spyod gzhan dag byed rgyu red/ lo 'khor za 'bru mi ldeng ba'i khyim tshang gis kyang 'bru dang po son 'bru byed pa dang 'bru gnyis pa/ 'bru gsum pa/ sog log gi 'bru bcas za 'bru byas thog da dung brje tshong byas nas za 'bru'i kha gsab byed dgos/ nyung ma lo rab byung dus nyung son khyor ba gang la nyung ma rkyal sgro nyi shu skor thon pa/ nyung lo gzhan skabs nyung son khyor ba gang la nyung ma rkyal sgro bcu yas mas skor thon gyi yod/ nyung ma ni 'bru rigs gron chung byed rgyur phan thogs chen po yod pas rang gi za rgyu dang / phyugs rigs gso chas ster yas bye da kyi yod/(10) zhing srung lam lub/sa skor/ grong tsho re'i khyim tshang gsum bzhi tsam nas lo ltar res bskor gyis dbyar dus lo tog srung skyob kyi 'gan 'khung nas phyugs kyis zas skyon mi yong ba byed dgos/ gal te phyugs rigs kyis zas skyor shor tshe gtan 'bebs ltar 'gel byas pa der skya lo sngo khrims zer/92

bzhi pa/ phyugs rigs kyi thon skyed ni dbyar ston dgun dpyid bcas kyi dus tshigs so so'i khyad chos ltar phyugs 'tsho bdag gnyer la shugs snon rgyag rgyu dang / rtswa thang lugs mthun gyi bed spyod byed rgyu bcas gnad cher 'dzin dgos/ lhag par du dbyar ston gnyis kyi dus tshigs ni 'gag rtsa'i dus tshigs shig yin zhing / dus tshigs de'i nang phyugs rigs kyi thon rdzas dam 'dzin/ sha shed rgyas thabs dam 'dzin/ dus thog tu sbyor sdeb byed rgyu dam 'dzin byed rgyu bcas dam 'dzin gsum po de dngos 'brel yag po 'dzin thub na lo de'i thon skyed yag po yong rgyu dang / dgun dpyid bde brgal thub pa/ lo rjes ma'i thon skyed kyi rmang gzhi yang yag po 'ding thub kyi red/ zhib phra'i byed stangs/(1 ) ra lug gi thon skyed dus tshigs dang po'i ring skye bsu byed rgyu de sa ma 'brog gi yul bab la gzhigs na bod zla 3pa'i nang yin/ re'uphrug skye bsu byed skabs ri la skyes pa'i re'u phrug rnams sgye mo'i nang ma blugs nas 'khur ba'am yang na am phrag nang bcug ste 'khyags shi ma thebs pa byed dgos/ phyugs rdzis re'u phrug skye grabs yod med sngon tshud nas shes pa byas te re'u phrug skye bsu byed dgos/ gal te sngon tshud nas ma shes pa yin na re'u dang lu gu ri la skyes nas lus pa'i nyen kha yod pa red/ re'u lug skyo ba'i rkyen gyis nu kha ma thebs na mis nu kha sbyor rogs byed dgos/ ma mo sha shed skyo ba'i rkyen gyis 'o mas lu gu gso ma thub 93 /de//de—— ——

na mis 'bri yi 'o ma chu dang bsres nas nyin kha shas kha nang blugs nas steng ba dang / yang lu gu shi ba'i ma mo dang 'o ma mang ba'i ma mo mis bzung nas lu gu skyo gras kyis nu ru bcug dgos/ skye bcu'i skabs mtshan mo re'u lug skyes 'phral 'khyags shi ma song ba'i drod srung byed dgos/ re'u lug skyes rjes nyin shas slel po'i nang la 'jog pa'am/yang na khang chung nang logs su ma bzhag par lhad rwa'i nang re'u lug che chung 'dres na mnan shi thebs nyen yod/ dgong mo lug rnams lhad rwar slebs rjes re'u lug re re bzhin mis ma re bu re bzhin ngo shes pa byas nas ma ngo bu ngo sprod dgos/ de nas nyin shas song mtshams re'u lug rnams lhad rwa'i nang 'khrab 'gro byed du bcug pa dang / de rjes lhad rwa'i nang sngo rtswa skam po gtor te rtswa bza' rgyu'i goms gshis chags pa byed kyi yod/ de rjes lhad rwa'i nye skor la sngo gsar skyes pa rnams za ru bcug gi red/ sde shog 'ga' shas nas re'u lug skyes nas nyin shas song mtshams pho rnams bya bsdam pa/ sde shog 'ga' shas kyi re'u lug skyes 'phral pho rnams bya bsdam gyi yod/ sde shog 'ga' shas kyis dbyar dkyil tsam la re'u lug pho rnams bya gcod kyi yod/dus tshigs gnyis pa dbyar gyi dus tshigs te/ de ni phyugs rigs thon skyed dngos su byed pa'i dus tshigs yin pas bod zla 4pa'i nang kha gsar zer ba lug rnams zhogs pa snga po ri la 'ded cing / nyi ma tsha rting khar lhad la bskongs nas ma mo thengs re bzhos rjes dus tshod gang 'tshams shig—lam bu thag nye sar bkram pa dang / dgong mo lug lhad rwar slebs rjes 94

thengs gcig bzhos nas ma bu thengs gcig sprad de 'o ma nus tshar mtshams mtshan mor lu gu dang re'u khang chung nang bcug gi yod/ bod zla 4pa'i nang lug gi dbo ga zer ba lte spu dang sbo spu dus tshod snga phyi ma shor ba dus thog tu 'thog dgos/ gal te dus tshod snga phyi shor na btog bde po yod pa ma red/ bod zla 4pa'i zla mjug nas zla 5pa'i tshes 'go yas mas la lug dro bskor gyi red/ de ni mar phyur mang tsam yong ched red/ mar rnams zhogs pa/ nyin dgung / dgong mo gsum la 'o ma thengs gsum 'jos shing / re'u lug rnams nyin dgung dang dgong mo ma bu thengs gnyis sprad nas dgong mo re'u lug gdang la 'dogs pa dang / nyin mo'i ring zas la bkram dgos/ dbyar khar rtswa za rgyu je mang la ba rten ra lug la'ang 'o ma bzho rgyu je mang du 'gro gi red/ de'i skabs thon rdzas la dam 'dzin yag po byed dgos/ 'on kyang re'u zhan gras la 'o ma 'os 'tshams nu ru 'jug dgos/ de 'dra byas na thon rdzas mang la re'u lug son tshad la gnod pa med pa yong gi red/ bod zla 6pa'i zla mjug tu lug la bal gsar pa ran tshad skyes yod pas skabs der lug bal breg dgos/ dus tshigs gsum pa ston ku'i dus tshigs te bod zla 7pa nas lug ma mo rnams 'o ma skam rim bzhin lu gu lug khyur bsri zhing tshang ma skam rjes nyin dgung lhad la skor mi dgos/ skabs der lug khyu rnams ri mtho sa rtswa gang yag tu lug rdzis phyin nas bdag gnyer yag po byed dgos/ ra ma rnams bod zla 10pa'i bar 'jo gi yod pa red/bod zla 7pa'i nang yu bu zer ba lu gu'i bal breg gi yod/95

lug thug ni sazugs tshad dang bal rgyu sogs lug rigs yag gras bdamyo sa pa dang / lug rigs gcib gi lug rgyud rgyun ring 'khor mi 'jug par lug rgyud ga nan gyi lug rigs 'tshol gyi yod/ bod zla 8pa shar ba nas lug thug dang ra thug gi sbyor khung la kheb 'gebs dgos/ bod zla 9pa'i nang lug thug gi thug kheb bshus nasargyud sbyor byed kyi yod/ dus tshigs bzhi pa'i dgun kha'i dus tshigs te bod zla 10pa'i nang ra thug gi kheb bshus nas rgyud sbyor byed kyi yod/ ra thug dang lug thug la kheb rgyag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sa bab kyi khyad chos las ldog ste snga tsam rgyud sbyor byas na dgun lug dang dgun re'u skyes na 'khyags shi 'gro ba/ yang na ma mos lu gu gso mi thub par mug shi 'gro ba/ sha shed zhan gras ma bu gnyis ka shi ba bcas byed nyen yod/ de 'dra yin tsang snga sbyor bkag ste dus thog rgyud sbyor byed rgyu ni ra lugagi thon rdzas dang / lu gu dang re'u gson tshad bcas la phan pas red/ ma mo mngal chags nas ma skyes bar khog la zla 6sdod kyi yod pa dang / ra ma mngal chagasanasam skyes bar khog la zla 5sdod kyi yod pa red/ dgun dus lug rnams lug khang nang du bcug pa dang / res lag dang la ga skyo gras/ ma mo skyo gras rtswa zar 'gro mi thub pa rnams la gzan pa dang nyung bsregs bcas kyi chas ster nasagaso tshagasabadag gnyer yag po byed dgos/(2) nor gyi thon skyed/ dpyid ku'i dus tshigs te bod zla gnyis pa dang gsum pa nasabe'u skye bsu byed rgyu snga rjes su 'go tshugasapas 'bri so sor be'u skye rar yod med brtag dpyad kyis mtshan mor gnyid sang po 96

byed dgos pa dang / be'u nyin mtshan ba/ duyoskyes na de 'phral 'a khyag shi mi thebs pa dang / phru srub ma thebs pa byed dgos pa ma zad/ 'bri thul ma'i be'u dang / be'u gzhan dag skyo gras la mis nu kha sbyar rogs byed dgos/ be'u skyes rjes ma dang mnyam du nyin bco lnga yas mas ri la gtong dgos shing / de dus be'u grod pa rgyags nas zhag re tsam ri la nyal sdod ring spyang ki sogs la nyen zon byed skabs phyugasardzis gzab nan gyis ri ru ma lus pa byed dgos/ de rjes 'bri rnams dgong mo lhad rwar slebs skabs be'u gdang la btags shing / phyi nyin zhogasaltar 'bri rnams thengs re 'jo gi yod/ de rjes kha gsar zer ba'i 'bri rnams nam ma langs gong ri la bkram zhing / nyi ma shar drod skabs thengs gcig bzhos nas phyi dro ma bu mnyam du ri la gtong gi yod/ 'bri yar ma rnamasasnar bzhin snga dgong dus gnyis 'jo dgos/ dbyaram̐ gyi dus tshigs nang bod zla 4pa'i zla mjug dang zla 5pa'i tshes 'go tsam la sngo rtswa za rgyu mang du song ba'i 'bri ra 'o ma 'jo yas yang mang du 'gro gi red/ de'i skabs mar phyur thon skyed byed rgyu'i dus tshigs yin pas nor dro zer ba 'bri rnams mtshan mo thengs gcig dang / dro dgung thengs gcig dgong mo thengs gcig bcas dus gsum 'jo dgos/de'ang snga gsum zer ba/ mtshan nor/ dro nor/ dgong nor gsum ka snga tsam bcug ste 'bri rnams mtshan gyi zil rtswa mang tsam bza' ru bcug na'o ma mang gi red/ 'on kyang dbyar smad nas phyi ru ma btang na 'bri mang che ba mtshan nor 'jo rgyu khag po yod/ dbyar stod 'o ma mang tsam 97

bzhos nas dbyar smad be'u skyon bral la 'o ma 'os 'tshams 'jog dgos/de ni be'u 'tshar long yong bar phan pas red/ bod zla 4pa'i nang nor la spu gsar phran bu skyes yod pas dus thog tu ze rtsid breg pa dang / khu lu 'thog dgos/ dbyar gsum lon pa'i shad pho mo'i rnga rtsid breg dgos/'bri grus ma rnams ze rtsid dang / khu lu len srol med/ bod zla 6pa'i zla smad la rtsid pa gsar rnying dbye ba'i dus tshod la khal g.yag dang skam hrag rnams rtsid pa breg cing / de rjes 'bri yar ma rnams skam rim bzhin rtsid pa breg dgos/ zla 5pa'i nang nas pho g.yag dbyar gsum dang /dbyar bzhi pa'i bya bcad nas 'gel khal byed pa dang / 'o ma mang zhing mo khrid yag pa'i nor rigs yag shos bdams nas pha phyugs la 'jog gi yod/ 'bri la rgyud sbyor byed rgyu ni bod zla 6pa nas 'go btsugs te 'bri la grus rtsa lang rim bzhin pha phyugs nor chen yod na rang shugs kyis rgyud sbyor yong ba dang / pha phyugs nor chung yin na 'bri mis 'dzin rogs byas rgyud sbyor byed dgos/ spyir btang 'bri ni lo res 'khor gyis yar re grus res yin kyang grus ma sha shed yag gras grus log rgyugs 'gro ba des lo rjes mar 'bri dang be'u gnyis ka grus ma byings las sha shed zhan gyi red zer srol yod/ 'bri la mngal chags nas zla byasdod kyi yod/ dbyar—dus char zhod che skabs nor gdang yang yang ma spos tshe gdang nang 'dam rdzab che na 'o ma 'bab tshad la shugs rkyen thebs kyi red la grus rtsa langs rgyu dal bas rgyud sbyor la'ang cung gnod kyi red/ der brten dbyar dus 'dam rdzab mi yong ba'i ched du nor gdang yang yang spo dgos pa ma zad/98

—gdang nang dang gdang zur gyi lci rnyang rnams zhogs pa snga mor gtsang ma sgrug 'phyag byas te zhib po'am/ yang na srab po byas nas nyi skam btang ste 'bud shing byed pa red/ gal te lci rnyang nyi skam gtong rgyur do snang ma byas na phyur ba dus thog 'thag las ma thub par phyur ba'i thon 'bab zhan du 'gro gi red/ dbyar ston gyi dus tshigs nang mar dang phyur ba gsog rgyur do snang dang dam 'dzin byed dgos shing / 'o mdong che ba'i nang 'o ma/ zho/ zho yi spris ma blugs te drod tshad 'tshams po byas te yun ring dkrog dgos/ de 'dra byas na mar thon 'bab che gi red/ mar bton rjes chu bcag nan po byas nas mar nang dar ra ma lus pa dang / sob sob ma chags pa byas nas rul skyon mi yong ba byed dgos/ gal te 'o ma dkrog skabs zho dang zho yi spris ma nyung ba dang / drod tshad mtho drags na dkrog yun thung zhing mar bzhu skyon 'gro bas mar gyi thon 'bab nyung ba mar bton nas chu bcag byed skabs mkhregs po med pa sob sob dang /mar nang dar ra lus pa yin na dus thung nang mar rul nas sngon po chags te bed spyod mi nyan pa yong gi red/ dar ra ni me tsha po'i nang mgyogs tsam bkol te phyur ba mkhregs po dang skyur mo mi chags pa byed dgos/'on kyang phyur khu dkrug rgyu lhod g.yeng song na phyur ba 'tshigs te thon tshad chag gi red/ phyur ba skam dus 'phral skam byas na phyur phye mi yong ba'i phan thogs yod/ dbyar kha 'o mdong che ba'i nang mar dkrog thengs rer mar 'degs khal re thon gyi red/ (spyi rgya'i mar rgya bdun red )ston kha'i dus tshigs te bod zla 7pa'i nang 'bri yar ma rnams rim bzhin skam 99

'gro ba dang / bod zla 8pa'i nang 'bri grus ma rnams 'o ma nyung du 'gro ba/zhing las ston bsdu'i dus tshigs kyang thug skabs khyim tshang ngal rtsol nus shugs nyung gras kyis nor sum dro 'jo ste snga dgong gnyis la 'jo dgos/ngal rtsol nus shugs mang gras khyim tshang gis bod zla 8pa'i zla mjug bar sum dro 'jo gi ma red/ bod zla 9pa'i nang gnam gshis grang dus nor rnams lhad rwa'i nang 'dogs pa dang / be'u rnams thog yod phyugs khang nang 'dogs dgos/ dgun kha'i dus tshigs bod zla 10pa'i nang sde shog 'ga' shas la phyugs zog cung mang ba'i khyim tshang gis khal g.yag dang skam hrag rnams phu gsum rtswa kha yag sar zog rong 'gro gi red/ des skam hrag sha shed mi shor bar phan pa ma zad/ mngal chags 'bri la skye shor mi yong bar yang phan pa yod ze bshad srol yod/ bod zla 10pa'i nang nas bzung be'u rnams la dkar thig shugs pa'i rtsam thug ster ba dang /snga dgong du nyung lo dang / sngo rtswa bcas rgyun gtan ster nas sha shed srung skyob byed pa de ni dpyid kor be'u la nad nyung ba dang / mug shi mi yong bar phan gyi red/ be'u la khebs brgyab nas drod srung byas na sgal 'bu mi rgyag pa dang / 'khyag shi mi 'gro ba yong gi red/ 'bri yar ma skyo gras la'ang khebs g.yogs nas drod srung byed pa dang sngo rtswa ster dgos/lo mang song mtshams gangs zhod che ba thengs re bab pas de dus byugs rigs skyo gras la khebs rgyag pa dang / chas dang gzan rtswa ster ba las skabs de'i spyi tshogs lam lugs kyis rkyen pas gangs 'gog phyugs srung gi 'go khrid byed rgyu dang / byed thabs gzhan dag yod pa ma red/ gangs 100

zhod che skabs sa ma 'brog tu bab cung dro ba dang / gangs bzhu cung mgyo7 pas mi tshad/ gseb rtswa dang gseb lo sogs za rgyu yod stabs phyugs rigs shi tshad 'brog khul kher rkyang las nyung gi red/(3) rta'i thon skyed skor/ bod zla 4pa dang zla 5pa tsam nang rta'i rgyud sbyor gyi dus 'khel skabs rta rgyud gcig skyar bskor byas na rta spus—zhan du 'gro bas rta rgyud gzhan dag gi rta rigs yag pa'i rta gseb yod sar rgod ma khrid nas rgyud sbyor byed kyi yod/ rte'u ma'i khog nang sdod pa'i dus tshod ni lo gcig yin/ snga lo rgyud sbyor byas pa'i rgod ma rnams rte'u skye bsu ran skabs rtswa yag sar bzhag nas lta srung gis rte'u skyes 'phral phru tshub mi yong ba dang / 'khyag tu mi 'jug pa byed dgos/ rte'u skyes 'phral rte'ur mar ster rgyu de gzugs stobs rgyas thabs red zer srol 'dug rte'u la nyin nyi shu skor ring khebs g.yogs nas drod srung byas na bshal nad mi phog par phan gyi red/ rta bed spyod skabs dgun dpyid gnyis su bed spyod byed rgyu'i rta rnams dbyar ston bed spyod nyung tsam byas te sha shed rgyas thabs byed pa dang / lhag par ston kha'i dus skabs su rta tsha rgyugs byas tshe tshil khrag 'khrug nas gnod skyon che tsam yod la gam nad phog sla po yod pa red/ dgun dpyid/ dbyar stod bcas la rta rnams bed spyod byed dgos/ dbyar kha rta rnams 'brog sar 'tsho ba dang /dgun kha rta rnams zhing khul du nyar nas zhing lud yong thabs byed pa/bed spyod byed bzhin pa'i pho rta dang rgod ma sbrum ldan bcas la mtshan khebs g.yogs pa/ sngo rtswa dang skya rtswa ster ba/ 'bru snyigs dang nyung skam 101

nyung lo bcas kyi chas rigs ster gyi yod pa red/ de min gyi rta rnams skya rtswa ster ba las chas rigs ster gyi ma red/ pho rta lo gsum phyin mtshams bya bcad de bzhon rta sbyong brdar byed dgos/ rta bed spyod byed skabs sbyong brdar ched du rgyugs dgos kyang / ha cang gis rgyugs che ba/ rgyukha yun ring ba/ dbugs ngal gso ru ma bcug pa bcas byas na/ rta nad phog sla ba/ zer ma zer ba'i glo bur gyi na tsha phog ste 'gyel nas shi ba'am nad ro chags kyi red/(4) dus bzhi'i rtswa za bed spyod dang / phyugasarigs 'tsho skyong bdag gnyer byed stangs/ phyugs rdzi yag nyes bcas 'brog las thon skyed kyi rag las sa zhig la brtsi ga yod pa ma zad/ lo 'khor dus bzhi'i nang rtswa thang bed spyod dang phyugs 'tsho bdag gnyer bcas la ga dus yin na yang lhod g.yeng ma song ba byed dgos/ phyugs rdzis phyugs rigs dang 'bral med du phyin te phyugs rigs 'grang ltogs dang / glo bur nad mnar byung rigs dus thog tu shes thub pa/ gcan gzan gyis za ba/ g.yangs la 'dril ba/ chur lhung ba sogs skyon chag mi yong ba'i sngon 'gog thub pa/ phyugs ngo gsal po shes pa/ phyugs rigs la gces skyong / nam dus kyi bab dang bstun shes pa'i nyams myong yod dgos/ phyugs rdzi mang che ba khyim tshang rang gi mi ngo 'gro gi yod/ kha shas kyis phyugs rdzi gla ba/kha shas nas bran g.yog bkol ba bcas byed kyi yod pa red/ dgun dpyid gnyis la phyugasarigs sha shed skyo zhing skyon chag shor sla ba'i dus tshigs yin pas dbyar dus nas bsri tshags byas pa'i rtswa kha yag sar phyugs rigs 'tsho 102

dgos pa dang / ri la rlung chen rgyag skabs phyugs zog nyal srid pas nyal du ma bcug par rtswa za ru 'jug dgos/ zan rtswa res bskor gyis za dgos kyi red/yar mar 'ded dus dal por 'ded dgos/ lhag par du sa drod slebs skabs lug rnams sa phug tu bskyod nas rtswa rgyud 'brad rgyur dga' po byed kyi yod stabs gtan nas 'gro ru 'jug rgyu med/ gal te rtswa rgyud 'brad par phyin na grod khog mi rgyag par sha shed zhan du 'gro gi red/ sngo rtswa thog mar skye skabs phyugs kyis sngo gsar pa za rgyur dga' yang grod khog mi rgyag pas skya sngo 'dres pa'i rtswa thang thog 'tshos nas grod khog 'grang ba byed dgos/ zhogs pa lug rnams snga tsam ri la 'ded na rtswa za yun ring bas skyo ru mi 'gro bar phan gyi red/ be'u skye bsu byed skabs be'u la spri mang tsam nu ru bcug na be'u 'tshar skyes yong rgyur phan thogs ha cang chen po yod pa red/ sngo gsar mang tsam skyes rjes be'u skye bcu'i skabs spri 'os 'tshams las mang po nu ru bcug rgyu med/ gal te spri ster mang graḍan be'ur bshal nad phog gi red/ be'u skye bsu byed skabs 'bri la nyin bzhi lnga'i ring sngo rtswa skam po grod khog 'grang nges ster dgos/ de 'dra byas na 'bri la 'o ma mang du 'gro gi red zer srol yod/ dpyid ka 'bri yar ma skyo gras dang / ma mo lo rgas song / yar ru shed skyo ba/ la ga—skyo gras sogs rtswa zar 'gro mi thub pa rnams lhad rwar nyar nas gzan chag ster nas bdag gnyer yag po byas te dpyid rgal thub pa byed dgos/dbyar kha bod zla 4pa dang zla 5pa'i skor la dbyar mtsher sa bab mtho la 103

dgun dpyid ston sogs la bed spyod mi 'tshams pa'i sa char skya sgo byed dgos shing / skabs der phyugs rigs sha shed dam 'dzin byed pa'i dus tshigs 'khel bas phyugs rigs rnams rtswa chu gang bzang dang rtsi thog 'dzoms sar 'tsho skyong byed dgos/ sa cha so sor rtswa za rgyu 'dra yang sa cha'i rtswa shugs bzang zhan gyis phyugs rigs kyi 'o ma mang nyung dang sha shed rgyas tshad mi 'dra ba'i nyams myong la do snang byed rgyu ni gal chen po yod/phyugs rigs che gras dang / be'u dang yar ru lu gu bcas so sor phyugasartsi ched 'dzugs yod pa ltar ma bu ma 'dres par do snang byas nas khag so sor 'tsho dgos/ gal te ma bu 'dres na phyugs rigs thon tshad la gyong gun yong gi yod pa red/ 'bri la mtshan mo'i zil rtswa mang tsam za rgyu yong ba byas na 'o ma mang ba dang sha shed rgyas rgyur phan pa yod/ lug dang / lu gu/ be'u/ yar ru sogs la zhogs rtswa snga tsam za rgyu yong ba byas na skye 'tshar yong rgyur phan gyi red/ dbyar smad bod zla 6pa nas sha shed dam 'dzin dang / rgyud sbyor gyi 'gag rtsa'i dus tshigs de'i nang phyugs rigs dbyar 'tsher kho na'i thog bkag bskyil byas te 'os 'tshams rang mos kyis rtswa za ru ma bcug na sha shed rgyas mi thub pa dang / grus rtsa lang dal ba'am/yang na grus rtsa lang mi thub pas sha shed shor nyen dang / rgyud sbyor gnyis kur shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs kyi red/ phyugs rigs kyis 'os 'tshams rang mos rtswa za ru bcug na grus rtsa lang mgyogs pa'i rgyud sbyor la mngon gsal gyi phan 'bras yod la sha shed dam 'dzin byed rgyur yang phan 'bras yod pa red/ da dung rgyud sbyor ma tshar na ston mtsher thog ru ba spo dgos/ ston 104

'bog thog tu phyugs rigs kyis dus tshod 'os 'tshams shig la rtswa rang mos kyis za ru bcug na rgyud sbyor rtsa ba'i cha nas byed thub pa/ sha shed yag tu 'gro ba/ 'o ma mang du 'gro ba bcas rgyud sbyor dang / sha shed/ thon rdzas bcas yag po yong bas mi tshad/ dgun dpyid brgal rgyu'i sha shed kyi rmang gzhi yag po 'ding thub cing phyugs rigs la nad nyung ba/ 'bri la sha shed chub na mngal chags kyi be'u gzugs gzhi thang ba/ skye bsu byas rjes be'u gson tshad mtho ba yong gi red zer srol yod la/ lo rjes ma'i thon skyed kyi rmang gzhi brtan tsam yong gi red/ gal te dbyar ston dgun bcas kyi rtswa thang dbye mtshams kho nar do snang byas te nor rnapos dbyar mtsher thog bkag bskyil byed rgyu nan drags te 'os 'tshams rang mos kyis rtswa za ru ma bcug na grus rtsa langs dal ba'am/ yang na 'ga' shas la grus rtsa mi lang ba/ sha shed rgyas mtshams 'jog pa/ 'bri rnams 'o ma nyung du 'gro ba bcas kyis rkyen pas lo de'i dgun kha dang / phyi lo'i dpyid ka brgal ba'i sha shed rmang gzhi zhan stabs dgun khar phyugs rigs kyi grang ngar mi 'khyog pa dang / dpyid dus sha shed zhan skabs mngal chags kyi be'u gzuḍa kyi gzhi bde thang yag po med pas skye bas byas rjes gson tshad daca 'a ba dang / pyugs rigs sha shed zhan gras la shi god mang ba bcas yong gi yod pa red/ bod zla 7pa nas lug dro 'jo mtshams bzhag tshar ba'i lug ma bu mnyam du lug rdzis snga bton phyi log byas nas thag cung ring ba'i rdza spang mtshams kyi rtsi tog yag sar 'tsho dgos/ yar mar dal por 'ded nas za 'gros byed du bcug ste lug gi sha shed rgyas rgyur mu 105— —/de/ /de— — —/de— — — —— ——

mthud dam 'dzin byed dgos/ de ltar byed thub na dgun dpyid brgal ba'i sha shed kyi rmang gzhi yag po 'ding thub pa dang / mug shi mi 'gro ba/nad nyung ba/ grang ngar 'khyog pa/ mngal chags kyi lu gu'i gzugs gzhi thang ba/ skye bsu byas rjes lu gu'i gson tshad mtho ba/ la ga sha shed yag po yod na dgun gyi grang ngar cung 'khyog pa dang / mug shi nyung ba bcas gson tshad yag tsam yong gi red/ bod zla 8pa'i zla mjug tu dgun 'tsher thog tu sbra spos rjes dgun dpyid gnyis kyi rtswa thang bkod sgrig byed dgos/ thag nye sa dang rtswa yag los nyi 'od che sar dang po be'u'i rtswa dang / de nas gangs bab skabs za yas/ dpyid ka za yas bcas rtswa thang yag gas 'jog dgos/ ston smad dang / dgun stod phyugasarigs sha shed cung yag skabs thag ring sa nas rim bzhin za 'go 'dzugs dgos pa dang / de'ang nyin ltar rtswa sa brje dgos pa las/ sa cha gcig rang la 'tsho rgyu med/ nyin shas mtshams nas phyugs rigs rnams chu 'thung rgyu yod sar 'ded nas chu 'thung du 'jug dgos pa dang / phan tshun rdung res mi yong ba byed dgos/ gal te rdung res byas na mngal chags kyi 'bri la skye bshor yong nyen yod pa red/ ston dgun gnyis la nyi ma thung stabs phyugs rigs rtswa sar 'ded rgyu ji tsam snga na de tsam gyi yag si/ red/ dgun kha gnam gshis grang skabs sa bab cung dro sar 'tsho ba dang / kha ba bab skabs nyi 'od yag sar 'tsho dgos/ phyugs rigasartswa sar yar mar ded skabs be'u'i zan rtswa dang / dpyid ku'i ster rtsa bzhag pa'i thog 'ded nas za ba'am brdzis rnyog mi yong ba'i bkag 'gog nan po 106

byed dgos kyi yod/ dgun kha bod zla 10pa'i nang skam hrag mang tsam yod mkhan khyim tshang gis phu gsum rtswa kha yag sar skam rong du bskyod nas skam hrag rnams lcaḍa rtsis grangs bsher dang 'dzoms skor byed pa tsam las lhad la mi 'jug par nyin mtshan gnyis kur rtswa za ru 'jug gi yod kyang mtshan moskam hrag rnams nyal ba lasartswa de tsam za gi med/ sa ma 'brog gi sa bab g.yang gzar che stabs gangs bab skabs dang phan tshun rdung res byas na g.yang la 'dril nyen yod pas phyugs rdzis de rtsis do snang byed dgos/(5) 'brog las kyi thon tshad dang bed spyod skor/ 'bri grus ma rer mar spyi rgya nyi shu rtsa gcig skor dang / phyur ba spyi rgya nyi shu skor/'bri yar ma rer mar spyi rgya bco lnga skor/ phyur ba spyi rgya bcu bzhi skor lug ma mo rer mar spyi rgya gcig dang phyed tsam/ phyur ba spyi rgya gnyis tsam ra ma rer mar spyi rgya rgya gsum skor/ phyur ba spyi rgya bzhi tsam bcas thon gyired/ mar bed spyod byed stangs ni/ gtso bo rang gi za mar byed pa/ khral mar sprod pa/ lhag ma yod mkhan khyim tshang gis zhing 'brog dbar brje tshong byed pa dang / da dung 'bru dngul dang thon rdzas gzhan dag dang brje tshong byed kyi yod/ phyur ba ni rang gi za rgyur bed spyod gtong ba/spu rigs sko ra/ nor rer cha snyoms byas na rtsid pa srang lnga skor dang /khu lu srang lnga skor thon gyi yod pa red/ rtsid pa ni spra yi rgyu cha byed pa dang / khu lu ni khal gdan dang sgye mo sogs kyi rgyu cha byed pas mi tshad/rtsid pa dang khu lu gnyis ka thag pa phra sbom sna tshogs dang / nor gdang gi rgyu chas byed kyi yod/ lug rer cha snyoms byas na bal spyi rgya gcig 107

dang phyed ka thon gyi yod pa red/ bal ni snam bu'i gos dang btsug phrugs kyi nyal chas/ lham 'go lham yu/ sked rag lham sgrogs sogs gyon chas kyi rgyu cha dang / ga'an yang rta gdan/ khal gdan/ phying pa/gdan sogs kyi rgyu cha byed kyi yod/ lu gu'i yu bu lu gu rer cha snyomasabyas na srang gsum re yas mas thon pa/ yu bu ni gtso bo gos phying sgor phying bcas char gos kyi rgyu cha byed kyi yod/ sa khul kha shas la ra rtsid bregs nas thag pa dang sgye mo'i rgyu cha byed pa dang / ra lug mi pags pas gyon chas bzo gi yod/ spu rigs dang pags rigs lhag ma yod mkhan khyim tshang gis zhing 'brog brje tshong la 'khyer gyi yod/ bshas gtong rgyu'i thad pho lug dang / ma mo rgan gras rnams bod zla 7pa nas dgun bshas ma brgyab bar khyim tshang so so'i lug mang nyung ltar rim bzhin bshes pa dang /dgun bshas ni khyim tshang dbal ja/ḍa ltar nor lnga nas gcig gam/ phyed ku'i ༄ ca bar bshas gtong ba dang / de rjes ra ma nyung ltar ra pho dang / ra ma rgan gras bcas bshas gtong gi yod/ nor gyi ko ba ni rkyal sgro dang / 'breng pa/lham rdog gi rgyu cha byed pa dang / be'u yar kom bu/ tsha ru bcas ni gyon chas kyi rgyu cha byed kyi red/(6) phyugs nad 'gog bcos skor/ lo rgyus nas brgyud pa'i nyams myong yod mkhan nyung shas kyis nor gyi hon nad la sngon 'gog byed thabs ni/ dkar po zer ba'i khrag blugs kyi yod pa red/ sngon 'gog de ni phan 'bras ha cang yag po yod pa/ dkar po zer ba'i sngon 'gog gi khrag de gtsod dang rgo ba la hon nad na ba'i khrag rgyun nor la sgyur ba red zer 108
