srol yod )glo rgod kyi nad la glo rgod na ba'i nor bsad rjes glo ba dkar po zhig la glo sman sbyar te bla rtsi brgyab nas sngon 'gog byed kyi yod pa des phan 'bras chen po thon gyi red/ 'jam nad la 'jam nad na ba'i nor gyi kha chu dang sman sbyar nas 'jam rtsi brgyab ste sngon 'gog byed pa/ nor chung gsum gyi mgo yur 'khor nad la smyo 'dru zhes thod pa'i rus par i khung phug yod pa/ shun pa'i phyi la mdzub mos mnan tshe mngon rgyu yod mtshams shun lpags phug nas smyo 'don dgos/ yar ru dang / lug la rtsi chang blugs te glo 'bu sngon 'gog byed dgos/ ra dang nor la rngo nad 'phog skabs chu tshan gyi chus 'khrusapa'am/ yang na dred tshil/ 'phyi ba'i tshil/lug gi tshil bcas tshil rnying pa dang / sdo sa byug nas rngo nad bcos thub kyi red/ yar ru'i rnu nad la rdo tha dang mar rnying sbyar nas byug pa yin na rnu nad bcos thub/ de min phyi nang rigs dang / tsag tsig gi nad rigs la lag bcos byed mkhan yod kyang byed thabs gang dang gang yod nga tshos shes kyi mi 'dug phyugs rigs kyi 'gos nad che ba 'ga' shas phud/de min nad rigs mang che ba sha shed zhan pa'i dbang gis ngan nad mang stabs dbyar ston gnyis la sha shed dam 'dzin dang / dgun dpyid gnyis la sha shed srung thabs byed rgyu gal che ba yin/ skabs de'i spyi tshogs nang phyugs nad sman pa zer ba med stabs phyugs rigs kyi nad rigs la sngon 'gog dang byung bcos byed rgyu'i thabs shes mang po yod pa ma red/ phyugs rigs dang mi la gnod 'tshe gtong mkhan gcan gzan spyang ki dang / dred mong / gzig dbyi/ gsa'/ phar ba bcas kyis mi phyugs la gnod 109/de/de — —/de/de—

'tshe gtong gi yod stabs me mda' dang / gri la brten nas gsod pa'am/bkag 'gog byed kyi red/ gcan gzan de dag gi pags rigs gras nas 'ga' shas la gong thang chen po yod/ spyang ki bsad rjes spyang lpags 'khyer nas spyang ki bsad sa'i rgyud du khyim tshang so so'i sgo drung du phyin tshe spyang nas zer ba'i 'bru 'os 'tshams sprod srol yod/ skabs 'gar dpyid kur spyang phrug skye skabs mi kha shas sgrig 'dzugs kyis spyang tshang btsal nas spyang phrug blangs te bsad pa'i pags pa nye skor gyi khyim tshang so so'i sgo khar 'khyer na spyang nas sam/ yang na spyang mar zer ba'i mar 'bru gang 'tshams sprod kyi yod/(7) 'brog las thon skyed kyi lag cha zho bzo/ gsog bzo/ zhozom/ mdong mo che chung / mar sgam che chung / shing gi gzar bu che chung / slel po che chung / zog gdang gi phur pa/ 'grim 'grul gyi yo chas khal sga dang / rta sga/ sbra gur gyi gzhung shing dang / ka ra/ phur pa sogs shing chas kyi rigs/ lcags ko/ 'o zangs/ 'o sdig zor ba/ 'jor/ khyem/ gri/ sta re sogs lcags chas kyi rigs/'phyar ba/ sgye sgro/ thag 'breng / khal gdan/ rta gdan phyugs khebs che chung / zog gdang / bstar thag bcas phyugs rigs kyi spu rtsid dang /ko lpags las bzos pa'i rigs/ phyugs rwa ni sa khul kha shas la lci bas bskor ba'i rwa ba/ sa khul kha shas la shing gis skor ba'i rwa ba/ phyugs rigs chung gsum la thog yod rwa ba bcas bzo gi yod/110

'dzi rnga /dus tshigs ltar zhor las thon skyed byed stangs/(1 ) dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brko ba'i dus tshigs (lag sor dang log char bar gyi dus tshigs te )bod zla 4pa'i zla dkyil nas bod zla 5pa'i zla dkyil bar yin/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu ni ri ldebs cung mthosar skye zhing ngal rtsol nus shugs yag gras nas 'jor gyis brko dgos/'bu lo yag dus ngal rtsol nus shugs yag la lag myur bde shos kyis nyin rer 'bu thur chig stong yas mas lon gyi yod/ brkos tshar rjes 'bu shun zer ba'i phyi'i rdzab bshu ba dang / de nas skam ste 'bu brgya rer chags pa brgyab ste tshong par btsong gi yod/(2) rdza nyung ni bod zla 6pa nas zla 8pa'i bar brko dgos/ rdza nyung skye yul ni g.ya' ri 'jam la mtho ba'i ldebs ngos la yod/ ngal rtsol nus shugs yag gras kyis 'jor chung gis brkos nas nyi skam gtong dgos/rdza nyung lo yag dus ngal rtsol nus shugs rab gras kyis nyin rer rdza nyung rlon pa bre lnga tsam lon gyi yod pa de dag tshong par 'tshong dgos/(3) ram pa bod zla 6pa'i zla smad nas 'thu zhing / ram pa ni spang gsham dang / lung gzhung khul gyi ri ldebs bcas la skye gi yod/ngal rtsol gyi nus shugs yod pa'i skyes pa mang che bas skor dang skor sgye zer ba'i lag cha bed spyad de 'thu gi yod pa dang / bud med rnams kyis lag 'thu byed kyi yod/ btus tshar rjes nyi skam gtong dgos/ lag 'thu 111

shing / pho gla la rnyi 'jog pa dang / me mdar brten nas gsod kyi yod/ gla ba'i sha dang pang/sa pa spu bcas bed spyod yod pas mi tshad/gla rtsi ni rin thang che ba'i sman rigs yin pas gzhan tshong byed pa/ sa khul 'ga' shas la de sngon sha ba mang po yod kyang rjes su je nyung du song ba dang sa khul 'ga' shas la sha ba gsod mi chog pa'i bkag rgya byed kyi yod stabs sha ba gsod mkhan nyung nyung red/ sha ba'i khrag rwa'i spus tshad legs shos kyi dus tshod ni bod zla 5pa'i zla mjug nas bod zla 6pa'i nang bar yin/sha ba gsod mkhan kha shas kyis me mdar brten nas gsod kyi yod/ sha ba'i sha dang / pags pa/ spu bcas bed spyod yod pas mi tshad/ sha /bye/ /rmi/ /blordo 111 /re) /bye/ /blordo /shes /spro1/ ba khrag rwa na nga ha cang ba sman gas na stabs gzhan nga byed kyi yod/(7 ) lag shes bzo las skor/ nga re'i sa ma 'brog gi sa khul kha shas la rang byung gi nags tshal yod pas nags las gang 'tshams byas te shing cha gcod breg gis khang pa'i ka gdung dang / lcam shing / sbra gur gyi ka ba/ phur ba ring thung sna tshogs/ lag cha'i yu ba phra sbom sna tshogs/ spang leb/ rta sga/ khal sga bcas bzos nas gtso bo rang nyid kyis bed spyod byed pa/ 'ga' shas 'brog khul du dbor nas 'brog las thon4 rdzas pags rigs dang brje tshong byed pa 'am/ tshwa bul sogs dang brje tshong byed kyi yod/ da dung shi nga bzo bas zhing las yo chas sna tshoḍa dang / 'brog las yo chas sna tshogs/ khyim chas sna tshogs/ thon skyed gzhan dag gi lag cha sogs bzo ba/ dngul bzo dang / rag bzo 113——/de/de— — —/de———

bas gtso bo rgyan cha dang / 'tsho ba'i yo chas gzhan dag bzo ba/ rdza bzo bas rdza chas sna tshogs bzo ba/ rdo bzo bas rang 'thag bzo ba/de min ko lpags mnyes rgyu/ gos lham bzo 'tshem/ spu rigs 'khel 'thag phying pa glings rgyu sogasarang las rang spyod dang / gzhan la 'tshong ba/ gzhan la las rogs byas nas gla len pa sogs byed kyi yod/drug pa/zhing 'brog brje tshong skor/ thag ring gi brje tshong dang / nang khul gyi brje tshong gnyis yod/ thag ring gi brje tshong la dus tshigs yod pa/bod zla 9pa nas bod zla 10pa'i zla 'go bar yin/ brje tshong 'gro mkhan mi kha shas bkod sgrig byas nas thag ring sar 'gro mkhan mi res khal ma nyi shu skor dang / nye sar 'gro mkhan mi res khal ma drug nas bcu bar 'ded nas 'gro gi yod/ brje tshong du 'gro mkhan gtso bo khyim tshang khalagyugs yod mkhan dang / tshong zog cung 'dzoms mkhan nas rkang byas gogadan dag gis de la khal zog rang 'grigs khal ma gcig nas gsum yas mas mngags bskur byed kyi red/ 'brog zhor gyi thon rdzas 'khyer nas zhing khul du brje tshong la 'gro gi yod/ brje tshong 'gro sa'i tshong ni lho kha'i zangs ri dang / gtsang khul bcas la cha mtshon na brje tshong gi thang gzhi ni khal bshasarab la 'bru 'bo bco lnga nasanyi shu bar dang / 'bri bshasal 'bru 'bo bcu nas bco lnga'i bar/ rmon mdzo rab la 'bru 'bo sum cu nas bzhi bcu'i bar/ mar 'degs khal rer 'bru 'bo gnyis re/114

tshwa tshong yag skabs tshwa 'bo brgyad la 'bru 'bo bcu re/ 'bring dus tshwa 'jal snod kha bcad la 'bru dkyil 'bur yod pa/ tha dus tshwa 'bru mgo gtugs/ bal la bal sgor chung chung gcig la 'bru 'bo lnga nas brgyad bar/ yang na bal 'degs khal rer 'bru 'bo gnyis re/ tshil 'degs khal drug rer 'bru 'bo brgyad re/ gro ma 'bo gang la 'bru 'bo do re bcas red/ lha sa'i rgyud la 'brog las thon rdzas kyi gong thang de las dma' tsam yod pa/ rgyal ston rgyud la zhing 'brog brje tshong gi thang gzhi ni sa khul de'i mar yul rgya gcig (spyi rgya gcig dang srang bdun tsam )la 'bru bre bcu/ bal rgya gcig la 'bru bre lnga/ tshwa bul bre bcu la 'bru bre bcu re/ khal bshas 'bring la 'bru 'bo bco lnga/ lug lpags/ko mnyed/ yar kom/ khu lu bcas tshong zog kha snon gyi rigs la 'bru 'os mtshams brje thub kyi yod pa red/ de min gyi tshong sa kong po'i rgyud dang / steng chen rgyud/ lcags ra dpal 'bar rgyud/ rngod gro skad rgyud bcas la 'brog zhor thon rdzas kyi thang gzhi rgyal ston las cung mtho ba yod pa red/ tshong sa gang 'dra yin rung zhing khul lo yag nyes dang /sa gnas gcig la 'brog khul tshong pa sdeb 'byor mang nyung sogs kyis thang gzhi mtho dma' sna tshogs yong gi yod pa red/ nang khul gyi brje tshong ni khyim tshang so sor mtshon na 'ga' shas 'brog las mang la zhing las nyung ba/ 'ga' shas zhing las mang la 'brog las nyung bas phan tshun yod med brje resabyed pa de yin/ de'i thang gzhi ni/ mar 'degs khal gcig la 'bru 'bo gang / khal bshas gcig la 'bru 'bo bcu yas mas/115

'bri bshasagacig la 'bru 'bo brgyad yas mas/ phyur ba 'bo gang la 'bru 'bo gang / lcags 'degs khal gcig la mar 'degs khal gnyis/nyung ma ni lug sha khog gcig la nyung ma rkyal sgro gcika mar rgya ma gang la 1/nyo /ce) /rje/ /smon /bye/ spyor (11 )rtse/nyung ma rkyal ga ga bcas byas nas ba nga da kya da pa da/gong gsal 'bri ru rdzong dang / sog rdzong gnyisasu sa ma 'brog gi sngar gyi thon skyed byed stangs dang / dpal 'byor bdag gnyer dang bed spyod brje res byed stangs skor nga tshos thog ma'i dpyad gzhi rob tsam bris pa yin/ 'on kyang nga tshor zhing 'brog thon skyed kyi shes bya dang lag len dngos kyi nyams myong ha cang zhan pa ma zad/ zhib 'jug byed rgyu'i nus pa'ang zhan rkyen don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i gnad don mi nyung ba zhig yod nges red/ zhing 'brog thon skyed kyi shes bya dang / lag len/nyams myong bcas phun sum tshogs shos sa ma 'brog gi rgya che'i mang tshogs nas zhib 'jug gis legs slob yong ba'i re 'dun zhu rgyur//phur bu bdud 'dul dang / g.yung drung rgyal ba/ nyi zla/rta mgrin/ yon tan/ bkra ba bcas kyis bris/116

—/bye lnga// /khye/ ྅:mi theg theṭa betho:reb ngas 'a la sngan du nag chu sa khul ga ming dang them grangs 'go dpon mi grangs bcas kyi tho byang /sa gnas chab gros rig gnas lo rgyas dbyad yig khang nas bsdu bagligs byas/ de sngon nag chu rdzong khong sa byang rigs shog lnga bcu nga gsum dang /sger gzhung gsar rnying tshang ma tshud bodashaṃ ba'i bcings 'grol rjes/ nag—chu'i khongs su tshud pa'i shog kha lnga cu nga bdun yod pa gsham gsal gsang gzhung la sger gzhung dgu yod pa ste/ gzhung ni sa gnas srid gzhung gi mi /ces che/ /de thego che/ :sgo /ste/theg chen ) the /ra dang ra sku drag dang da na khag ra la ra gzhung drug ni/ wa ba shog la dud grangs nyis brgya bco brgyad/ shog der brgya dpon gsum yod/ lho tha'i brgya dpon ri yang bar gling brgya dpon tshe dgram byang tha'i brgya dpon re dag bcas red/ dmar yong shog la /spre )sgo phen che/ rjes /tshe spus :rnodud grangs brgya dang shu ra/ ga kha ra brgya da na ga ga da pa ming 'ju ru/ rgan po jo chung / so che shog la them dud brgya dang bdun bcu'i skor/ shog kha der brgya dpon gnyis yod pa bstan chos dang byams pa blo gros zer/ rgan po tshe mgon thog ru shog la them dud brgyad cu skor/'tsho 1zig :spro/ /speshā /rngos 1jo 'ji 1(1shag kha dar brgya da na ga ga da pa dbang 'dus ra/ rgan dbu 117

gser bkras ljong shog la them dud bdun cu skor/ shog kha der brgya dpon gcig yod pa tshe ring rdo rje zer/ rgan po chos 'phel rab rgyas/ sems pa shog la them dud chig brgya drug bcu skor/ brgya dpon gcig yod pa spug bdag zer/ gong gsal gzhung tsho drug thog sger tsho gsum yod pa/ rtse gser gdung shog la them dud nyi shu rtsa gsum yod/ shog kha de'i 'go pa rtse phyag nang gi jo lags gcig yong gi yod pa/ de'i tshab she dpon bstan pa ye shes/ sems pa rta rdzi shog la them dud bdun cu don lnga skor/ shog kha de'i brgya dpon ngag dbang bstan dar zer/chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga dgu lor spyi zla gnyis pa'i nang ngag dbang bstan dar gyis bsod nams dbang chen kho rang gi tshab tu bskos pa red/dga' ldan ru kha la them dud brgyad cu gya lnga skor/ shog kha de'i 'go pa'i ming la spyi mi zer ba red/ de'i ming la dbang lha zer/ gong gsal sger gzhung dgu'i 'go pa gtso bo spyi khyab blo gros red/ lho ma shog drug zer ba ni/ e ne ru ba/ lho ma rang shog nang so ru ba/ me mdel ru ba/ shog rnying ma/ yongs 'dzin ru ba bcas red/ skabs der e ne'i ru shog 'go pa rda rog nor lha dang tshing bkra zer/ shog khader them dud lnga bcu nga lnga yod pa/ lho ma rang shog pa 'go pa rda rog bsod nams tshe g.yang dang / bsod nor zer/ shog kha der them dud bzhi bcu zhe brgyad lhag tsam dang / nang so ru ba shog kha'i 'go pa rda rog gong 'phel/ shog kha der them dud drug cu tsam/ me mdel ru ba shog kha de'i 'go pa rda rog tshe g.yang / shog kha der them dud bzhi bcu 118

zhe brgyad yod/ shog rnying ma'i 'go pa rda rog don 'grub/ shog kha der them dud nyi shu/ yongs 'dzin ru ba'i 'go pa rda rog bsod nams dpal 'byor/ skabs der them dud bco brgyad yod pa bcas gong gsal lho ma shog drug gi brgya dpon ni g.yu rgyal red/byang ma shog drug ni/ stag ring dang / stag gsar a kong ru ba/ ba ring ru ba/ brgya dpon ru ba/ bya rig ru ba bcas red/stag ring ru ba'i 'go pa dpon o rgyan zer/ shog kha der them dud chig brgya nyi shu tsam dang / stag gsar ru ba'i 'go pa dpon bsod rgyal zer/ shog kha der them dud lnga bcu tsam yod/ a kong ru ba'i—'go pa rda rog rgyal mtshan zer/ shog kha der them dud lnga bcu tsam—yod/ ba ring ru ba'i 'go pa rda rog dona'agrub/ shog kha der them dud nyi shu lhag tsam/ brgya dpon ru ba'i 'go pa rda rog bstan rnam/shog kha der them dud sum cu tsam yod/ bya rig ru ba'i 'go pa rda rog—bkra nor/ shog kha der them dud dgu tsam bcas yod/ gong gsal—byang ma shog drug gi brgya dpon nor dar zer/ byang rigs khongs sger pa shog brgyad yod pa ste/ dbu tog mi ser—'go pa dpon tshe dpag zer/ shog kha der them dud rig brgya lnga bcu yod/ khri ba ru ba'i mi ser 'go pa dpon dgra tshe dang tshe ring don 'grub—gnyis red/ skabs der them dud chig brgya bcu med lnga tsam yod/bstan rgyas gling mi ser 'go pa dpon dpa' rgyal/ shog kha der them dud drug bcu skor yod/ kun bde gling mi ser 'go pa rgan po tshe thar 119

red/ skabs der them dud nyi shu skor yod/ grwa tshang ru ba mi ser 'go pa dpon lha rgyal zer/ skabs der them dud sum cu gser khang mi ser 'go pa dpon rdo rgyal/ skabs der them dud bcu drug rgya ma ru ba'i 'go pa dpon blo bzang / skabs der them dud bcu gcig rdo ring ba'i mi ser 'ako pa/ dpon lha rgyal/ shog kha der them dud bdun cu yod pa bcas de rnams sger pa shog brgyad zer/bar tha sger gzhung dgu yod pa ste/ sde gsar shog kha'i 'go pa brgya dpon rgod po'i stobs rgyal dang dbang rgyal gnyis red/ shog kha der them dud chig brgya brgyad cu gya bdun yod/ ru chen shog kha'i 'go pa brgya dpon me mdel dgra 'dul dang / sman rgyud gnyis red/ shog kha der them dud chig brgya drug cu re bzhi yod/ sbu thar shog kha'i 'go pa brgya dpon rgyal mtshan dang / dngos grub gnyis red/ shog kha der them dud dgu bcu lhag tsam yod/ dbyis chen shogakha'i 'go kha brgya dpon nos nag bdag dang ka la/ co ka gsum red/ shog kha der them dud bdun cu skor yod/ dbyis chung shog kha'i 'go pa brgya dpon gsum dar dang / rgyal po gnyi sa red/ shog kha der theca/ dud bzhi bcu nas lnga bcu bar yod/ gung skor shog kha'i 'go pa gong skyabs dang / de 'og brgya dpon nor bzang / o rgyan lhas/ a nyi nga bsod nams dbang 'dus ba cas bzhi yod/ shog kha der them dud drug cu skor yod/ rigs spyi shog kha'i 'go pa rgan po zer ba de yin ming gnam sras zer/ shog kha der them dud sum cu skor yod/ g.yu thog 120

shog kha'i 'go pa bso rgyal/ shog kha der them dud su ma cu sko ra yod/stag sde shog kha'i rago pa ming la rgan po zer de ni rdo rje red/ shog khader them dud nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod/ sger gzhung dgu'i spyi'i 'go pa bar tha jing ger dbang 'dus phun tshogs nged/hor smad shog bzhi ni/ ru snying / ru gsar/ che 'bum 'khor mang bcas red/ ru rnying shog kha'i 'go pa dpom yar 'khel dang / dpon rgya mtsho gnyis red/ shog kha der them dud chig brgya bzhi bcu lhag tsam yod/ che gsum shog kha'i 'go pa/ dpon rtsub bdag zer/ shog kha der them dud nyis brgya skor yod/ ru gsar shog kha'i 'go pa dpon bstan 'dzin rab rgyas/ shog kha der them dud chig brgya skor yod/ 'khor mang shog kha'i 'go pa dpon rgyal mtshan nor bu shog kha der them dud bdun cu skor/ rong po mi ser shog kha'i 'go pa dpon nyi ma 'od zer/ skabs der them dud chig brgya bzhi bcu yod/a mdo shog brgyad/ da lta a mdo rdzong / a mdo stod ma la khral dud lnga brgya yod kyang dmangs gtso'i bcosabasgyur byed skabs khyim dud chig stong tsam thon pa red/ de'i khongs su khang ser shog kha zer ba khyim dud drug cu re bzhi tshud yod/ dpon rgan pa rin chen g.yang 'grub rus ming ga bya/ dpon gzhon pa khang ser shog kha'i dpon gcig lcog nor bsam rus ming klu zog de ni chig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu nga bdun lor stod ma'i dpon gzhon pa ngag tshe brje 'then zin rjes su nor bsam 121

bskos pa red/ a mdo stod ma/ shog kha gcig la nang khul shar nub gnyis yod pa red/ nub ma'i rgan po dbyang nyor dang lha rgod gnyis red/shar ma'i rgan po ma 'dis don rnams dang / ga rgyab shig ris gnyis red/dmag dpon ma gtab dbang rnam dang / li ba bu dga'/ mgar ba 'brug skyabs/ gung dpon 'khor mo bcas bzhi ni shar ma'i khongs su sdod kyi yod/ gong gsal khang ser shog kha zer ba de ni skabs der tā la'i mdzod sbug gi mi ser red/ dpon gong nas gsal/ rgan po bkra bsam red/ a mdo smad ma la khyim dud nyis brgya bzhi bcu skor yod/ dpon rgan pa lha mchog dang / gzhon pa dbang 'phel gnyis kyi rus ming ga gya red/ rgan po no no dang / bkra bsam/ dmag dpon 'khor tu bskyod pa dang / rdo rje nyi ma/ bu bsod nams/seng chen bcas bzhi red/ a mdo rgya mtsho ru ba khyim dud chig brgya nyi shu skor/ dpon ga rgya 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang bsod nams dbang rgyas/ rgan po ngag dbang byang chub/ cig dga'/ blo bu/ bsod rgyas/ a jo bcas red/ a mdo se rdor khyim dud chig brgya lnga bcu skor dpon dung skyabs rus ming se rdor/ rgan po nag ril/ a jo khra bdag dmag dpon bshad grub dang nor bsam/ a mdo bkra ru khyim dud cheg brgya bzhi cu skor/ dpon o rgod/ rus ming ga bya/a mdo shog chen khyim dud chig brgya skor/ dpon ngag dbang ye shes rus ming rtogs/ rgan po rta mgrin rgyal po dang / blo chos/ a mdo shog chung khyim dud chig brgya nyi shu lhag tsam dpon tshe dgram a mdo 122

ga bya khyim dud chig brgya skor/ dpon pad rnam rus ming ga bya/ sgrub khang bla brang si mi ser 'go pa bsod nams dbang 'dus dang / byams phun gnyica/ red/ der them dud chig brgya lnga cu skor yod sngar byang shog gsum zer ba ni/ 'jam kha gshi tha dbyug tha gsum red/ 'jam kha shog kha'i 'go pa/ bcu dpon tshe stobs red/ de 'og dmag dpon gsum yod pa ste rgod po/ dbang chen/ dgra 'dul bcas red/shog kha der them dud chig brgya bzhi bcu skor yod/ gshi tha shog kha'i 'go pa bcu dpon bde chen lhun grub/ de 'og dmag dpon bzhi yod pa ste/ sgrub chog 'ju ru/ dar rgyas/ dpa' lo bcas red/ shog kha der them dud chig brgya sum cu skor yod/ dbyug tha shog kha'i 'go pa bcu dpon don 'grub dang / de 'go dmag dpon bzhi yod pa ste/ rdo rje dang byams pa/ man 'gog bzang 'gog bcas red/ shog kha der them dud drug cu skor yod/ gong gsal shog gsum dang / yam ji shog la dud grangs dgu cu skor dang / 'go pa bcu dpon/ tshes bzang bcas ni de sngon 'daca/ rgya shog brgyad kyi gras red/shan rtsa rdzong khongs nag tshang gi de sngon tsho shog dang / them grangs 'gopa rgan po so so'i ming bcas bsgriḍa pa/ thog mar gzhung sger dbye na gzhung khongs la tsho bcu gcig dang / sger chos che btsan gyi khongs tsho bdun bcas bsdoms nag tshang sger gzhung tsho khag bco brgyad yod pa la/ thog mar gzhung khongs tsho dpon tshe rta byang bsdom tsho gcig la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur sngon tshod rtsis byas na them grangs nyis brgya tsam la rgan po 123

bzhi yod pa ste/ rgan po dbang tsheng / rgan po lnga sa'i job rdor/ rgan po rgyal po bcas dang gzhung smad shog bzhi la them grangs chig brgya dgu bcu tham pa la/ rgan po bzhi yod pa ste/ smad pa rgan po bu chung / gzhung smad rgan po bka' 'gyur ma yo rgan po ra ba btsan po/ 'tsho sgril rgan po nor bu bcas red/ rta khro shog gnyis la them grangs chig brgya sko ra dang rgan po gnyis yod pa ste/ rgan po bkra shis don 'grub/ rgan po bkrashis tshe ring bcas red/ sang ser shog gnyis la them grangs chig brgya bdun cu skor la/ rgan po gsum yod pa ste/ rgan po rgya kog skal bzang rgan po mag pa dbang 'dus/ rgan po nang so/ tshe rnam/ phyug tsho shog gnyis la them grangs chig brgya drug cu skor dang / rgan po gnyis yod pa ste/ rgan po dkyil gsum em rje bsod nor rgan po yo tshang bsod nams don 'grub bcas dang / dpon stod shog gsum la them grangs chig brgya dgu cu skor yod pa la/ rgan po gsum yod pa ste/ rganapo gu ru/ rgan po dkon mchog dgra 'dul/ rgan po dbang 'dus rin chen/ la stod tsho gcig la shog kha lnga yod pa der/ them grangs nyis brgya yod pa da nga rgan po lnga yod pa ste/ rgan po 'dar ba smad/ rgan po phun tshogs rgan las khyed 'khur byas pa/ rgan chung byams pa dang /rgan chung snyan grags/ rgan po'i las tshab srid gcod grags pa bcas red/ 'om po tsho gcig la zhib gsal gzhung 'a/phod rgan po gnyis yin na'ang / tsho der zhing 'brog gnyis yod par brten rgan po gcig spyi khyab rgan po dang / rgan po gzhan zhig rgan po rkyang ma yin la mi tshos 'om 124

po'i rgan chen rgan chung zer srol yod/ rgan chen skyer sgril dpon tshang gi go mag bstan pa tshe ring rgan chung ni pha cho stag lha gnyis red/ 'om por zhing 'brog them grangs chig brgya lnga bcu skor dang / rtsa shog gsumayod/ gom nag tsho pa zhes tsho khag bcu drug yod pa'i nang che shos yin pa der them grangs brgyad brgya la zhib gsal gzhung 'khod rgan pa bzhi dang las bya lta bu'i rtsa dpon bzhi bcas yod pa ste/ rgan po gtsang pa mgon po/ rgan po/ rgan po gtsang pa co skang/ rgan po mus pa rdo rje bzhi bcas red/ rtsa dpon rgyud chung dbang grags rtsa dpon ya mgon/ rtsa dpon tshe ring mgon po rtsa dpon thag nag gang skyabs bcas so / gro dpal tsho gcig la shog gsum rtsam la them grangs chig brgya brgyad cu skor der rgan po bzhi yod pa ste/ rgan po zhang gzhung dang dpal 'byor rgyal po/ rgan po khri bzang rgyal po/ rgan po rtsa khag dpal ldan/ rgan po gnam sras bcas red/ dkar tsho zhes pa phyugs zog dkar nag cung mang tsam yod la/ khyug tsam gyi dud tshang mang ba las dbul po'i dud tshang drug las med pa brten dkar tsho'i phyug sde mar khu zhes 'bod srol yod/ tsho der them grangs chig brgya nyi shu tsam dang / rgan po gnyis yod pa ste/ rgan po g.yang tshe ring dang / dbu ril gcung ma bcas gong gsal tsho khag bcu gcig la zhib gzhung gong don gzhung bkod rgan po sum cu so drug yod pa tsho pa re zung la zhi drag ar gsum zhes pa ni zhi ba la khral/ drag po la dmag ar pa la 'u lag bcas zer ba'i don yin/ spyi khyab yod pa tsho pa/ gom nag spyi khyab blo bzang / 125

phyug tsho'i spyi khyab co dran pa/ gzhung smad spyi khyab ra ba mthong nga don 'grub/ sger cho'i 'go dpon ser ra bla spyi khongs/ sger ba dang chung la shog gnyis la them grangs chig brgya bdun cu/ 'go pa gnyer pa zhes pa 'bod srol yod/ gnyer pa dbang rgyal dang / gnyer pa dpal 'byor bcas red/ ser ra bla spyi khongs sger gser ba gzhis chags tsho la them grangs lnga bcu skor la/ 'go pa chos bzang sger ngor rba gang them grangs brgyad cu la/ rgan po tshe dbang rab brtan/ sger ri rgyu tsho gcig la them grangs lnga cu/ rgan po gcig yod pa rdor phun/ sger so hrug la them grangs nyi shu skor/ rgan po lhun grub dbang rgyal/ sger ser zhig ces de sdon ser zhig dgon gyi chos gzhis yin yang / bar lamadagon la dkar me tsam phral sdu khrims gnon tshang mar sang ser khongs gcig mtshungs la them grangs bzhi cu skor zhig la 'go 'dom ser dgon spyi so nas byed srol yod/ gong gsal dang chung stod smad gnyis tsho chung la brtsis sger tsho bdun dang / gzhung tsho bcu gcig la nag tshang sger gzhung tsho khag bco brgyad ces 'bod par tsho bco brgyad la/ spyi 'dom nag tshong 'go pa lhan drug sgril zhes lhan drug ni rdzong dpon gnyis/ rdzong shar shod drung tsha sde gzhon pa/ rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ rdzong nub 'bras bsam blo khang / mtshan dge 'dun phun tshogs/ spo bo a kun gom nag khongs/ tsho dpon dbang grags gzhung smad khongs/ sgar dpon o rgyan la stod khongs/ sgar dpon gzhan zhig go gnas phyed bgos kyi mi gnyis bzos pa gcig sgar dpon tshe ring dbang rgyal dpon tsho 126

khongs/ gcig lho ba dpal dga' dpon stod khongs/ shing rta lo nas bzung spyi rgan dmangs bcas kyi spyi 'thus zhig gsar bkod la/spyi 'thus 'jam dpal la stod khongs/ tsho drug ces nang don tsho bco brgyad la dgra jag rkun gsum dang / lhag par sa gnas srid gzhung gi thag gcod bzhin lag thel yod pa'i thon dang po zhes rta dmag nyis brgya tham pa dang / thon gnyis pa zhes yul dmag sum brgya la/ dmag gi brgya dpon bzhi yod pa/ brgya dpon blo bzang gom nag khongs/brgya dpon gang skyabs gom nag khongs/ brgya dpon bu chen gzhung smadakhongs/ brgya dpon phun bdun dpon tsho khongs bcas red/ shan rtsa khongs rdza phyogs zhes shog gcig yod pa ste nang don rdza srib la dpon khongs gzhung bla gnyis/ gzhung khongs mar kyang khongs them grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga skor la/ 'go dpon rgan po smra ba tshe ring rdo rje dmag dpon don tshang skal bkras/ phyogs bcu smad ni gzhung bla brang phyag mdzod kyi she sde yin pa/ them grangs bzhi cu skor yod pa la/ she dpon em rje dgra lta/ de sngon bkras lhun bla brang gi rta nag rin rtse gzhis khongs kyi g.yag pa/ khru ma drug cu zer bar nang gses phye na shog kha bcu yod pa ste/ g.yag pa blon po/ 'grung pa/ nyang ra/ khra tshang mu thigakha tsha/ grum bu/ gnam srib/ thar ma 'jag rol bcas red/g.yag pa blon po shog la dud grangs nyis brgya sum cu tsam dang de'i 'go pa dmag dpon g.yang skyabs/ de 'og 'khru dpon snyi lung bkra shis nyi ma dang / rgan zur chos 'khel/ 'tshab la'i bka' 'gyur/ mtsho 127

smad/ bkras tshe sogs red/ 'grung pa shog khar dud grangs chig brgyasum cu/ skor la 'go pa 'phru dpon rtse g.yag jo rgyas dang / a ra rta mgrin/ bo tho'i sri thar tshe ring bcas red/ g.yag pa nyang ra shog la dud grangs chig brgya bdun cu don drug tsam/ 'go pa dmag dpon lhu ru pa che 'phru dpon gcig lcog dang / de 'og 'phru dpon bdun yod pa ste/ mag pa rdo rje/ tshe ring dngos grub/ dga' skyel/ rdo dbang /g.yag mgon/ dga' so rdo rje tshang pa'i gso le/ khra tshang shog kha la dud grangs drug cu re bzhi tsam/ 'go pa dmag dpon gu rub sum pa 'phru dpon gcig lcog 'phru dpon bsod nams snyan graḍa/ mu thig shog la dud grangs lnga bcu nga lnga/ 'go pa dmag dpon rgya lha 'phru dpon gcig lcog de 'og 'phru dpon bsod rdor dang / dgra lha/ rtam rdor bcas red/ba tsha lnga sgrig shog la dud grangs brgyad cu tsam 'go pa snyas dpon zla tshe 'phru dpon gcig lcog dmag dpon 'khar phun/ 'phru dpon dbang rgyas/'phru dpon lha tshogs/ 'phru dpon phyag chung / 'phru dpon phyag chen rdo rje bcas red/ grum bu shog la dud grangs chig brgya bcu med gnyis skor 'go pa dmag dpon bson spen/ 'phru dpon tshe ring dbang ma/'phru dpon dgra 'dul rdo rje/ 'phru dpon chos grags/ gnam srib shog khar dud grangs drug cu re brgyad tsam la/ 'go pa spyi khyab las bya g.yag pa dgra 'dul 'phru dpon gcig lcog 'phru dpon gnyis bcas yod/ thar ma shog khar dud grangs bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam/ 'go pa dmag dpon 128

phun tshogs dbang phyug 'phru dpon g.yag pa tshe phun no/ 'ab/ra ba tshe reng do dzo/ 'jag rol shog kha nang gses shog kha drug yod pa ste/'jag rol byang ma shog la dud grangs bzhi cu slor/ 'go pa dmag dpon sri chod tshe ring / 'phru dpon tshe rnam/ 'phru dpon tshe ring don 'grub/ 'jag rol lho ma la dud grangs nyi shu rtsa brgyad tsam dang /'go pa dmag dpon o rgyan dang / tshe mgon gnyis phyag sgril/ de 'og 'phru dpon glen pa mgon po dang / 'phru dpon tshe ring mgon po/sgob spa shog khar dud grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam/ 'go pa dmag dpon bsam tshe 'phru dpon gcig lcog 'phru dpon brgya zur bkras dbang /sngo tshogs shog khar dud grangs bco lnga 'go pa 'phru dpon bu chung / mun rtu shog khar dud grangs bcu gsum/ 'go pa dmag dpon sri gcod dgra 'dul/ rdza srib shog la dud grangs bco lnga skor/ 'go pa 'phru dpon sba chen rin chen bcas so/ gong gsal g.yag pa 'phru ma drug cur spyi 'dom 'go pa spyi mi dgu yod pa ste/ gong rim ltar na/ rgan po bzhi ni 'jag rol rtag rgan po bsod nams rdo rje/ blon po'i rgan po sde khang chos 'phel/ rgan po bkra shis dbang ma/ khra tshang rgan po tshe rnam dang 'grum bu bkra shis rdo rje gnyis rgan las khyed khur byas pa rgan rkang gcig sgar dpon gnyis ni khra tshang sgar dpon bsod nams dbang 'dus thar ma sgar dpon zla tsheng / brgya dpon gnyis ni grum bu brgya dpon bkra shis rdo rje/ 'jag rol brgya dpon blo ba/ gnam srib spyi khyab skar ma bstan phun bcas dgu yod/ g.yag pa blon po dang / 123

nyang ra/ 'grung pa/ shog gsum ni da lta gzhis rtse kron chus kyi bzhad mthong smon shan khongs la yod/ de sdon bkras lhun bla brang gi bzhad mthong smon gzhis ku'i khongs kyi 'brog kham dol sger gsum la khyon bsdomasashog kha sum cu so gcig yod pa der shog chen bzhi yod pa ste/ dol ba shar ma shog brgyad dang / bar gling shog pa bzhi/ lho ma shog brgyad la rgyab shog bcu gcig bcas yod/ shar ma shog brgyad kyi nang gses zho sde shog la dud grangs chig brgya drug bcu skor/ 'go pa ru dpon mgon phun zad pa shog la dud grangs chig brgya lnga bcu skor/ 'go pa ru dpon lho bsod/ zhu ru shog la dud grangs chig brgya bzhi bcu tsam/ 'go pa ru dpon o rgyan/ sngo rag shog la dud grangs brgya dang nyi shu skor/'go pa bcu dpon sngo tshang tshe brtan/ shing skun shog la dud grangs bdun cu/ 'go pa tsho dpon phun bkras/ kham phra shog la dud grangs sum cu skor/ 'go pa rgan po gzhis ka dbang 'dus phying 'thul shog khar dud grangs bdun cu/ 'go pa rgan po rig 'dzin/ na mo che shog la dud grangs bdun cu tsam/ 'go pa rgan po khri tshang mig dmar dang / gong mo bkra shis bcas red/ bar gling shog khar nang gses/ 'khyags bon shog la dud grangs chig brgya sum cu tsam/ 'go pa rgan po drung don dang / sri med/ dol sgro shog khar dud grangs bzhi bcu skor/ 'go pa rgan po rdo rje dpal/ 'dam skyed shog khar dud grangs chig brgya bcu skor/ 'go pa/ rgan po rdor rnam dang / bsod nams bstan pa/ dgon sbrug shog khar dud grangs sum cu tsam 'go pa rgan po bsod rtam/130

lto ma shog brgyad kyi nang gses/ kham lho shog khar dud grangs sum cu skor/ rdza khog shog khar dud grangs nyi shu tsam/ rdza lhas shog khar dud grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga skor/ 'go pa rgan po rta mgrin/ nas res shog 4khar dud grangs nyi shu skor/ 'go pa rgan po lha dar/ snar thang shog khar dud grangs sum cu skor/ 'go pa rgan po chos dbyings/ tsho bzhi shog la dud grangs bzhi cu tham pa/ 'go pa rgan po seng rtog stobs rgyas dang tsho rtsis lha don/ byis chung shog la dud grangs sum cu skor/ 'go pa rgan po yi dam/ byis chen shog la dud grangs sum cu tsam/ 'go pa rgan po nam langs/ star sgo la rgyab shog kha'i nang gses la smad shog la dud grangs chig brgya sum cu tsam/ 'go pa rgan po rtam bzang rta thog shog la dud grangs bdun cu tsam/ 'go pa rgan po dar rgyas steng thang shog la dud grangs drug cu skor/ 'go pa rgan po bsam gtan/byis 'thor shog la dud grangs sum cu tsam/ 'go pa rgan po dkon mchogal lo shog khar dud grangs chig brgya bdun cu tsam/ 'go pa rgan po rgya ba'i dbang phyug ru gsar shog dud grangs sum cu/ 'go pa rgan po yon tan/ bar la shog khar dud grangs sum cu/ 'go pa rgan po pad+ma/la byang shog khar dud grangs chig brgya brgyad cu tsam/ 'go pa rgan po stobs rgyal/ nyag lto shog khar dud grangs bzhi bcu tsam/ 'go pa rgan po mkhyen pa/ nyag gzhung shog khar dud grangs drug cu skor/ rgan po dbang chen nyag byang shog khar dud grangs lnga bcu skor/ 'go pa rtsis dpon nor rgyas/ gong gsal kham dol/ sger gsum gyi 'go pa gtso 131

bo spyi khyab tsho dpon bakhyi dang / sgar dpon bani yod ba ni/ shar—ma'i tshe dpon rim bzhi chos 'phel/ sgar dpon rim bzhi bsod nams nor bu/ yang rim bzhi bsod nams don 'grub/ bar gling tsho dpon skal bzang sri gcod dang / sgar dpon stag rgyal/ lho ma'i sgar dponashes rab dang / nor rten/ la rgyab shog kha'i tsho dpon rim bzhi be ri mgon dang / yang tsho dpon rim bzhi mkhas grub/ sgar dpon rim bzhi stobs rgyar 5 bcas red/ gong gsal nas da lta nya ga shog mnga' ris kyi mtsho chen shan khongs la yod pa dang / la rgyab kyi shog kha bdun/gzhis rtse kron chus kyi ngam ring shan la yod/ steng thang shog kha da lta lha rtse shan khongs yod/ lho ma shog brgyad dang / shar ma'i na che dang 'phying thul shog kha gnyis bzhad mthong smon shan khongs yod pa/ bar gling shog bzhi'i dgon sbrug ngam ring shan khongs yod/ de 'phros nag chu kron chus kyi 'um bu khru'u dang / shan rtsa shan/ dpal mgon shan bcas la yod/de sdon gnam ru spyang lung rdzong khongs/ gnam ru 'du khongs bcu gsum zer srol yod kyang dngos su tsho pa bcu gcig las yod pa ma red/ nang gses sa gnas srid gzhung gi gzhung tsho bdun dang / sger tsho bzhi yod pa ste/ gzhung tsho bdun ni ring pa shog kha dang se kha shog kha/ ljongs nag shog kha/ ljang ru shog kha/ gnam chen shog kha byang tsho lnga dang / del phyin shog kha dang / bdun bag shog kha la lho tsho zer gyi yod/ sger tsho bzhi ni/ sgo mang shog kha ni 'bras spungs sgo 132

mang grwa tshang gi mi ser yin pa red/ gnam chung shog kha 'bras spung rig spyi'i mi ser red/ sha khra shog kha gzim shag bshad sgra'i mi ser/ sger lde shog kha mtshur phu mchod khongs 'og gi mi ser red/ ring pa shog khar dud grangs sum cu tsam/ 'go pa bcu dpon mig dmar dang / dmag dpon rdor rdir se ba shog khar dud grangs bzhi brgya lnga bcu skor 'go pa rda rog chos dbang / bcu dpon thog rdis/ de'i las tshab btsan rgod/ se ba stod ma'i dmag dpon don 'grub/ las cha pad rnam se ba nyi ma'i dmag dpon o rgyan/ las cha bsod nams rin chen/se ba smad ma'i dmag dpon dge 'dun/ las cha rgyal po bcas dang / ljongs nag shog la dud grangs chig brgya brgyad cu tsam/ 'go pa rda rog bstan 'dzin/ bcu dpon spug 'jig dmag dpon jo spel/ ljang ru shog kha dud grangs dgu bcu skor/ 'go pa rda rog g.yu lha bcu dpon phun tshe/ dmag dpon kun bsam/ gnam chen shogakhar dud grangs chig brgya tsam/ 'go pa rda rog a 'jig bcu dpon dpal 'byor/ dmag dpon a mis del phyin shog khar dud grangs nyis brgya skor/ 'go pa rda rog tshe brtan bcu dpon gcig dmag dpon smanalha/ bdun bag shog khar dud grangs nyi shu skor/ 'go pa rgan po gu ru tshe ring / sgar sde shog khar dud grangs bzhi cu skor/ 'go pa rda rog ngang rab dang dmag dpon dgra 'dul/ sgo mang shog khar dud grangs brgyad cu tsam/ 'go pa rda rog jo gnyer bcu dpon mi rgod/ gnam chung shog khar dud grangs lnga cu skor/ 'go pa rda rog dgra 'dul bcu 133

dpon pad+ma/ dmag dpon phur bu/ bshad sgra shog la dud grangs chig brgya lhag tsam/ 'go pa rgan po g.yang 'grub/ bcu dpon bstan 'dzin dngos grub/ dmag dpon nor dgra bcas gong gsal gnam ru'i 'du khongs kyi spyi 'doms sgar dpon gcig yod pa ni ring pa'i bstan pa red/ de sngon bla brang nang sgang gi mi ser shen sger 'phru ma bco lnga zer bar bsdoms dud grangs nyis brgya sum cu skor yod pa nang gses lnga tsho gsum yod pa ste/ stod kyi chab 'gor lnga tsho la/ rtsa stod 'phru ma/ de'i 'phru dpon dar po/ dmag dpon gcig lcog gla nub 'phru ma/ 'phru dpon g.yag pa rin chen/ gla shar 'phru ma 'phru dpon g.yang 'bas bsod rgyal/ ngang chung 'phru ma/ 'phru dpon skal bzang / thar spyang 'phru ma/ 'phru dpon gram pa'i tshe ring dbang 'dus bcas dang / bar gyi maṇa thang lnga—tsho la/ sma smad 'phru ma lasa'aphru dpon sba nyor nyor dmag dpon gcig stog sma stod 'phru ma/ 'phru dpon bya ba'i phun tshogs dbang 'dus/ rtsa smad 'phru ma/ 'phru dpon gnam —ru g.yang skyabs/ thar lho 'phru ma 'phru dpon stobs rgyal 'bo stod 'phru ma 'phru dpon g.yag pa'i g.yungal smad kyi sto lam lnga—tsho zer bar klu steng 'phru ma 'phru dpon klu steng—rta dbang / 'phru gsar 'phru ma 'phru dpon dge gnyer sa la lam 'go pa gcigasalcog rgan rnying 'phru ma 'phru dpon rgan rnying dkon mchogadang / em rje bstan 'dzin/sto bar phrid 'phru ma 'phru dpon dbang 'dus/ 'bo smad 'phru ma 'phru dpon—dkon mchog 'gyur med bcasa'i spyi 'dom 'go pa gtso bo nangakonang gi 134

rim bzhi dang / rgan chen gcig lcog rta ru zla ba lha rgyal dang rgan chung klu steng rta dbang bcas red/ geng gsal gshen sger shog kha da rti dpal mgon shan khongs yin/ de sngon phying lung rdzong khongs 'dam sa skya tsho bdun ni/ sbra 'char dang / bya rig she ma/ kre ma/ sde rnying /sde rab/ shog phyed bcas yin/ spra 'char shog la dud grangs chig brgyabacu yod/ 'go pa bcu dpon bsod nams lhun grub/ shul gling stobs chen/ dmag dpon bsod nams rdo rje/ bya rigs shog khar dud grangs dgu bcu/ 'go pa bcu dpon bsod nams stobs rgyal/shul gling nor pa/ dmag dpon skal nor/ she ma shog la dud grangs brgyad cu/ 'go pa bcu dpon bstan dgram shul gling chos skyabs/ dmag dpon jo skal/ kre cog la dud grangs brgyad cu/ 'go pa bcu dpon bkra rnam/ shul gling pad rgyal/ dmag dpon sba ra sbra chen dpal ldan/ rdo snying shog la dud grangs chig brgya bcu dpon bsod nams g.yu rgyal/ shul gling rong sbra'i rin dbang / dmag dpon ram zhi tshe dga'/ sde rab shog la dud grangs brgyad cu/ 'go pa bcu dpon bde skyid tshogs rab/ shul gling gtsang pa bstan 'grub/ dmag dponarol ba'i rdor rnam shog phyed shog la dud grangs lnga bcu/ 'go pa bcu dpon 'jigs med/ shul gling ga mer/ dmag dpon skar dgra bcas dang / sa skya tsho bdun gyi spyi khyab sgar dpon tshe ring lhun grub red (a khri yang zer/) bya dol dgon gyi se rug shog chung der dud grangs/'go pa bya rigs skya seng zer/ gong gsal sa skya tsho bdun nas da lta 135

dpal mgon rdzong khongs phying lung chus la yod pa dang / she ma dang / pob sde rnying / stod ma sogs spro che chus la yod/ sde rab dang / shog chen gnyis lcags mtsho chus la yod/sngon 'dam brgya shog brgyad kyi khongs chos 'khor them grangasalnga brgya skor la/ nang khul lho byang gnyis yod/ 'go pa bcu dpon spra nag dpa' chen dang / lung ru bcu dpon bsam 'grub/ bon lung bcu dpon tshe rdor bcas gsum/ de 'og shul gling gnyis yod pa ste/thang lha tshe ring dang / rag shi ngag dbang / de 'og 'go dpon gnyis yod pa rta mgrin dbang 'dus dang / gzhan gcig bcas yod/ sger mkhar rdo bla brang gi sger sde/ mkhar rdo ru ba dud grangs chig brgya nyi shu 'go pa mkhar rdo bla gnyer zer ba mkhar rdo'i phyag mdzod kyis byed kyi yod pa dang / shog kha'i nang rda rog gcig yod pa/ tshe ring rgyal po zer/ 'bri ru rdzong khongs dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma byas sngon gyi shog kha dang / dud grangs/ spyi dpon dang lding dpon/ brgya dpon/rgan chen bcas kyi tho gsham gsal/khra ring shog kha'i spyi dpon rdo rje gzhon nu zer/ khra ring shod der nang gses shog kha chung ba bzhi yod/ khra ring sgur stod shog la dud grangs rig brgya lnga bcu nga lnga skor dang de'i 'go pa brgya dpon ga rgya dung skyabs zer/ khra ring sgur smad shog la dud grangs brgyad cu gya gsum skor la/ 'go pa lding dpon lha srung zer/ rgan chen kram chos mo khra ring mkha' re shog la dud grangs chig brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de'i 'go pa 136

ldeng dpon rta mgrin rgan chen tshe 'khel/ khra ring ka rong shog la dud grangs lnga cu nga gcig de'i 'go pa lding dpon don 'grub/ ka mda' rgan chen bcas red/ gong gsal khra ring shogal srid gzhung rnying pa'i shing byi lo'i deb 'khod ltar bsdoms dud grangs bzhi brgya bcu bzhi yod/rag shi shog kha'i spyi dpon lha dbang rnam rgyal zer/ lding dpon rdo rje lha rgyal/ brgya dpon tshe ring rab brtan/ shog kha chung ba dbye srol med pa red/ rag shi shog la gong gsal ltar srid gzhung rnying pa'i shing byi lo'i deb 'khod dud grangs sum brgya brgyad cu gya lnga yod pa red /'gom shotsa kha'i spyi dpon rnam rgyal dbang phyug lding dpon dpal bzang rab brtan zer/ 'gom shog la nang gses shog chung lnga yod pa/'gom yung dkar shos la dud grangs chig brgya nyer lnga/ 'go pa brgya dpon yung dkar bsod rgyal/ rkyang ri dkon mchog brgya dpon skyid 'grub/ brgya dpon a khang / spyi mi nor rgyas/ 'gom chu srib shogal dud grangs lnga bcu/ de'i 'go pa tha gdong rab dga' zer/ 'gom yus pa la dud grangs brgya cu gya lnga yod pa de'i 'go pa brgya dpon gsal byed dang / brgya dpon tshe 'grub/ 'gom nyang gu shog la dud grangs drug cu yod pa/ de'i 'go pa brgya dpon lcam pa ko rgyas zer/ 'gom lum tha dang / dkar gzhung gnyis la dud grangs lnga cu nga lnga yod pa de'i 'go pa brgya dpon lcam pa pad dar dang / brgya dpon rgya po bcas red/ 'gom shog la srid gzhung rnying pa'i shing byi lo'i deb 'khod bsdoms dud grangs sum brgya drug cu re lnga yod/ 'bri ru shog kha'i spyi dpon 137

bsod nams rdo rje zer/ nang gses shog kha bzhi yod pa red/ 'bri ru skyar rgyud shog la dud grangs rig brgya bcu yod/ de'i 'go pa rgan chen rta nor zer/ 'bri ru chung rgyud shog la dud grangs brgyad cu gya gsum yod/ de'i 'go pa lding dpon bsod nams dar 'phel rgan chen 'bis rdo rje/ 'bri ru lung rgyud shog la dud grangs bdun cu don lnga/de'i 'go pa lding dpon skar ma rnam rgyal/ rgan chen sog ru rdo rab/'bri ru nyi ma shog la dud grangs lnga cu nga lnga/ de'i 'go pa lding dpon tshe ring nor bu dang / rgan chen a phur bstan dar bcas red/ gong gas la 'bri ru shog la srid gzhung rnying pa'i shing byi lo'i deb 'khod ltar dud grangs sum brgya nyi shu rtsa gsum yod pa red/ stag phrug shog kha'i spyi dpon 'jigs med rdo rje bis pa lding dpon tshe ring chos 'phel dang /g.yas/ pa lding dpon bkra shis bsod nams/ blon po 'brug stag 'chi med tshe ring bcas red/ shog kha chung ba dbye srol med pa red/ gong gsal stas phrug tsho pa la srid gzhung rnying pa'i shing byi lo'i deb 'khod ltar bsdoms dud grangs sum brgya bcu yod/ de'i nang stag phu bla brang gi mgo btags dud grangs bdun cu tshud yod/ bom phan shog kha'i spyi dpon phur bu bdud 'dul/ nang gses shog kha gnyis yod pa ste/ bom phan stod shog la dud grangs drug cu re bzhi yod/ de'i 'go pa lding dpon dkon mchog zer/ bom phan smad shog la dud grangs lnga cu nga gsum yod/ de'i 'go pa lding dpon rdo rje zer/ sen tsha shog kha'i dpon tshul khrims rgya mtsho zer/ chig stong dgu brgya lnga cu nga dgu'i lo stod 138

nas de'i bu stag lha rgya mtsho nas 'gan khur ba dang / rgan chen rag zhi bsod nams dbang grags dang / rgan thos dpa' grags bcas red/srid gzhung rnying pa'i shing byi lo'i deb 'khod dud grangs lnga cu nga gciganag rog shog kha'i dpon rje btsun mo/ blon po mar ldog shing byi lo'i deb 'khod dud grangs brgyad cu gya gcig dngos yod dud grangs chig brgya skor yod/ bu 'dzum rtse/ga kha'i dpon snang srid zil gnon dang /blon po dpon ru nor 'dus dang / blon po yang nge g.yang sras bcas red/ srid gzhung rnying pa'i shing byi lo'i deb 'khod dud grangs bdun cu don bdun/ dngos yod dud grangs chig brgya lhag tsam kong po nying khri rgyud du bu rdzum gyi khyim dud chig brgya skor zhig yod pa red/ de'i 'go pa kong stod rgan po spang dkar bstan pa dang / kong smad rgan po dkar mar bkra bo bcas red/ chag rtse'i 'go btags dud bcu drug de'i 'go pa nang chen dar dbyang dang / rgan po yung dkar a mgo bcas red/bu ju ma g.yas phu ru sdod pa'i sde dud 'ga' zhig da lta dpal 'bar shan khongs su yod/ chig stong dgu brgya drug cu re gsum lor chab mdo kron chus dpal 'bar shan khongs nas 'bri ru la sprad rgyur byas pa sngon rgya ston lding dgu'i khongs ban dkar shog la dud grangs chig brgya dgu cu go lnga de'i 'go pa che shos stag phu bla brang gi phyag mdzod bstan 'dzin ri dbang dang de'i 'go gnyer pa tsho mdo/ ngag dbang sangs rgyas dang gnyer pa a zu dbang ldan bcas red/ skur bzhi shog la dud grangs chig brgya lnga cu nga lnga skor yod/ shog kha de'i 'go pa sgur bzhi lding dpon tshe dbang rgyal 139

mtshan dang lding dpon yul pa 'brug sras blon po bar ma bsam che na/bcu dpon bstan 'dzin tshul khrims/ mi drag gangs ri chos ris bcas red/lha ri rdzong khongs de sngon dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma byas gong chig stong dgu brgya lnga cu nga dgu lo'i skabs shog kha so so'i ming dang dud grangs/shog kha'i 'go pa bcas kyi tho gsham gsal/ lha ri rtsa za ru bzhi zer ba de la bsdoms dud grangs sum brgya sum cu so dgu/ rtsa za ru bzhi'i spyi dpon 'go pa lding dpon ya nge skar rgyal/ de'i nang gses sde khog shog la dud grangs drug cu re bdun/ 'go pa gtso grags zer ba nang chung o rgyan dang / nag rgyud phyag rdor gnyis red/ thang tho shog la dud grangs bzhi cu zhe gnyis/ 'go pa gtso grags thos pa chos dbyings dang / dmar rtsa dbang rgyal gnyis/ thang mag shog la dud grangs sumacu so bdun/ 'go pa rgan po nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ sangs pa shog la dud grangs bdun cu don lnga/ 'go pa rgan po bro bdag dang spus tsha pa sangs/ lha rje kun khyab gsum ching pa shog la dud grangs chig brgya bco brgyad/ 'go pa gtso drag chos skyong dang / ye shes gnyis red/lha ri mi ser zer ba dud grangs bani cu zhe lnga dang / ra lu nang pa zer ba dud grangs bco lnga/ de'i 'go pa spyi mi zer/ skabs der sgo sgur dang / sba ga'i a bu gnyis gsar rnying mtshams red/ de 'og mi ser rgan po dpal ldan zer/ zhabs khyi zer ba'i dbul dud bco lnga rdzong g.yog red/ de'i 'go pa rgan po pad rnam/ ru bdun zer ba ni rtsa 140

za ru bzhi'i thog lha ri sde dgon dang / shug stag rdzis/ dgon ar tsa sde dgon bcas brgyab pa'i bdun la zer gyi yod/ ru bzhi gong gsal yod la lha ri mi ser zer ba'i gong du gsal ba ltar red/ shug sta ga rji sa pa zer ba shog der dud grangs drug cu yod pa de'i 'go pa rgan po tshe lha dang / 'go pa gtso bo dge slong 'jig pa zer/ ar rtsa shog la dud grangs bco lnga/ sde pa rnam rgyal tshe ring gis shug stag sdo daphon dang /mar rtsa sde dgon gnyis kyi 'go pa byas yod/ gong ba sal dud grangs rnams khral pa sha stag red/ snye bo stod sngon chad lha ri rdzong zhabs/ la 'du dgos pa/ der shog kha du srag gnyis dang / tsi 'bras gnyis yod pa ste/ du srag gnyis la dud grangs nyi shu rtsa drug 'go pa ldi nga dpon srag ma bkra shis/ tsi 'bras la dud gra ngas sum cu 'go/ pa lding dpon/ dbye dkar chos dbyings/ snye bo smad ni/ yi bo yi da 'ongs rdzong zhabs la gtogs pa der shog kha lnga yod pa ste/ grang sasu ma po'i shog khar dud grangs sum cu/ 'go pa rgyas dpon pad+ma tshe reng /bde 'bang shog la dud grangs nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'go pa rgyas dpon rab rgyas/ bkra shis sgang la dud grangs bzhi cu zhe gnyis/ 'go pa rgyas dpon rta mgrin tshe dbang / nyin smad la dud grangs bco brgyad/ 'go pa da 'o rgyas dpon/ snyan 'grung sgong gsu ma dud grangs nyi shu rtsa brgyad/'go pa sga 'gag rgyas dbon/ gong gsal lding khag lnga'i 'go pa gartsa bo rdzong dpon 'gyur med zer/ 'bri gung sbra ga sngon cha da 'bri gung rdzong 'og dang der shog spyi'i ming 'bri gung sbra ga dud grangs lnga brgya zer srol 141

yod kyang / du ba gnam gtong dud grangs bdun brgya ma tshad dngos yod dud grangs brgyad brgya lnga bcu skor dang / de'i 'go pa sbra ga spyi khyab/ da gsar gre 'bum dang / de'i 'og stong dpon rgu rdzi phun tshoḍa/de 'og brgya dpon a ban mi 'gyur zer/ nang gses shog chung bzhi phye yod pa ste/ mer pa'i rgan shog dang / she ma ru pa'i rgan shog nya 'bo'i bo/na shog smad pa'i rgan shog bcas bzhi la dud grangs nyis brgya ngacu lhag tsam re yod pa red/ de min da dung rtse yig tshang la gtogs pa'i 'u na shog zer ba zhig yod pa der dud grangs chig brgya nyi shu skor yod/ de'i 'go pa ni bcu dpon kham pa dbang rgyal zer/ gong gsal sbra ga sga shog bzhi'i rgan po ni mer pa'i rgan po dar dbyang / shan ma ru pa'i rgan po gcig nya 'bo'i rgan po bsam 'phel/ smad pa'i rgan po spu ge bcaṭa5 red/ su rong la sngon chad 'bri gung rdzong 'og shog kha gsum yod pa/ 'og shog zer ba dud grangs lnga cu/ der bcu dpon dud /sar rig rgod/ rong stod dud grangs bdun cu/ der bcu dpon chos 'byor/ rong smad dud grangs lnga bcu skor/ der bcu dpon shanaseng ge/ gong gsal shog gsum spyi pa'i 'go pa rgan po mi 'gyur dang /brgya dpon ma nor gnyis ded/ yang 'bras spung sgo mang grwa tshang gi mi ser spyang ru zer ba dud grangs bcu dgu/ de'i 'go pa rgan po klu mo zer/ gong gsal sbra gari nya 'bo'i rgan shog nas dud lnga bcu skor zhigad lta rgya mda' rdzong khongs gtogs yod/snyan rong shan khongs la lngar yod shog kha brgyad yod pa/ sog sde 142

la nang gses shog kha bzhi/ de 'og rgan shog chung ba yod med ma nges/ zhib gzhung khongs med pa'i dud grangs cung mang ba yod/ ar stod shog la shing byi zhib gzhung nang 'khod dud grangs brgyad cu gya brgyad/ khral med dud bsdoms grangs nyis brgya nga/cu med gnyis / shog de'i dpon khri 'bum dang / las bya nyams ma khar/ ar smad shog la la shing byi zhib 'khod dud grangs chig brgya sum cu so gnyis/ khral yod med bsdoms dud grangs nyis brgya bcu med dgu/ dpon bstan pa dar/ las cha khyung po lha 'ju/ rdza dmar shog la shing byi zhib 'khod dud grangs nyis brgya sum cu so dgu/ khral yod med bsdoms dud grangs sum brgya/dpon zha khra 'chi med/ laca/ cha spes thog nor rdo dang stag dban tshe lo/nag zhig a dga' ge mo shog la shing byi zhib 'khod dud grangs chig brgya bcu med dgu/ khral yod med bsdoms dud grangs nyi shu/ dpon ge khod dang / las cha tshe ring rgyal mtshan/ ba 'o shog la shing byi 'ib 'khod dud grangs bdun cu/ khral yod med bsdoms dud grangs chig brgya sum cu/ dpon sbang zhig dpon ming 'dzin khyung rgyal/ be ru shog la shing byi zhib gca/la dud grangs chig brgya bcu dgu/ khral yod med bsdoms nyis brgya sum cu so lnga/ dpon 'gan khur khan dpon ngag dbang dge legs/ sog sde shog la shing byi zhib gsal dud grangs sum brgya lnga cu nga drug nang gses shog kha 'bring ba bzhi ste/ sog sde stod mngal dngos yod dud grangs lnga brgya dang bcu/ 'go pa mi grags ar chung dgra lha dar rgyas/ dgon skor shog la dud grangs nyis brgya 143

bco lnga 'go pa mi drag bod pa stag rgyal / dpon skor shog la dud grangs chig brgya lnga bcu 'go pa mi drag 'brug stag dgra 'dul/ rgod tha shog la dud grangs brgya cu/ 'go pa nag rgyud spyi drung bso da nams bkra shis/tho/nga gsal sog sde shog kha'i spyi dpon nor bu tshe ring / khyon bsdoms dud grangs dgu brgya lnga cu nga lnga klu zog shog kha zhib gzhung la 'khod med/khral yo da med bsdoms dud grangasashe chig brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga/ 'go ba rang yi/sa bskos pa/ dpon rigs gsum khri stobs bcas red/sbra chen rdzong khongs/ 'brog shog tsho nga 'i spyi dpon g.yung drung rgyal ba/ de 'og lding dpon tsha rong dbang 'grub dang / lding dpon tsha kha rnam rgyal/ lding dpon lha dge/ rnaca chen bcas red/ lding khag gsu ma la nang gses dmar ru shog la dud grangs lnga cu nga lnga/ 'go pa nad dwangs dbang myo/chog glan sne shog la dud grangarnga bdun cu don gsum/ 'go pa yon chen o ma bkra tri/sa/ gong tha shog la dud grangs bdun cu don lnga/ 'go pa rgan chen tshab skal rgyas/ rdza khyim shog la dwad grangs bzhi cu/ 'go pa blon po byu mur ga yang rgya'/ bdar chen shog ‘ sa dud grangs bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ 'go pa blon po rgyu sne skal nor/ pra 'o shog la dud grangs drug cu re lnga/ 'go pa blon po gtsang tsha bon gshen/g.yab gda' shog la dud grangs bdun cu don lnga/ 'go pa blon po bra'o bstan rgyal rdza srib shog la dud grangs dgu cu go gnyis 'go pa blon po phun tshoḍa/ gang che shog la dud grangs chis/ brgya bcu med gciga'ago pa slon ngo skal bzang bkra shis / mkha' skor shog la dud grangaca/ bzhi cu zhe brgyad / 144

'go pa gtsang tsha don ldan sgar chen shog la dud grangs sum r+sha so bzhi/ 'go pa rgan po chos ldan/ rta stod shog la dud grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ 'gopa blon po ga bya skar ma bra smad shog la dud grangs nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'go pa 'bru skal grags/ ar shog dud grangs lnga cu nga gnyis/ 'go pa blon po 'khor tsha skar rgyan/ bong smad shog la dud grangs bzhi cu zhe brgyad 'go pa rgan po bu thar/ nyin lung shog la dud grangs sum cu/ 'go pa rgan po g.yung shes/ 'brog shog bsdoms dud grangs brgyad brgya lnga cu nga lnga/ bor tha shog kha'i dpon bru khyung dgon dang / rgan chen 'thu bkra ba/ bon tha shog la nang gses shog bzhi yod pa ste/ ar rtsa dang gan skor gnyis la dud grangs chig brgya bcu bzhi/ 'go pa rgan po ra ru 'brug lha dang / rgan po 'go span rnam rgyal thog chen shog la dud grangs bdun cu don bzhi/ 'go pa rgan po thog chen 'od bdag bra 'o shog la dud grangs lnga cu nga drug 'go pa bra 'o dbang chen/ 'ba' ba shog la dud grangs bzhi cu zhe bzhi/ 'go pa rgan po dgyang nyor bsdoms du da grangs nyis brgya brgyad cu gya dgu/ drug cu shog kha'i dpon tshab dkon mchog dang / rgan rdo ba g.yung chen/ nang gses shog kha brgyad yod pa ste/ byang tha shog la dud grangs nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa bag gro/ yigatha shog la dud grangs sum cu so bzhi/ 'go pa yig rong g.yung drung rgan chen bsod nams mu rgyal/ tha sne shog la dud grangs nyi shu rtsa gciga'ago pa rgan chen kha dbang / pho rgod shog la dud grangs nyi shu 'go pa 'khri she/ rgan chen rta nag bstan phun lha lung shog la dud grangs bco 145

brgyad/ 'go pa tshe nor/ dga' lung shog la dud grangs nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ 'go pa tshe ring bsod dga'/ rgan chen ngo che skal grags/ lha bu shog la dud grangs bzhi cu zhe gcig 'go pa glang bsod bzang /ngo che shog la dud grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ 'go pa 'byor rgyas bsdoms dud grangs nyis brgya bcu med dgu/ me tha shog kha'i dpon bdud 'dul rdo rje/de 'og lding dpon gnam lha/ nang gses ye tha/ stod smad gnyis yod pa ste/ smad ma'i khongs sang mda' shog la dud grangs bzhi cu zhe lnga 'go pa blon po zhu mkhan rdo graḍa/ de 'og rgan po yung dkar mar dga' re ho shog la dud grangs sum cu blon chen 'go ba 'ob tshug rgan chen lhaphun/ srib tha shog la dud grangs lnga cu nga gsum/ 'go pa blon po dbang rgyal dang rgan chen rin chen dbang rgyal/ mar rdom shog la dud grangs sum cu so brgyad/ blon po 'go ba g.yung drung / rgan chen rnam rgyal dbang grags lung bzang shog la dud grangs sum cu so brgyad/ 'go pa blon po bya rigasashes rab phar phyin/ rgan chen ba 'o blo ldan nyi ma/dgu spyang shog la dud grangs bzhi cu zhe brgyad/ 'go pa blon po ba 'o dbang 'dus/ rgan chen zhu mkhan tshe ring dga' 'grub/ bar tha shog la dud grangs bzhi cu zhe gnyis/ 'go pa blon po a rigs khri rgyal rgan chen phyug gsar tha gdong / ye tha stod ma'i khongs mam tha shog la dud grangs sum cu so gnyis/ 'go pa blon u ri bkra shis dbang rgyal rgan chen che rgyud dge 'dun/ rong chen shog la dud grangs bzhi cu zhe dgu/ 'go pa blon po dpa' gsal gtso mchog rgan chen dpa' gsal—146
